rules.scenario_en: When evaluating enterovirus-positive widespread bullous lesions in immunocompromised patients
rules.checkpoint: 该患者是否为不典型手足口病？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is this patient diagnosed with atypical hand-foot-mouth disease?
rules.error_behavior: 错误认为不典型手足口病皮损局限于经典分布，误判为播散性肠道病毒感染
rules.correct_reasoning: 不典型手足口病皮损可超出经典分布，免疫低下者可出现广泛病变伴病毒血症

rules.rule: 眶周紫黄皮疹先排查多发性骨髓瘤，勿先诊血管炎
rules.rule_en: Periorbital purpuric yellow rash, rule out multiple myeloma first
rules.scenario: 眶周分布紫黄色皮肤皮疹的鉴别诊断
rules.scenario_en: Differential diagnosis of periorbital purpuric yellow skin rash
rules.checkpoint: 是否先排查了多发性骨髓瘤？
rules.checkpoint_en: Have you ruled out multiple myeloma first?
rules.error_behavior: 误将眶周紫黄皮疹判为白细胞碎裂性血管炎，错误排除多发性骨髓瘤
rules.correct_reasoning: 白细胞碎裂性血管炎好发下肢，眶周分布不典型；多发性骨髓瘤可出现眶周皮肤淀粉样变，表现为该类皮疹，应优先考虑

rules.rule: 年轻正常BMI糖尿病伴减重，一线用药为胰岛素
rules.rule_en: For young diabetic patients with normal BMI and weight loss, first-line is insulin
rules.scenario: 年轻患者出现体重减轻、正常BMI，诊断糖尿病分型选初始治疗时
rules.scenario_en: When diagnosing diabetes type and selecting initial treatment for young patients with weight loss and normal BMI
rules.checkpoint: 该患者是否为1型糖尿病？
rules.checkpoint_en: Does this patient have Type 1 diabetes mellitus?
rules.error_behavior: 模型误判为2型糖尿病，错将二甲双胍作为一线用药
rules.correct_reasoning: 患者年轻、正常BMI、非 intentional体重减轻符合1型糖尿病，一线治疗是胰岛素

rules.rule: 新生儿呼吸困难胸片，先排查先天性膈疝征象
rules.rule_en: For dyspneic neonate's chest radiograph, first check CDH signs
rules.scenario: 新生儿呼吸困难行胸片检查鉴别诊断时
rules.scenario_en: When differential diagnosis is done via chest radiograph for dyspneic neonate
rules.checkpoint: 是否排查了先天性膈疝典型征象？
rules.checkpoint_en: Have you checked typical CDH signs?
rules.error_behavior: 误读胸片，漏诊先天性膈疝典型征象，错诊为 surfactant缺乏
rules.correct_reasoning: 先仔细阅片，排查CDH典型征象如胸腔肠气影、纵隔移位，再诊断

rules.rule: 鉴别FL-HCC与FNH，中央瘢痕T2信号最具决定性
rules.rule_en: When differentiating FL-HCC and FNH, central scar T2 signal is most definitive
rules.scenario: MRI鉴别肝脏FL-HCC和FNH时
rules.scenario_en: When differentiating hepatic FL-HCC and FNH on MRI
rules.checkpoint: 哪项是二者最明确的鉴别特征？
rules.checkpoint_en: What is the most definitive differentiator between the two?
rules.error_behavior: 错误认为肝胆期信号比中央瘢痕T2信号更具决定性
rules.correct_reasoning: FL-HCC中央瘢痕T2低信号，FNH中央瘢痕T2高信号，此特征最具鉴别性

rules.rule: 喙肩韧带切除后，直接结果是增加盂肱关节平移
rules.rule_en: After coracoacromial ligament resection, the direct result is increased glenohumeral joint translation
rules.scenario: 分析肩关节镜下喙肩韧带切除后的结果时
rules.scenario_en: When analyzing the outcome of coracoacromial ligament resection during shoulder arthroscopy
rules.checkpoint: 喙肩韧带切除的直接结果是什么？
rules.checkpoint_en: What is the direct result of coracoacromial ligament resection?
rules.error_behavior: 混淆手术治疗指征和切除后的直接结果，误选减少肩峰下撞击
rules.correct_reasoning: 喙肩韧带限制盂肱关节平移，切除后直接增加盂肱关节平移，减少撞击是治疗指征而非直接结果

rules.rule: 钝性眼外伤IOP升高需先排查眶隔综合征
rules.rule_en: Rule out orbital compartment syndrome first for elevated IOP after blunt ocular trauma
rules.scenario: 钝性眼部外伤后出现眼压显著升高
rules.scenario_en: Significantly elevated intraocular pressure after blunt ocular trauma
rules.checkpoint: 是否排查了眶隔综合征？
rules.checkpoint_en: Have you ruled out orbital compartment syndrome?
rules.error_behavior: 误将眶隔综合征所致眼压升高当成外伤性青光眼处理
rules.correct_reasoning: 钝性眼外伤后眼压显著升高首先考虑眶隔综合征，需紧急侧方切开减压

rules.rule: Multiple findings require selecting the unifying primary diagnosis
rules.rule_en: Multiple findings require selecting the unifying primary diagnosis
rules.scenario: When multiple abnormal findings exist and overall diagnosis is required
rules.scenario_en: When multiple abnormal findings exist and overall diagnosis is required
rules.checkpoint: Is this the unifying diagnosis for all findings?
rules.checkpoint_en: Is this the unifying diagnosis for all findings?
rules.error_behavior: Only focused on inner ear complication, dismissed primary CML diagnosis
rules.correct_reasoning: Recognize CML is the unifying primary diagnosis accounting for all findings including the complication

rules.rule: For oligomenorrhea with vasomotor symptoms, rule out hyperthyroidism with TSH first
rules.rule_en: For oligomenorrhea with vasomotor symptoms, rule out hyperthyroidism with TSH first
rules.scenario: Middle-aged female with oligomenorrhea and vasomotor symptoms, suspected perimenopause
rules.scenario_en: Middle-aged female with oligomenorrhea and vasomotor symptoms, suspected perimenopause
rules.checkpoint: Did you rule out hyperthyroidism with TSH first?
rules.checkpoint_en: Have you ruled out hyperthyroidism with TSH first?
rules.error_behavior: Incorrectly claimed hyperthyroidism does not cause oligomenorrhea, chose FSH over TSH as initial test
rules.correct_reasoning: Hyperthyroidism causes oligomenorrhea, rule it out with TSH before testing FSH for perimenopause

rules.rule: 稳定急性全肺不张粘液栓，首选胸部物理治疗
rules.rule_en: Stable acute total atelectasis from mucus plug, chest physiotherapy first-line
rules.scenario: 卧床稳定患者粘液栓致急性全肺不张，选择初始治疗
rules.scenario_en: Selecting initial management for stable acute total atelectasis caused by mucus plug in bedridden patient
rules.checkpoint: 患者是否为临床稳定状态？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is the patient clinically stable?
rules.error_behavior: 错误认为完全肺不张需直接行支气管镜，未首选胸部物理治疗
rules.correct_reasoning: 稳定急性全肺不张粘液栓初始首选胸部物理治疗，支气管镜仅用于保守无效者

rules.rule: 垂体病变增强MRI先判增强模式再定性
rules.rule_en: Characterize enhancement pattern first for pituitary lesions on contrast MRI
rules.scenario: 评估肢端肥大症患者增大垂体病变的动态增强MRI
rules.scenario_en: Evaluating enlarged pituitary lesions via dynamic contrast MRI in acromegaly
rules.checkpoint: 病灶增强模式是不是均匀一致？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is the lesion enhancement pattern uniform?
rules.error_behavior: 错误将不均匀低强化判为均匀无强化，误判为囊性病变
rules.correct_reasoning: 先观察增强后各区域信号确认增强模式，再定性，本例不均匀低强化符合低血供肿瘤

rules.rule: Selecting chest CT pathology needing immediate intervention, don't confuse workup with urgent action
rules.rule_en: When selecting pathology needing immediate intervention on chest CT, do not confuse workup with urgent action
rules.scenario: 解读胸部CT，需要识别需要立即干预的病变时
rules.scenario_en: When interpreting chest CT to identify pathology requiring immediate intervention
rules.checkpoint: 该病变是否需要立即干预？
rules.checkpoint_en: Does the finding require immediate intervention?
rules.error_behavior: 把正常纵隔血管误判为肿大淋巴结，将进一步检查需求混淆为立即干预，错误因窗设置排除D选项
rules.correct_reasoning: 孤立纵隔淋巴结肿大仅需评估不需要立即干预，纵隔窗可观察胸腔积液，磨玻璃影伴血管扭曲和胸腔积液才是需要立即干预的病变

rules.rule: 无急性靶器官损害的血压骤升先观察不急于降压
rules.rule_en: For BP elevation without acute end-organ damage, monitor first instead of urgent intervention
rules.scenario: 住院患者出现无急性靶器官损害的血压骤升，血压升高继发于急性炎症应激
rules.scenario_en: When a hospitalized patient has sudden blood pressure elevation without acute end-organ damage, and the elevation is secondary to acute inflammatory stress
rules.checkpoint: 是否存在急性靶器官损害？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is there any acute end-organ damage?
rules.error_behavior: 模型错误认为显著血压升高必须立即干预，排除了继续观察的选项
rules.correct_reasoning: 患者血压骤升但无急性靶器官损害，升高由蜂窝织炎炎症应激导致，多为一过性，无需立即降压，继续当前治疗并监测是合适的

rules.rule: CT见肠壁缺损对比剂先排除穿孔再考虑憩室
rules.rule_en: Rule out perforation before diverticulum for contrast in colonic wall defect on CT
rules.scenario: 解读结肠CT轴位，见肠壁缺损内局灶口服对比剂，轴位难追踪
rules.scenario_en: When interpreting axial colon CT with focal oral contrast in wall defect hard to trace
rules.checkpoint: 对比剂是否进入肠壁缺损而非憩室?
rules.checkpoint_en: Does contrast enter a bowel wall defect not a diverticulum?
rules.error_behavior: 错误认为穿孔仅表现为大量游离对比剂外渗，误将小穿孔诊为憩室
rules.correct_reasoning: 小局限性穿孔可表现为肠壁缺损内局灶点状对比剂，憩室是膨出而非缺损，需排除穿孔

rules.rule: 骨盆出口位摄片最佳显示骶神经孔
rules.rule_en: Pelvic outlet radiography best visualizes sacral neural foramina
rules.scenario: 髂骶螺钉置入术中判断出口位作用
rules.scenario_en: Judging function of outlet view during iliosacral screw placement
rules.checkpoint: 出口位是否最佳显示骶神经孔？
rules.checkpoint_en: Does outlet view best visualize sacral neural foramina?
rules.error_behavior: 错误认为出口位最佳显示骶翼矢状曲，误排骶神经孔选项
rules.correct_reasoning: 出口位头倾投照显示骶神经孔，骶翼矢状曲由侧位片评估

rules.rule: LCH累及≥2个器官系统即为多系统LCH
rules.rule_en: LCH involving ≥2 organ systems is multisystem LCH
keywords: 朗格汉斯细胞组织细胞增生症
rules.scenario: 对朗格汉斯细胞组织细胞增生症进行分型诊断时
rules.scenario_en: When classifying Langerhans cell histiocytosis
rules.checkpoint: 患者累及几个不同器官系统？
rules.checkpoint_en: How many organ systems are involved?
rules.error_behavior: 错误认为多系统LCH必须累及特定内脏器官，漏算独立器官系统
rules.correct_reasoning: 多系统LCH定义为≥2个不同器官系统受累，本例皮肤+骨符合，诊断多系统LCH

rules.rule: 4岁儿童双侧对称股骨头骨骺改变先考虑Meyer发育不良
rules.rule_en: For 4-year-old children with bilateral symmetric femoral epiphyseal changes, consider Meyer's dysplasia first
rules.scenario: 4岁儿童髋关节X线见双侧对称股骨头骨骺改变，鉴别诊断时
rules.scenario_en: Differential diagnosis of bilateral symmetric femoral epiphyseal changes on hip X-ray of a 4-year-old child
rules.checkpoint: 是否为双侧对称儿童股骨头骨骺改变?
rules.checkpoint_en: Is this bilateral symmetric change in child's femoral epiphysis?
rules.error_behavior: 错误将双侧对称股骨头骨骺改变诊断为Perthes病，排除Meyer发育不良
rules.correct_reasoning: Meyer发育不良是4岁儿童良性发育变异，表现为双侧对称股骨头骨骺不规则骨化；Perthes病多单侧，双侧也不对称伴塌陷，本例应优先考虑Meyer发育不良

rules.rule: 青少年骨盆撕脱骨折按部位确定责任肌肉
rules.rule_en: Identify responsible muscle by avulsion site for adolescent pelvic avulsion fracture
rules.scenario: 青少年运动后髋损伤，骨盆平片见撕脱骨折需定责任肌
rules.scenario_en: Adolescent hip injury after sports, pelvic radiograph shows avulsion fracture requiring responsible muscle identification
rules.checkpoint: 撕脱骨折部位判断正确了吗？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is the avulsion fracture site correctly identified?
rules.error_behavior: 错误判定撕脱部位为坐骨结节，错选股二头肌
rules.correct_reasoning: 先确认撕脱骨折具体部位，再对应肌肉起源确定责任肌

rules.rule: 慢性咳嗽伴清喉，无鼻漏仍需考虑PNDS
rules.rule_en: Chronic cough with throat clearing, consider PNDS even without rhinorrhea
rules.scenario: 健康成人慢性干咳，常规检查无异常时
rules.scenario_en: Otherwise healthy adult with chronic nonproductive cough and normal examinations
rules.checkpoint: 是否正确排除PNDS？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is PNDS correctly ruled out?
rules.error_behavior: 错误认为无鼻漏即可排除PNDS，误诊为GERD相关咳嗽
rules.correct_reasoning: PNDS可无前置鼻漏，仅表现为慢性咳嗽伴清喉，首选苯海拉明经验治疗

rules.rule: 区分不同肺炎球菌疫苗对应免疫机制
rules.rule_en: Distinguish immune mechanisms of different pneumococcal vaccine types
rules.scenario: 为COPD合并急性感染患者推荐疫苗时
rules.scenario_en: When recommending vaccination for COPD patients with acute infection
rules.checkpoint: 是否区分不同肺炎球菌疫苗免疫机制？
rules.checkpoint_en: Do you distinguish different pneumococcal vaccine immune mechanisms?
rules.error_behavior: 错误认为推荐疫苗都增强记忆B细胞抗荚膜菌激活，选错C
rules.correct_reasoning: 区分多糖和结合疫苗不同免疫机制，匹配正确选项

rules.rule: 不能仅以正常脉率排除房室结功能障碍
rules.rule_en: Do not rule out AV node dysfunction only by normal pulse rate
rules.scenario: 评估心梗后头晕伴不规则心律患者的传导系统受累部位
rules.scenario_en: Evaluating affected conduction system in post-MI patients with dizziness and irregular heartbeat
rules.checkpoint: 正常脉率能否排除房室结功能障碍？
rules.checkpoint_en: Can normal pulse rule out AV node dysfunction?
rules.error_behavior: 错误认为房室结功能障碍必致心动过缓，凭正常脉率排除该病误判
rules.correct_reasoning: 偶发漏搏的二度房室传导阻滞脉率可正常，不能仅靠脉率排除，需结合心电图判断

rules.rule: Use only the exact patient and lesion described, do not misassign cases
rules.rule_en: Use only the exact patient and lesion described, do not misassign cases
rules.scenario: When asked to differentiate two lesions from different patients on MRI
rules.scenario_en: When asked to differentiate two lesions from different patients on MRI
rules.checkpoint: Am I using the correct patient cases as described?
rules.checkpoint_en: Am I using the correct patient cases as described?
rules.error_behavior: Misassigned the wrong patient's lesion as the one described in the question
rules.correct_reasoning: Only use the patient/lesion info explicitly stated, don't substitute with an unrelated case

rules.rule: 睾丸周围积液需结合多普勒血流判断原发病
rules.rule_en: Peritesticular effusion needs Doppler for primary diagnosis
rules.scenario: 阴囊超声发现睾丸周围伴随积液时
rules.scenario_en: When peritesticular effusion is found on scrotal ultrasound
rules.checkpoint: 是否结合多普勒血流结果判断？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is Doppler flow result considered?
rules.error_behavior: 仅以存在睾丸周围积液排除睾丸附睾炎，未结合多普勒血流
rules.correct_reasoning: 反应性鞘膜积液可继发于睾丸附睾炎，需结合多普勒血流判断血供

rules.rule: OMM综合方案前需评估患者活力耐受度
rules.rule_en: Evaluate vitality tolerance before comprehensive OMM plan
rules.scenario: 拟行全面整骨手法综合治疗评估禁忌症时
rules.scenario_en: Evaluating contraindications for comprehensive OMM treatment
rules.checkpoint: 患者低活力能否耐受全方案治疗？
rules.checkpoint_en: Can low vitality tolerate full OMM plan?
rules.error_behavior: 误将转移性骨病列为全方案禁忌症，误排低活力
rules.correct_reasoning: 转移性骨病可调整低强度技术使用，低活力无法耐受多技术综合方案，是禁忌症

rules.rule: 排尿诱发晕厥优先考虑情景性晕厥而非主动脉狭窄
rules.rule_en: Prioritize situational syncope over aortic stenosis for urination-triggered syncope
rules.scenario: 评估老年伴收缩期杂音患者排尿诱发的晕厥
rules.scenario_en: Evaluating urination-triggered syncope in elderly with systolic murmur
rules.checkpoint: 患者晕厥的诱发因素是什么？
rules.checkpoint_en: What is the trigger of the patient's syncope?
rules.error_behavior: 错误优先考虑主动脉瓣狭窄，误记其晕厥典型诱因
rules.correct_reasoning: 排尿诱发晕厥符合情景性晕厥，主动脉狭窄晕厥由劳力诱发，单纯杂音不能确诊病因

rules.rule: 诊断CHS先找中性粒过氧化物阳性巨颗粒
rules.rule_en: When diagnosing CHS, first look for giant peroxidase-positive granules in neutrophils
rules.scenario: 疑诊CHS，解读外周血涂片结果时
rules.scenario_en: When suspecting CHS and interpreting peripheral blood smear results
rules.checkpoint: 是否正确识别CHS的血涂片表现？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is the CHS blood smear finding correctly identified?
rules.error_behavior: 模型错把巨血小板异常归为CHS特征，混淆了CHS的典型血涂片表现
rules.correct_reasoning: CHS特征血涂片表现是中性粒细胞过氧化物阳性巨颗粒，巨血小板不是CHS特征

rules.rule: 真肋3-10以桶柄运动为主，1-2以泵柄运动为主
rules.rule_en: True ribs 3-10 primarily use bucket handle motion, 1-2 pump handle
rules.scenario: 整骨治疗肋骨功能障碍，确定肋骨运动类型时
rules.scenario_en: When determining rib motion type for osteopathic rib dysfunction treatment
rules.checkpoint: 病变真肋的主要运动类型是什么？
rules.checkpoint_en: What is the main motion of the affected true rib?
rules.error_behavior: 错误将4-6真肋的主要运动判定为泵柄运动
rules.correct_reasoning: 真肋1-2主要运动为泵柄运动，3-10主要为桶柄运动，4-6属于3-10范围，因此主要运动是桶柄运动

rules.rule: 识别手术类型，交指皮瓣需警惕PIP屈曲挛缩
rules.rule_en: Confirm procedure type, cross-finger flap needs alert for PIP flexion contracture
rules.scenario: 判断手指交指皮瓣术后最可能并发症时
rules.scenario_en: When evaluating the most probable complication after finger cross-finger flap
rules.checkpoint: 是否正确识别了手术类型？
rules.checkpoint_en: Has the procedure type been correctly identified?
rules.error_behavior: 错将交指皮瓣识别为指尖再植，错误排除正确选项
rules.correct_reasoning: 先识别为交指皮瓣，该术需PIP长期屈曲固定，最常见并发症是PIP屈曲挛缩

rules.rule: 屈肘3个月内恢复提示臂丛产瘫完全恢复
rules.rule_en: Elbow flexion recovery within 3 months predicts full recovery of brachial plexus birth palsy
rules.scenario: 评估臂丛神经产瘫患儿远期恢复情况时
rules.scenario_en: When evaluating long-term recovery of infant with brachial plexus birth palsy
rules.checkpoint: 屈肘是否在3个月内恢复？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is elbow flexion recovered within 3 months?
rules.error_behavior: 错误认为完全恢复可能性低，误选与屈肘恢复矛盾的持续畸形选项
rules.correct_reasoning: 屈肘3个月内恢复提示臂丛功能完全恢复，18个月可无异常体征

rules.rule: 诊断选择优先选标准诊断而非病程特征描述
rules.rule_en: Prioritize standard diagnosis over disease course description when selecting diagnosis
rules.scenario: 给出病例要求选出合适的患者诊断时
rules.scenario_en: When asked to select the appropriate diagnosis for a given case
rules.checkpoint: 当前选项是标准诊断吗？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is the current option a standard diagnosis?
rules.error_behavior: 错误优先选择病程特征描述，而非标准诊断表述
rules.correct_reasoning: 应优先选择包含组织学、部位、转移、分子改变的标准诊断表述，而非病程特征描述

rules.rule: 脂肪饱和后消失的乳腺MRI亮区是伪影而非病理
rules.rule_en: Bright area disappearing after fat saturation on breast MRI is artifact not pathology
rules.scenario: 对比乳腺预增强T1加权非脂肪饱和与脂肪饱和图像识别伪影
rules.scenario_en: When comparing non-fat saturated and fat-saturated pre-contrast T1-weighted breast MRI to identify artifacts
rules.checkpoint: 亮区在脂肪饱和后是否消失？
rules.checkpoint_en: Does the bright area disappear after fat saturation?
rules.error_behavior: 模型错误认为非脂肪饱和T1亮、脂肪饱和T1不亮的区域仅为正常解剖，误选D选项
rules.correct_reasoning: 真实T1高信号病理病变内在T1缩短，脂肪饱和后仍保持高信号；非脂肪饱和T1亮而脂肪饱和后消失的区域是脂肪，属于序列相关伪影而非病理病变，因此选项A正确。

rules.rule: 口腔深色色素沉着勿直接诊断汞合金纹身

rules.scenario_en: Differential diagnosis of black pigmented gingival lesions
rules.checkpoint: 是否排除了黑色素瘤等恶性病变？
rules.checkpoint_en: Have melanoma and other malignancies been ruled out?
rules.error_behavior: 仅靠色素颜色和邻牙有修复体就诊断为汞合金纹身，漏诊黑色素瘤
rules.correct_reasoning: 逐一鉴别所有候选疾病，结合病变特点排除恶性病变后再诊断

rules.rule: 纵隔肿块先定位，前纵隔胸腺瘤后纵隔神经源性肿瘤

rules.checkpoint: 肿块位于前纵隔还是后纵隔？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is the mass in anterior or posterior mediastinum?
rules.error_behavior: 错误将后纵隔肿块定位为前纵隔，误诊为胸腺瘤
rules.correct_reasoning: 先准确定位肿块为后纵隔，本例符合后纵隔神经纤维瘤表现

rules.rule: Fontan术后新发发绀，需排查高凝血栓病因

rules.scenario_en: Finding cause of new cyanosis after Fontan in child

rules.checkpoint_en: Is it new cyanosis after Fontan?
rules.error_behavior: 误将正常D二聚体当血栓依据，漏诊高凝病因
rules.correct_reasoning: D二聚体<500ng/mL为正常，该患者活化蛋白C抵抗降低提示高凝状态，是血栓致发绀的病因

rules.rule: 使用非选择性β阻滞剂需关注吸烟史，警惕支气管痉挛
rules.rule_en: Watch for bronchospasm when using non-selective beta blockers with smoking history

rules.scenario_en: New-onset dyspnea after initial pharmacotherapy for STEMI, adverse drug reaction screening
rules.checkpoint: 是否警惕非选择性β阻滞剂致支气管痉挛？
rules.checkpoint_en: Should non-selective beta blocker-induced bronchospasm be considered?
rules.error_behavior: 错误归因于吗啡呼吸抑制，忽略普萘洛尔可致支气管痉挛
rules.correct_reasoning: 患者有长期大量吸烟史，普萘洛尔是非选择性β阻滞剂，可阻断支气管β2受体引发急性支气管痉挛导致呼吸困难；吗啡呼吸抑制多伴意识改变，且非STEMI一线用药，可能性更低。

rules.rule: 心动周期曲线图时间从左到右，需按顺序排列心脏生理事件
rules.rule_en: On cardiac cycle graphs, time goes left to right, arrange cardiac events by temporal order
rules.scenario: 分析心动周期压力容积图标记点，确定病变瓣膜开放时间
rules.scenario_en: Analyzing labeled points on a cardiac cycle pressure-volume graph to determine affected valve opening time
rules.checkpoint: 是否按时间顺序正确排列了心脏事件？
rules.checkpoint_en: Are cardiac events correctly ordered by temporal sequence?
rules.error_behavior: 错误将二尖瓣开放时间放在收缩期前的舒张晚期，而非收缩期后的舒张早期
rules.correct_reasoning: 图上时间从左向右走行，二尖瓣开放发生在心室收缩期结束后的舒张早期，位于收缩期峰值之后

rules.rule: 毛囊痣可表现为多发沿Blaschko线分布皮损

rules.checkpoint_en: Does this case fit hair follicle nevus?

rules.correct_reasoning: 毛囊痣可表现为多发沿Blaschko线分布皮损，组织病理符合本例，应诊断毛囊痣

rules.rule: Mild AIS (10-25° Cobb) manage with OMT + observation first
rules.rule_en: For mild adolescent idiopathic scoliosis (10-25° Cobb), manage with OMT plus observation first
keywords: 青少年特发性脊柱侧弯
rules.scenario: 新诊断轻度青少年特发性脊柱侧弯(Cobb 10-25°)伴背痛
rules.scenario_en: Newly diagnosed mild adolescent idiopathic scoliosis (10-25° Cobb) with back pain
rules.checkpoint: Cobb角是否在10-25度之间？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is the Cobb angle between 10 and 25 degrees?

rules.correct_reasoning: 轻度AIS(10-25°Cobb)一线方案是观察，OMT可缓解背痛，无需立即转诊

rules.rule: B细胞淋巴瘤伴浆细胞分化需明确具体亚型
rules.rule_en: Confirm specific subtype for B-cell lymphoma with plasmacytic differentiation
rules.scenario: 脑脊液检出B细胞淋巴瘤伴浆细胞分化行诊断时
rules.scenario_en: When diagnosing B-cell lymphoma with plasmacytic differentiation in CSF
rules.checkpoint: 是否明确淋巴瘤具体亚型？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is the specific lymphoma subtype confirmed?
rules.error_behavior: 模型将描述性分类当作确诊诊断，排除了正确具体亚型
rules.correct_reasoning: 应区分描述性分类和具体亚型，LPL是伴浆细胞分化B细胞淋巴瘤的具体亚型，符合本例应诊断LPL

rules.rule: 怀疑IHPS伴脱水时，先补液再检查
rules.rule_en: When IHPS is suspected with dehydration, hydrate first before diagnosis
rules.scenario: 怀疑婴儿肥厚性幽门狭窄，患者存在脱水征象
rules.scenario_en: When infantile hypertrophic pyloric stenosis is suspected with dehydration signs

rules.checkpoint_en: Correct dehydration before diagnosis?
rules.error_behavior: 模型认为应先做腹部超声明确诊断，忽略脱水需优先处理
rules.correct_reasoning: 患者存在明确脱水征象，应先纠正脱水再行诊断检查

rules.rule: 前列腺融合活检先明确MRI序列再匹配信号
rules.rule_en: Confirm MRI sequence before matching signal for prostate fusion biopsy
rules.scenario: MR-超声融合前列腺活检判断配准成功时
rules.scenario_en: Judging successful alignment in MR-ultrasound fusion prostate biopsy
rules.checkpoint: 是否明确了所用的MRI序列？
rules.checkpoint_en: Have you confirmed the MRI sequence used?

rules.correct_reasoning: 融合定位常用DWI序列，前列腺癌DWI呈高信号，选A

rules.rule: 膀胱壁增厚伴双侧上尿路扩张先排查下尿路梗阻
rules.rule_en: Check lower urinary tract obstruction first for bladder wall thickening with bilateral upper tract dilatation

rules.correct_reasoning: 膀胱壁增厚提示下尿路梗阻，后尿道瓣膜符合所有表现

rules.rule: When differentiating arthropathies, prioritize discriminatory over exhaustive findings
rules.rule_en: When differentiating arthropathies, prioritize discriminatory over exhaustive findings
rules.scenario: Differentiating psoriatic arthritis from RA/OA on joint imaging
rules.scenario_en: Differentiating psoriatic arthritis from rheumatoid arthritis and osteoarthritis on joint imaging
rules.checkpoint: Are selected features discriminatory between arthropathies?
rules.checkpoint_en: Are selected features discriminatory between arthropathies?
rules.error_behavior: Rejected correct option for not listing all findings, selected wrong option with non-discriminatory findings.
rules.correct_reasoning: Need features that distinguish PsA from RA/OA, not all findings. Correct option has key discriminatory features: DIP involvement, periosteal reaction, preserved density, ivory phalanx, which are absent/rare in RA/OA.

rules.rule: 见PAS阳性肠巨噬细胞应考虑惠普尔病而非乳糜泻

rules.checkpoint: 是否存在PAS阳性肠巨噬细胞？
rules.checkpoint_en: Are there PAS-positive intestinal macrophages?

rules.rule: 题目问关联疾病时，找病理生理关联而非当前病因
rules.rule_en: When asked for associated condition, find pathophysiologic link not current cause
rules.scenario: 临床病例题要求找出与现有表现相关的关联疾病
rules.scenario_en: When a clinical case question asks for a condition associated with the presentation
rules.checkpoint: 题目要求找病因还是关联疾病？
rules.checkpoint_en: Does the question ask for cause or associated condition?
rules.error_behavior: 错误选择了患者当前病因，排除了存在病理关联的选项
rules.correct_reasoning: 明确题目要求，找与基础疾病存在病理关联的疾病，而非病因

rules.rule: 分析癫痫灶定位需核对检查结果的偏侧性
rules.rule_en: Check laterality of findings when localizing seizure focus

rules.scenario_en: When localizing primary seizure focus of drug-resistant epilepsy with PET and MEG

rules.correct_reasoning: 先核对每个选项中PET和MEG结果的偏侧，再判断是否指向目标侧癫痫灶

rules.rule: 鉴别垂体腺瘤和Rathke囊肿，强化结节支持腺瘤

rules.scenario_en: Differentiating corticotrophic microadenoma from Rathke cleft cyst on pituitary MRI
rules.checkpoint: 病灶是否存在钆对比剂摄取？
rules.checkpoint_en: Does the lesion take up gadolinium contrast?
rules.error_behavior: 错误认为T2阴性加临床库欣更支持微腺瘤，否定强化结节价值
rules.correct_reasoning: Rathke囊肿无对比剂摄取，强化结节提示实性微腺瘤，更具特异性

rules.rule: 解读眼底图像时，需确认是否存在奶油色视网膜血管

rules.correct_reasoning: 先检查是否存在奶油色视网膜血管，阳性需考虑视网膜脂血症

rules.rule: ≤20mm指神经间隙，胶原导管等效自体神经移植

rules.correct_reasoning: 胶原导管对≤20mm指神经间隙等效自体神经移植

rules.rule: 慢性炎性背痛患者，低能量创伤需排查椎骨骨折

rules.scenario_en: When confirming diagnosis for chronic inflammatory back pain patients with acute back pain after low-energy trauma
rules.checkpoint: 是否存在椎骨骨折风险？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is there a risk of vertebral fracture?

rules.correct_reasoning: 慢性炎性背痛提示脊柱脆性增加，低能量创伤也可致椎骨骨折，需优先排查

rules.rule: 膝关节MRI先确认图像方位再定位腔室

rules.scenario_en: When interpreting knee MRI and localizing lateral compartment
rules.checkpoint: 是否正确确认了MRI图像方位？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is MRI image orientation correctly confirmed?
rules.error_behavior: 错把矢状位MRI认作冠状位，错误定位腔室，漏诊含铁血黄素沉积
rules.correct_reasoning: 先确认图像方位是旁矢状位外侧腔，再识别含铁血黄素低信号

rules.rule: 判断病例需结合所有多幅超声图像的发现

rules.rule_en: For coronal images, patient's right is on viewer's left per convention

rules.scenario_en: When interpreting coronal FDG PET for organ side localization

rules.checkpoint_en: Is patient side correctly identified per convention?

rules.correct_reasoning: Follow convention: patient right is viewer left for coronal images, correctly localize liver first

rules.scenario_en: When PD patients present with RBD and need diagnosis

rules.correct_reasoning: 先依据病理明确病变诊断，本例病理证实为IgG4相关二尖瓣假性肿瘤

rules.rule: Rapidly growing red nodule in elderly, first rule out Merkel-cell carcinoma
rules.rule_en: For rapidly growing red nodule in elderly, rule out Merkel-cell carcinoma first
rules.scenario: 评估老年人快速生长的无痛红色皮肤结节时
rules.scenario_en: When evaluating a rapidly growing painless red skin nodule in an elderly patient
rules.checkpoint: 患者是否为老年人，结节是否快速生长？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is the patient elderly with rapidly growing nodule?
rules.error_behavior: 忽略患者高龄，假设存在未察觉的轻微创伤，错误诊断为化脓性肉芽肿
rules.correct_reasoning: 老年人曝光部位快速生长的无痛红色结节首先考虑默克尔细胞癌，优先排除该诊断

rules.rule: 无软骨钙化不能排除CPPD关节病，MCP可受累
rules.rule_en: Absence of chondrocalcinosis cannot rule out CPPD arthropathy involving MCP
rules.scenario: 诊断手部掌指关节关节病无软骨钙化时
rules.scenario_en: Diagnosing hand metacarpophalangeal arthropathy without chondrocalcinosis
rules.checkpoint: 是否排除无软骨钙化的CPPD关节病？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is CPPD without chondrocalcinosis ruled out?
rules.error_behavior: 错误认为CPPD仅累及大关节，排除无软骨钙化CPPD，误选侵蚀性骨关节炎
rules.correct_reasoning: CPPD可累及2、3掌指关节，无软骨钙化也不能排除；侵蚀性骨关节炎典型累及指间关节

rules.rule: For stable first-trimester incomplete abortion, prefer misoprostol over D&C
rules.rule_en: For stable first-trimester incomplete abortion, prefer misoprostol over D&C
rules.scenario: 选择稳定型早孕期不全流产合并衣原体感染的治疗方案
rules.scenario_en: Selecting treatment for stable first-trimester incomplete abortion with chlamydial infection
rules.checkpoint: 患者是否不稳定需立即手术清宫？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is the patient unstable requiring immediate surgical evacuation?
rules.error_behavior: 错误选择手术清宫，而非米索前列醇药物治疗
rules.correct_reasoning: 稳定型早孕期不全流产首选抗生素（若有感染）+米索前列醇，手术清宫仅用于不稳定或复杂病例

rules.rule: AJCC 8版间变甲癌IVA要求T1-T3 N0 M0
rules.rule_en: Per AJCC 8th, ATC stage IVA requires T1-T3 N0 M0
rules.scenario: 对间变性甲状腺癌行AJCC 8版分期时
rules.scenario_en: Staging anaplastic thyroid carcinoma per AJCC 8th edition
rules.checkpoint: AJCC 8版间变甲癌IVA是否要求N0？
rules.checkpoint_en: Does AJCC 8th ATC IVA require N0?
rules.error_behavior: 错误认为IVA允许任何N，IVB仅为T4病变
rules.correct_reasoning: AJCC 8版中，IVA要求T1-T3 N0 M0，IVB含T1-T3 N1 M0，本例T1 N0 M0，故为IVA

rules.rule: 胫骨关节面下病灶，勿误判为继发内生软骨瘤
rules.rule_en: Do not misdiagnose tibial subchondral lesion as secondary enchondroma
rules.scenario: 膝关节MRI发现股骨内生软骨瘤，伴胫骨关节面下病变
rules.scenario_en: Knee MRI found femoral enchondroma with tibial subchondral lesion
rules.checkpoint: 病灶位置符合内生软骨瘤好发吗？
rules.checkpoint_en: Does location fit enchondroma predilection?
rules.error_behavior: 因股骨存在内生软骨瘤，误将胫骨关节面下病灶诊断为继发内生软骨瘤
rules.correct_reasoning: 内生软骨瘤好发于长骨干骺端/骨干，罕见关节面下，先考虑退变软骨下囊肿

rules.rule: 急性检查前，先通过病史查体确认是否为新发改变
rules.rule_en: Before acute workup, confirm if changes are new via history and exam
rules.scenario: 已知患者存在先天性脑部疾病，出现意识改变和异常脑电图，拟行下一步处理
rules.scenario_en: Patient with congenital brain disease presents with altered mental status and abnormal EEG, next step management
rules.checkpoint: 是否已经确认当前改变为新发？
rules.checkpoint_en: Have you confirmed the changes are new?
rules.error_behavior: 错误假设病史查体已完成，直接选择CT排除急性颅内出血
rules.correct_reasoning: 首先获取额外病史查体，确认是否为新发急性改变，再决定下一步检查

rules.rule: 主动脉旁上纵隔洗脱结节优先考虑副神经节瘤
rules.rule_en: Prioritize paraganglioma for aortic lateral superior mediastinal washout nodule
rules.scenario: 分析CT上主动脉外侧上纵隔结节的增强特征
rules.scenario_en: Analyzing enhancement features of superior mediastinal nodule lateral to aorta on CT
rules.checkpoint: 病变位置是否匹配候选诊断?
rules.checkpoint_en: Does lesion location match candidate diagnosis?
rules.error_behavior: 错误认为副神经节瘤延迟期留影，误判其好发位置
rules.correct_reasoning: 副神经节瘤动脉强化后可出现延迟洗脱，主动脉旁上纵隔是其经典好发部位

rules.rule: 评估肠壁子宫内膜异位症需先明确病灶位置
rules.rule_en: When evaluating bowel endometriosis, confirm lesion location first
rules.scenario: 经阴道超声评估肠道子宫内膜异位症病灶时
rules.scenario_en: Evaluating bowel endometriosis lesion via transvaginal ultrasound
rules.checkpoint: 病灶是否位于肠壁内？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is the lesion located within the bowel wall?
rules.error_behavior: 误判病灶延伸至子宫直肠窝，排除正确选项
rules.correct_reasoning: 先明确病灶位置，本例病灶位于肠壁内，呈梭形伴不对称增厚

rules.rule: 肩颈轮廓凹陷先排除脂肪营养不良再考虑肌病
rules.rule_en: Rule out lipodystrophy before myopathy for neck-shoulder contour depression
rules.scenario: 肩颈区域出现局部轮廓凹陷，需鉴别诊断时
rules.scenario_en: When focal contour depression appears in shoulder-neck region for differential diagnosis
rules.checkpoint: 是否先排除了脂肪营养不良？
rules.checkpoint_en: Has lipodystrophy been ruled out first?
rules.error_behavior: 错误将肩颈轮廓凹陷归因于斜方肌断裂，排除了脂肪营养不良
rules.correct_reasoning: 先区分皮下脂肪丢失还是肌肉病变，先考虑局限性脂肪营养不良，排除后再考虑肌病

rules.rule: 判断水痘并发症需识别急性小脑性共济失调表现
rules.rule_en: Identify acute cerebellar ataxia when judging varicella complications
rules.scenario: 未接种疫苗儿童患水痘，判断可能并发症时
rules.scenario_en: When judging possible complications of varicella in unvaccinated children
rules.checkpoint: 水痘可致突发不协调性肌肉运动吗？
rules.checkpoint_en: Can varicella cause sudden uncoordinated muscle movement?
rules.error_behavior: 误将突发不协调性运动仅归为风湿性舞蹈病，排除了水痘该并发症
rules.correct_reasoning: 水痘可致儿童急性小脑性共济失调，表现为突发不协调性肌肉运动

rules.rule: 存在静脉通路不等于已完成低血压患者液体复苏
rules.rule_en: Established IV access does not mean fluid resuscitation for hypotension is completed
rules.scenario: 疑似食管穿孔合并低血压心动过速的急诊处理
rules.scenario_en: Emergency management of suspected esophageal perforation with hypotension and tachycardia
rules.checkpoint: 是否已启动低血压患者的液体复苏？
rules.checkpoint_en: Has fluid resuscitation for hypotension been initiated?
rules.error_behavior: 错误认为已建立静脉通路即等于液体复苏完成
rules.correct_reasoning: 仅存在静脉通路不代表已启动液体复苏，低血压时需立即补液

rules.rule: 离心收缩比向心收缩更有效增强肌肉力量
rules.rule_en: Eccentric contraction is more effective for muscle strengthening than concentric
rules.scenario: 判断抗阻运动哪个阶段最能增强肌肉力量时
rules.scenario_en: When judging which phase of resistance exercise builds most muscle strength
rules.checkpoint: 哪种收缩增肌增力效果更好？
rules.checkpoint_en: Which contraction gives better strength gain?
rules.error_behavior: 错误认为向心收缩比离心收缩增力效果更好
rules.correct_reasoning: 离心收缩产生更大张力，增力效果优于向心收缩

rules.rule: 区分骨整体强度与骨水泥界面强度
rules.rule_en: Distinguish bulk bone strength from bone-cement interface strength
rules.scenario: 评估骨质减少对骨水泥界面力学强度影响时
rules.scenario_en: When evaluating the effect of osteopenia on bone-cement interface mechanical strength
rules.checkpoint: 是否区分骨整体与界面强度？
rules.checkpoint_en: Did you distinguish bulk bone from interface strength?
rules.error_behavior: 混淆了骨质减少骨整体强度与骨水泥界面强度
rules.correct_reasoning: 先区分骨整体和界面强度，骨质减少骨孔隙增加，水泥嵌入更好，界面强度提升

rules.rule: 东南亚肝癌患者，勿漏曲霉产黄曲霉毒素致癌
rules.rule_en: For HCC patients from Southeast Asia, don't miss aflatoxin carcinogenesis from Aspergillus
rules.scenario: 判断乙肝阴性的东南亚来源肝细胞癌致病病原体时
rules.scenario_en: When identifying pathogen of HCC in HBsAg negative patient from Southeast Asia
rules.checkpoint: 是否考虑曲霉黄曲霉毒素致癌？
rules.checkpoint_en: Has aflatoxin carcinogenesis from Aspergillus been considered?
rules.error_behavior: 仅考虑曲霉侵袭性感染，漏了黄曲霉毒素致癌，错误排除正确选项
rules.correct_reasoning: 先识别患者为HCC，东南亚来源需考虑黄曲霉暴露，黄曲霉由黄曲霉产生，对应选项A

rules.rule: 优先依据题干给定影像信息而非额外知识
rules.rule_en: Prioritize given imaging findings over outside knowledge
rules.scenario: 医学影像考试鉴别附睾病变
rules.scenario_en: Differentiating epididymal lesions in imaging exam
rules.checkpoint: 是否依据题干给定影像信息作答？
rules.checkpoint_en: Do you answer based on given findings?
rules.error_behavior: 错误运用额外知识，认为两者都无内部血流排除正确选项
rules.correct_reasoning: 只依据题干给定影像信息，题干未提囊肿无血流，故B正确

rules.rule: 排除眼眶压迫性视神经病变先查视神经位置
rules.rule_en: Rule out orbital compressive neuropathy by first checking optic nerve position
rules.scenario: 评估冠状位眼眶MRI排除眼眶肿块压迫性视神经病变时
rules.scenario_en: When evaluating coronal orbital MRI to rule out compressive optic neuropathy caused by orbital mass
rules.checkpoint: 视神经位置是否正常无移位？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is the optic nerve normally positioned without displacement?
rules.error_behavior: 混淆内在与外在压迫病变，误选E而非正确答案A
rules.correct_reasoning: 眼眶肿块致压迫性视神经病变是外源性占位推挤移位视神经，视神经无移位即可排除；周围结构无增大畸变不能排除小肿块

rules.rule: In pelvic fracture trauma, prioritize blood loss over 6h dehydration for AKI
rules.rule_en: In pelvic fracture trauma, prioritize blood loss over 6h dehydration for AKI
rules.scenario: Evaluating elevated creatinine in trauma with pelvic fracture and delayed rescue
rules.scenario_en: Evaluating elevated creatinine in trauma with pelvic fracture and delayed rescue
rules.checkpoint: Is blood loss the cause of elevated creatinine here?
rules.checkpoint_en: Is blood loss the cause of elevated creatinine here?
rules.error_behavior: Incorrectly prioritized 6h immobilization dehydration over blood loss
rules.correct_reasoning: Pelvic fracture/lacerations commonly cause acute blood loss; 6h dehydration is insufficient to raise creatinine, so blood loss is the cause

rules.rule: 术中非移位股骨距骨折先取部分插入柄再固定
rules.rule_en: Remove partially inserted stem before fixing nondisplaced calcar fracture
rules.scenario: 无骨水泥股骨柄插入术中发现非移位股骨距骨折
rules.scenario_en: Nondisplaced femoral calcar fracture during cementless femoral stem insertion
rules.checkpoint: 是否需先取出部分插入的股骨柄？
rules.checkpoint_en: Should partially inserted stem be removed first?
rules.error_behavior: 错误认为可继续插入股骨柄原位固定，无需取出部分插入柄
rules.correct_reasoning: 部分插入柄对骨折有撑开力，需取出后固定重插，原位无法可靠固定

rules.rule: 冠脉造影判断LAD狭窄需全程追踪，勿漏远端
rules.rule_en: Trace entire LAD in coronary angiography to avoid missing distal stenosis
rules.scenario: 判断左前降支是否存在显著狭窄的冠脉造影阅片
rules.scenario_en: Reading coronary angiography to check LAD significant stenosis
rules.checkpoint: 是否追踪了左前降支全程包括远端？
rules.checkpoint_en: Have you traced entire LAD including distal part?
rules.error_behavior: 漏看左前降支近心尖区的显著狭窄，误判为无狭窄
rules.correct_reasoning: 全程追踪左前降支，发现近心尖区显著狭窄，判断存在狭窄

rules.rule: 年轻无肝硬化患者肝占位不能排除肝腺瘤
rules.rule_en: Do not rule out hepatic adenoma in young non-cirrhotic patients with hepatic mass
rules.scenario: 年轻无肝硬化患者肝脏MRI发现偶发肝占位的鉴别诊断
rules.scenario_en: Differential diagnosis of incidental hepatic mass on liver MRI in young non-cirrhotic patients
rules.checkpoint: 是否考虑了肝腺瘤的可能性？
rules.checkpoint_en: Have you considered the possibility of hepatic adenoma?
rules.error_behavior: 过度概括肝腺瘤典型影像特征，错误排除肝腺瘤，无肝硬化仍诊断肝细胞癌
rules.correct_reasoning: 肝腺瘤影像表现多样，大腺瘤可出现中央纤维化钙化，不能因不满足典型表现就排除年轻无肝硬化患者的肝腺瘤诊断

rules.rule: 右肺容积损失会导致同侧膈肌位置升高
rules.rule_en: Right lung volume loss causes elevation of ipsilateral hemidiaphragm
rules.scenario: 胸部X线见右肺内纹理增多、左膈位置低下时
rules.scenario_en: When chest radiograph shows increased right medial markings and low left hemidiaphragm
rules.checkpoint: 右肺容积损失是否升高同侧膈肌？
rules.checkpoint_en: Does right lung volume loss elevate ipsilateral hemidiaphragm?
rules.error_behavior: 错误将左膈低下归因于右肺不张代偿，忽略同侧膈肌升高规律
rules.correct_reasoning: 右肺不张致右容积损失，会升高同侧右膈肌，不符合；右肺下叶实变符合所有表现

rules.rule: 颈椎前横突同侧压痛点：屈颈，对侧弯，对旋转
rules.rule_en: For ipsilateral anterior cervical transverse process tender point: flexion, contralateral sidebending and contralateral rotation
rules.scenario: 确定整骨反牵治疗颈椎前横突压痛点体位时
rules.scenario_en: When determining the counterstrain position for anterior cervical transverse process tender point
rules.checkpoint: 颈椎前横突同侧压痛点旋转方向是哪侧？
rules.checkpoint_en: Which side is the rotation direction for ipsilateral anterior cervical transverse process tender point?
rules.error_behavior: 错误将同侧压痛点的旋转方向判定为同侧，选错体位
rules.correct_reasoning: 颈椎前横突同侧压痛点，正确体位为屈颈、对侧弯、对旋转，对应选项G

rules.rule: 题干提示双侧附睾差异时，诊断需解释该差异
rules.rule_en: When question notes bilateral epididymal differences, diagnosis must explain them
rules.scenario: 分析阴囊超声考题，题干提示双侧附睾存在差异时
rules.scenario_en: When analyzing scrotal ultrasound exam questions with stated bilateral epididymal differences
rules.checkpoint: 诊断是否解释了题干所述的差异？
rules.checkpoint_en: Does diagnosis explain the differences stated in question?
rules.error_behavior: 模型仅关注图像标注的鞘膜积液，忽略题干提示的双侧差异，所选诊断无法解释差异。
rules.correct_reasoning: 首先明确诊断需要解释题干所述双侧附睾差异，结合图像右侧鞘膜积液，符合右侧急性附睾炎伴反应性鞘膜积液。

rules.rule: 1型RTA伴低钾酸中毒肌无力，先予静脉碳酸氢钠
rules.rule_en: For type 1 RTA with hypokalemic acidosis and weakness, give IV sodium bicarbonate first
rules.scenario: 临床处理1型远端肾小管酸中毒合并低钾、酸中毒伴肌无力时
rules.scenario_en: When clinically managing type 1 distal renal tubular acidosis with hypokalemia, acidosis and muscle weakness
rules.checkpoint: 本例下一步是否首选静脉碳酸氢钠？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is intravenous sodium bicarbonate the first choice here?
rules.error_behavior: 错误认为1型RTA伴低钾酸中毒首选口服枸橼酸钠，误认枸橼酸钠可纠正低钾
rules.correct_reasoning: 本例1型RTA伴中度低钾、肌无力、代谢性酸中毒，枸橼酸钠会加重低钾，应先予静脉碳酸氢钠纠正

rules.rule: HIV OI treated with folate antagonists requires adding folinic acid
rules.rule_en: When treating HIV opportunistic infections with folate antagonists, add folinic acid
rules.scenario: HIV患者CD4+<200cells/mm³，用叶酸拮抗剂治OI时
rules.scenario_en: HIV patients with CD4+ <200 cells/mm³ receiving folate antagonist therapy for OIs
rules.checkpoint: 此方案是否需要加用亚叶酸？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is folinic acid required for this regimen?
rules.error_behavior: 只考虑PJP预防选TMP-SMX，漏了需加亚叶酸
rules.correct_reasoning: 疑似弓形虫病需用乙胺嘧啶（叶酸拮抗剂），必须加亚叶酸防骨髓抑制

rules.rule: 发现舌乳头萎缩伴裂纹，需排查乳糜泻
rules.rule_en: When papillary atrophy with fissured tongue found, rule out celiac disease
rules.scenario: 口腔舌象诊断，鉴别甲减和乳糜泻时
rules.scenario_en: Oral tongue diagnosis, differentiating hypothyroidism and celiac disease
rules.checkpoint: 是否存在舌乳头萎缩表现？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is there papillary atrophy of the tongue?
rules.error_behavior: 忽略已观察到的舌乳头萎缩，错判为甲减排除乳糜泻
rules.correct_reasoning: 甲减典型表现为巨舌伴齿痕无萎缩；乳糜泻可出现舌乳头萎缩伴裂纹，需结合诊断

rules.rule: 解读卵巢超声囊肿必须先检查内部特征
rules.rule_en: Check internal features first when diagnosing ovarian cyst on ultrasound
rules.scenario: 解读妇科超声下卵巢囊肿的影像表现时
rules.scenario_en: When interpreting ovarian cyst findings on gynecologic ultrasound
rules.checkpoint: 是否观察到卵巢囊肿所有内部特征？
rules.checkpoint_en: Have all internal features of the cyst been observed?
rules.error_behavior: 模型漏看囊肿内部特征，误将出血性囊肿判为单纯囊肿
rules.correct_reasoning: 先确认囊肿内部回声特征，该囊肿符合出血性囊肿特征，排除单纯囊肿

rules.rule: 胎儿血红蛋白升高是DBA的重要特征
rules.rule_en: Elevated fetal hemoglobin is a key feature of DBA
rules.scenario: 判断钻石-布莱克凡贫血的特征时适用
rules.scenario_en: Applicable when judging characteristics of Diamond-Blackfan anemia
rules.checkpoint: DBA是否存在胎儿血红蛋白升高？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is fetal hemoglobin elevated in DBA?
rules.error_behavior: 错误否认DBA存在胎儿血红蛋白升高，误选病因选项
rules.correct_reasoning: 题干符合DBA表现，胎儿血红蛋白升高是DBA特征，C正确

rules.rule: STIR序列中脂肪被抑制，呈低信号而非高信号
rules.rule_en: On STIR sequence, fat is suppressed and shows low signal
rules.scenario: 判断STIR序列盆腔MRI中卵巢畸胎瘤成分时
rules.scenario_en: When judging ovarian dermoid composition on STIR pelvic MRI

rules.scenario: 根据癫痫患者的临床和MRI表现选择诊断时
rules.scenario_en: When selecting diagnosis based on clinical and MRI findings for a seizure patient
rules.checkpoint: 诊断是否包含所有描述的影像学表现？
rules.checkpoint_en: Does the diagnosis include all described imaging findings?
rules.error_behavior: 模型错误选择D，称其包含所有发现，但D遗漏了乳头体萎缩和穹窿体积损失
rules.correct_reasoning: C正确包含了丘脑前部脑软化和边缘系统跨突触变性，D遗漏了这些下游变性改变

rules.rule: 验证分子作用逻辑与临床表现一致
rules.rule_en: Verify consistency between molecular action and clinical manifestations
rules.scenario: 分析慢性肾衰肾性骨病致病蛋白的考题情境
rules.scenario_en: Question scenario analyzing CKD-MBD pathogenic proteins
rules.checkpoint: 分子作用逻辑符合临床表现吗？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is molecular logic consistent with presentation?
rules.error_behavior: 错误认为Klotho减少会致活性维生素D降低，逻辑矛盾
rules.correct_reasoning: BMP7由肾小管分泌，促进1-α羟化酶，其减少符合低VitD、高PTH表现

rules.rule: 宫颈癌分期读片需区分动态增强不同时相
rules.rule_en: Distinguish different contrast phases for cervical cancer staging
rules.scenario: 宫颈癌MRI分期读片判断选项对错时
rules.scenario_en: When judging options in cervical cancer MRI staging
rules.checkpoint: 是否区分了动态增强不同时相？
rules.checkpoint_en: Are different dynamic contrast phases distinguished?
rules.error_behavior: 用早期动态增强否定延迟期无增强描述，误选不存在的直肠侵犯
rules.correct_reasoning: 区分增强早晚期相，无明确证据不诊断邻近器官侵犯

rules.rule: 区分解剖位置的绝对表述和相对表述
rules.rule_en: Distinguish absolute vs relative anatomical position
rules.scenario: 评估缩乳术后乳腺实质相对于乳头的位置时
rules.scenario_en: Evaluating parenchymal position relative to nipple after reduction mammoplasty
rules.checkpoint: 位置是绝对还是相对乳头的？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is position absolute or relative to nipple?
rules.error_behavior: 混淆胸壁绝对位置和相对于复位后乳头的相对位置
rules.correct_reasoning: 缩乳术中乳头被向上移位，题目问实质相对于乳头的位置，因此残留实质相对于新乳头位置更低。

rules.rule: Cortical defect with periosteal reaction: don't rule out acute osteomyelitis without sequestrum
rules.rule_en: Cortical defect with periosteal reaction: do not rule out acute osteomyelitis without sequestrum
rules.scenario: Evaluating cortical defect, periosteal reaction and marrow changes on tibial MRI
rules.scenario_en: Evaluating cortical defect, periosteal reaction and marrow changes on tibial MRI
rules.checkpoint: Does acute osteomyelitis fit the findings?
rules.checkpoint_en: Does acute osteomyelitis fit the findings?
rules.error_behavior: Incorrectly ruled out osteomyelitis requiring late features like sequestrum, misdiagnosed as stress fracture
rules.correct_reasoning: Acute osteomyelitis can present with the described findings without late-stage features like sequestrum or abscess, must rule it out before diagnosing stress fracture

rules.rule: 判断左房充盈缺损先确认肺静脉解剖是否正常
rules.rule_en: Confirm pulmonary vein anatomy before diagnosing left atrial filling defect
rules.scenario: CT血管造影发现左房充盈缺损待查时
rules.scenario_en: When CT angiography shows a left atrial filling defect
rules.checkpoint: 肺静脉解剖结构是否正常？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is the pulmonary vein anatomy normal?
rules.error_behavior: 误判左肺静脉连接异常，错诊为先天性异常
rules.correct_reasoning: 先确认肺静脉存在连接正常，再诊断肺静脉狭窄

rules.rule: 骶骨扭转诊断遵循正确标志解读和力学规则
rules.rule_en: Diagnose sacral torsion per correct landmark and mechanics rules
rules.scenario: osteopathic结构性检查诊断骶骨功能障碍
rules.scenario_en: Diagnosing sacral dysfunction via osteopathic structural examination
rules.checkpoint: 是否正确解读骶骨标志和力学关系？
rules.checkpoint_en: Are sacral landmarks and mechanics correctly interpreted?
rules.error_behavior: 错误解读骶骨沟位置、L5旋转方向，违背力学规则
rules.correct_reasoning: 正确解读标志位置，L5与骶骨反向旋转，前屈位可推动向前

rules.rule: ECG见提早宽QRS，先排除房性异位灶再考虑旁路
rules.rule_en: For premature wide QRS on ECG, rule out atrial ectopic foci first
rules.scenario: 心电图鉴别提早出现的宽QRS波病因时
rules.scenario_en: Differentiating etiology of premature wide QRS on ECG
rules.checkpoint: 是否先排除了房性异位灶病因？
rules.checkpoint_en: Has atrial ectopic foci been ruled out first?
rules.error_behavior: 错将提早宽QRS认作旁路预激，误选旁路传导
rules.correct_reasoning: 提早宽QRS无delta波，应为房性异位灶致房早伴差传

rules.rule: 脓毒症休克补液后仍少尿，需考虑ATN而非仅肾前性AKI
rules.rule_en: Oliguric septic shock after fluid resuscitation should consider ATN
rules.scenario: 脓毒性休克补液后仍少尿，鉴别肾前性AKI和ATN
rules.scenario_en: Differentiating prerenal AKI and ATN in oliguric septic shock after fluid resuscitation
rules.checkpoint: 该AKI是ATN还是肾前性？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is AKI ATN or prerenal here?
rules.error_behavior: 错误认为短时间少尿就是单纯肾前性AKI，忽略脓毒症早期即可致ATN
rules.correct_reasoning: 脓毒性休克可早期致ATN，补液后仍少尿提示ATN，选对应实验室结果

rules.rule: 肺造影肺动脉扩张勿误判为肺动静脉畸形
rules.rule_en: Don't misdiagnose pulmonary artery dilatation on angiography as PAVM
keywords: 慢性血栓栓塞性肺动脉高压
rules.scenario: 解读肺血管造影，鉴别肺血管病变时
rules.scenario_en: When interpreting pulmonary angiography and differentiating pulmonary vascular lesions
rules.checkpoint: 是否误将肺动脉扩张认作AVM病灶
rules.checkpoint_en: Is pulmonary artery dilatation misrecognized as AVM nidus
rules.error_behavior: 误将CTEPH的扩张肺动脉当成AVM畸形巢
rules.correct_reasoning: 诊断AVM需确认引流静脉，CTEPH可表现为近端肺动脉扩张

rules.rule: 按颗粒形态辨认外周血涂片的免疫细胞类型
rules.rule_en: Identify immune cells by granule morphology on blood smear
rules.scenario: 辨认外周血涂片免疫细胞类型及分泌物质时
rules.scenario_en: When identifying immune cell type and its secretion on blood smear
rules.checkpoint: 是否按颗粒形态正确辨认细胞？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is cell correctly identified by granule morphology?
rules.error_behavior: 错将嗜碱性粒细胞认作中性粒细胞，误选髓过氧化物酶
rules.correct_reasoning: 根据粗嗜碱性颗粒识别为嗜碱性粒细胞，其分泌白三烯D4

rules.rule: 颈部残留碘摄取不代表所有骨转移都是碘亲和的
rules.rule_en: Residual neck iodine uptake does not mean all bone metastases are iodine-avid
rules.scenario: 解读甲状腺癌术后碘131全身转移显像时
rules.scenario_en: Interpreting post-thyroidectomy I-131 whole-body metastasis scan of thyroid cancer
rules.checkpoint: 所有骨转移灶都有碘亲和性吗？
rules.checkpoint_en: Are all bone metastases iodine-avid?
rules.error_behavior: 错误认为所有可见骨转移灶都具有碘亲和性
rules.correct_reasoning: 去分化甲状腺癌颈部残留可摄碘，转移灶低碘摄取高FDG摄取

rules.rule: 遗传性球形红细胞增多症最常见突变是移码突变
rules.rule_en: The most common mutation in hereditary spherocytosis is frameshift
keywords: 遗传性球形红细胞增多症
rules.scenario: 分析遗传性球形红细胞增多症的突变特征题目
rules.scenario_en: Characterizing mutation type of hereditary spherocytosis
rules.checkpoint: 最常见突变是不是移码突变？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is the most common mutation frameshift?
rules.error_behavior: 错误认为遗传性球形红细胞增多症很少见移码突变，排除正确选项
rules.correct_reasoning: 遗传性球形红细胞增多症最常见的ANK1基因突变多为移码突变，B为正确选项

rules.rule: 肝超均匀高回声边界清肿块先考虑海绵状血管瘤
rules.rule_en: Homogeneous hyperechoic well-demarcated liver mass on ultrasound, first consider cavernous hemangioma
rules.scenario: 妊娠期发现肝均匀高回声肿块，产后增大需诊断
rules.scenario_en: Pregnant woman found liver homogeneous hyperechoic mass that increased postpartum requiring diagnosis
rules.checkpoint: 该肝肿块的典型超声表现是什么？
rules.checkpoint_en: What is the typical ultrasound appearance of the mass?
rules.error_behavior: 记错两种病变的典型超声特征，错误排除海绵状血管瘤
rules.correct_reasoning: 均匀高回声边界清是海绵状血管瘤典型表现，肝腺瘤多不均质，海绵状血管瘤可随雌激素妊娠增大，故优先考虑

rules.rule: 经典药物诱导AIN，先停药无需先检查确认
rules.rule_en: For classic drug-induced AIN, stop offending drug first before testing
keywords: 药物诱导急性间质性肾炎
rules.scenario: 使用β内酰胺类抗生素后出现疑似AIN
rules.scenario_en: Suspected drug-induced AIN after beta-lactam antibiotic use
rules.checkpoint: 是否为经典药物诱导AIN临床表现？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is this classic drug-induced AIN presentation?
rules.error_behavior: 错误优先选择尿嗜酸性粒细胞检查而非立即停药
rules.correct_reasoning: 经典表现的药物诱导AIN，应立即停用可疑致病药物，无需先检查

rules.rule: 血红蛋白电泳见HbA+HbS提示镰状细胞性状而非HbSS
rules.rule_en: In hemoglobin electrophoresis, HbA+HbS suggests sickle cell trait not HbSS
rules.scenario: 解读新生儿血红蛋白病筛查电泳结果时
rules.scenario_en: Interpreting electrophoresis results of newborn hemoglobinopathy screening
rules.checkpoint: 电泳是否同时存在HbA和HbS?
rules.checkpoint_en: Are both HbA and HbS present in electrophoresis?
rules.error_behavior: 将同时存在HbA和HbS误判为纯合子HbSS镰状细胞贫血
rules.correct_reasoning: 纯合子HbSS无HbA条带，同时存在HbA和HbS提示镰状细胞性状，常见并发症为血尿

rules.rule: Dislodged ET tube must be corrected first before adjusting ventilation
rules.rule_en: Dislodged endotracheal tube must be corrected before adjusting ventilation
rules.scenario: Ventilated patient with refractory hypoxemia and known dislodged ET tube
rules.scenario_en: Mechanically ventilated patient with refractory hypoxemia and known dislodged endotracheal tube
rules.checkpoint: Is the endotracheal tube dislodged?
rules.checkpoint_en: Is the endotracheal tube dislodged?
rules.error_behavior: Ignored known dislodged ET tube, assumed normal PaCO₂ ruled out clinical significance, chose increasing PEEP
rules.correct_reasoning: Address known dislodged ET tube urgently first before adjusting other ventilator parameters

rules.rule: 非增强CT后颅窝卒中：无高密度灶勿推断出血转化
rules.rule_en: Non-contrast CT posterior fossa stroke: no hyperdensity, no hemorrhage inference
rules.scenario: 分析后颅窝卒中非增强CT影像，判断并发症时
rules.scenario_en: When analyzing non-contrast CT of posterior fossa stroke for complications
rules.checkpoint: CT是否可见出血相关高密度灶？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is there hemorrhage-related hyperdense foci on CT?
rules.error_behavior: 无CT高密度证据，错误推断PICA梗死伴出血性转化，漏诊关键征象
rules.correct_reasoning: 先排查CT关键征象，无高密度不能诊断出血转化，需识别致密基底动脉征

rules.rule: 急性眼痛伴角膜浸润前房积脓，需排查白内障术后眼内炎
rules.rule_en: For acute eye pain with corneal infiltration and hypopyon, rule out post-cataract endophthalmitis
rules.scenario: 急性起病眼痛伴视力下降，检查见角膜浸润、前房积脓
rules.scenario_en: Acute onset eye pain with vision loss, corneal infiltration and hypopyon on exam
rules.checkpoint: 是否排查了白内障术后眼内炎？
rules.checkpoint_en: Has post-cataract endophthalmitis been ruled out?
rules.error_behavior: 误诊为激素相关细菌性角膜溃疡，排除了白内障手术史
rules.correct_reasoning: 该表现符合感染性眼内炎，最常见危险因素是白内障手术史

rules.rule: 不要仅因选项不含题干关键词就提前排除
rules.rule_en: Do not exclude options just for lacking question stem keywords
rules.scenario: 多选题中根据影像临床特点选最佳诊断时
rules.scenario_en: When selecting best diagnosis from multiple-choice options
rules.checkpoint: 是否因缺题干关键词提前排除选项？
rules.checkpoint_en: Did you exclude options for lacking keywords?
rules.error_behavior: 错误要求选项必须含题干提及的关键词，提前排除正确选项
rules.correct_reasoning: 应判断疾病能否解释所有发现，布罗迪脓肿合并钙化性关节炎可解释羟基磷灰石沉积表现

rules.rule: 根据增强状态区分垂体微腺瘤和中间部囊肿
rules.rule_en: Differentiate microadenoma from pars intermedia cyst by enhancement status
rules.scenario: 在动态增强MRI上鉴别垂体微腺瘤和中间部囊肿时
rules.scenario_en: When differentiating pituitary microadenoma from pars intermedia cyst on dynamic contrast MRI
rules.checkpoint: 该病灶是否存在对比增强？
rules.checkpoint_en: Does the lesion have contrast enhancement?
rules.error_behavior: 错误将相对于正常垂体的延迟增强，解读为相对囊肿的延迟增强，选错答案
rules.correct_reasoning: 微腺瘤是实性组织，注药后会快速增强；中间部囊肿是囊性结构，全程无增强，选项A的比较无意义

rules.rule: 区分子宫肌瘤变性，红色变性有T1压脂高信号和T2周边高环
rules.rule_en: When distinguishing uterine fibroid degeneration, red degeneration has T1 fat-sat hyperintensity and T2 peripheral high rim
rules.scenario: MRI鉴别子宫肌瘤红色变性与透明变性时
rules.scenario_en: When differentiating red degeneration from hyaline degeneration of uterine fibroid on MRI
rules.checkpoint: 红色变性是否存在T2高信号周边环？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is there a T2 high-intensity peripheral rim in red degeneration?
rules.error_behavior: 错误认为T2低信号是鉴别特征，漏诊T2高信号周边环
rules.correct_reasoning: 两者均可表现为T2低信号，红色变性特征是T1压脂高信号伴T2周边高环

rules.rule: 膝关节外侧MRI需逐一确认各结构有无损伤
rules.rule_en: Check each structure one by one for injury on lateral knee MRI
rules.scenario: 读膝关节外侧结构MRI判断韧带肌腱损伤
rules.scenario_en: Reading lateral knee MRI to diagnose ligament and tendon injury
rules.checkpoint: 是否逐一确认了每个结构的状态？
rules.checkpoint_en: Has each structure's status been checked one by one?
rules.error_behavior: 误判正常腘肌腱为撕裂，错误选择D选项
rules.correct_reasoning: 确认各结构：腓侧副韧带部分撕裂，联合腱完好，腘肌腱无异常，选B

rules.rule: 检查黄色眼部病变位置，区分睑裂斑和眶脂肪脱垂
rules.rule_en: Check lesion location to distinguish pinguecula and orbital fat prolapse
rules.scenario: 鉴别球结膜黄色隆起性病变时适用
rules.scenario_en: When differentiating yellow elevated bulbar conjunctival lesions
rules.checkpoint: 是否正确判断了病变位置？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is the lesion location correctly judged?
rules.error_behavior: 错误描述病变位置，误认为眶脂肪脱垂仅见于下睑，误诊为睑裂斑
rules.correct_reasoning: 先确认病变位置，眶脂肪可脱垂至球结膜下，病变不在角膜旁需排除本病

rules.rule: 胫骨骨折畸形判断先明确位置，再分析受力
rules.rule_en: Confirm location before analyzing tibial fracture deformity
rules.scenario: 胫骨骨折髓内钉治疗前判断常见畸形时
rules.scenario_en: Judging common deformity of tibial fracture before intramedullary nailing
rules.checkpoint: 是否明确胫骨骨折的具体位置？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is the exact tibial fracture location confirmed?
rules.error_behavior: 错将胫骨近端骨折判定为中段，错误分析肌肉拉力误判畸形
rules.correct_reasoning: 先明确骨折为胫骨近端1/3骨折，结合正确解剖肌肉知识分析，得出常见畸形为顶点向前合并外翻

rules.rule: CT示精囊密度增高，应考虑急性前列腺炎累及
rules.rule_en: Increased seminal vesicle attenuation on CT indicates acute prostatitis involvement
rules.scenario: 盆腔CT发现单侧精囊密度增高，进行病因诊断时
rules.scenario_en: When pelvic CT shows unilateral increased seminal vesicle attenuation for etiological diagnosis
rules.checkpoint: 是否符合急性前列腺炎累及表现？
rules.checkpoint_en: Does it fit acute prostatitis involvement?
rules.error_behavior: 错误认为急性前列腺炎累及精囊呈低密度，误选创伤性出血
rules.correct_reasoning: 精囊是含液空腔结构，急性感染致脓性渗出使密度增高，CT精囊密度增高符合急性前列腺炎累及

rules.rule: After ampullary stone passage, check for pancreatic necrosis
rules.rule_en: After ampullary stone passage, check for pancreatic necrosis
rules.scenario: 解读急性胆源性胰腺炎CT，壶腹结石已排出时
rules.scenario_en: Interpreting CT of acute gallstone pancreatitis after ampullary stone passage
rules.checkpoint: 是否存在胰腺坏死和灌注缺失？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is there pancreatic necrosis and perfusion loss?
rules.error_behavior: 错误否认存在坏死、假性囊肿和灌注缺失，误选D
rules.correct_reasoning: 壶腹结石排出后仍可存在胰腺坏死、假性囊肿，应选B

rules.rule: Asymmetric DIP arthritis with osteophytes favors psoriatic over erosive OA
rules.rule_en: Asymmetric DIP arthritis with osteophytes favors psoriatic over erosive OA
rules.scenario: Diagnosing asymmetric DIP arthritis with irregular margins and osteophytes
rules.scenario_en: Diagnosing asymmetric DIP arthritis with irregular margins and osteophytes
rules.checkpoint: Is the arthritis symmetric or asymmetric?
rules.checkpoint_en: Is the arthritis symmetric or asymmetric?
rules.error_behavior: Model incorrectly chose erosive osteoarthritis, wrongly claiming it is asymmetric.
rules.correct_reasoning: Erosive osteoarthritis is classically symmetric. Psoriatic arthritis is characteristically asymmetric, often affects DIP joints, can present with irregular margins and osteophytes, matching findings better.

rules.rule: 内脏反位可使心脏瓣膜移位改变杂音位置
rules.rule_en: Situs inversus can shift heart valves and change murmur location
rules.scenario: 儿童反复呼吸道感染伴支气管扩张、先天性心脏病
rules.scenario_en: Children with recurrent respiratory infections, bronchiectasis and congenital heart disease
rules.checkpoint: 患者是否存在内脏反位？
rules.checkpoint_en: Does the patient have situs inversus?
rules.error_behavior: 错误排除A选项，误诊为囊性纤维化，忽略内脏反位
rules.correct_reasoning: 患者符合Kartagener综合征，内脏反位使杂音移位到右胸骨旁

rules.rule: CT仅显示单一层面出血，不能断定无其他颅内病灶
rules.rule_en: When CT only shows single slice hemorrhage, cannot confirm no other lesions
rules.scenario: CT鉴别颅内出血，仅提供单个层面影像时
rules.scenario_en: When differentiating intracranial hemorrhage on CT with only single slice provided
rules.checkpoint: 该层面外是否存在未显示病灶？
rules.checkpoint_en: Are there unshown lesions outside this slice?
rules.error_behavior: 仅见中脑单一层CT，错误断定该出血为孤立无其他病灶
rules.correct_reasoning: 单一层CT未显示其他脑区，不能确定无其他病灶，需基于可见明确征象鉴别，第一例出血前部钙化第二例无，选A

rules.rule: 分析踝关节损伤需结合正确投照体位平片
rules.rule_en: Analysis of ankle injury requires radiographs with correct projection
rules.scenario: 阅片判断踝关节Lauge-Hansen损伤分型时
rules.scenario_en: When classifying ankle injury via Lauge-Hansen system on radiographs

rules.correct_reasoning: Tenderness precisely localized to the transverse process medial to the inferior scapular angle is a posterior tender point. The inferior angle of the scapula aligns with T7 spinous process, so the transverse process just medial to it is T8 posterior tender point. Rhomboid major spasm causes tenderness over the muscle belly, not isolated to a single transverse process.

rules.scenario_en: When diagnosing lesion type on knee MRI

rules.rule: 类比病理改变需匹配整体特征，勿只取单一特征

rules.scenario_en: When analogizing pathological findings to another disease in pathology questions
rules.checkpoint: 是否匹配了全部病变特征？

rules.correct_reasoning: 整合所有大体镜下病变特征，再找匹配整体特征的病变

rules.rule: 解读'纯母乳喂养至今'，应理解为近期已停止纯母乳喂养

rules.checkpoint_en: Does 'exclusively breastfed until now' mean breastfeeding ended recently?
rules.error_behavior: 错误将表述解读为持续纯母乳喂养，错误排除醛缩酶B缺乏
rules.correct_reasoning: 该表述指此前纯母乳喂养现已停止，婴儿可能已接触果糖

rules.rule: 震颤为主早期帕金森病，认知正常可首选抗胆碱能药

rules.error_behavior: 错误排除抗胆碱能药物，误选钠通道拮抗剂
rules.correct_reasoning: 本例为震颤为主早期帕金森病，认知正常，抗胆碱能为合适一线用药

rules.rule: 儿童跛行伴骨反应水肿，先排除骨样骨瘤再诊感染
rules.rule_en: For child limp with reactive bone edema, rule out osteoid osteoma first

rules.correct_reasoning: 儿童跛行伴骨水肿先考虑骨样骨瘤，首选射频消融治疗

rules.rule: 翼状肩胛不是FBN1相关马凡综合征的诊断标准
rules.rule_en: Winging scapula is not a diagnostic criterion for FBN1-related Marfan syndrome

rules.correct_reasoning: 翼状肩胛不是马凡综合征的公认诊断标准，需依据公认标准关联FBN1突变表现。

rules.rule: Differentiate NMOSD vs CPM by lesion distribution and symmetry on MRI
rules.rule_en: Differentiate NMOSD from CPM by lesion distribution and symmetry on MRI

rules.scenario_en: Differentiating NMOSD and CPM on brain MRI with multifocal white matter lesions

rules.checkpoint_en: Do lesions fit NMOSD distribution or CPM symmetry?
rules.error_behavior: Incorrectly ruled out NMOSD, misdiagnosed as CPM by misinterpreting lesion distribution
rules.correct_reasoning: NMOSD has multifocal disseminated supratentorial/infratentorial white matter lesions. CPM has symmetric pontine/deep gray involvement, not discrete disseminated lesions.

rules.rule: 成人硬脊膜囊终止点为S1/S2，而非S2/S3
rules.rule_en: The terminal point of adult thecal sac is S1/S2, not S2/S3

rules.correct_reasoning: 成人硬脊膜囊终点位于S1/S2水平，应选S1/S2

rules.rule: 颅内单发环形强化病灶需结合随访排除不典型淋巴瘤

rules.rule: 多发双侧薄壁空洞先考虑血源性细菌性肺脓肿

rules.correct_reasoning: 血源性细菌性肺脓肿典型表现是多发双侧薄壁空洞，符合该表现，应首先考虑

rules.rule: 胸痛疑似ACS，需复查心电图再确定下一步干预

rules.rule: 去过疟疾流行区，初筛涂片阴性应重复检查

rules.error_behavior: 错误认为重复涂片阳性率低，临床表现不支持疟疾，误将发病1天症状加重归为登革热危象期
rules.correct_reasoning: 疟疾早期原虫密度低，初筛涂片可假阴性，高疑患者应12-24小时重复涂片，发病1天不会进入登革热危象期

rules.rule: 冻伤伴肢体水疱需排查低钙血症

rules.error_behavior: 错误排除低钙血症，误将奥斯本波归为心肌坏死，错选肌钙蛋白升高
rules.correct_reasoning: 严重冻伤致钙在受损组织隔离，引发真性低钙血症，奥斯本波仅提示低体温而非心肌坏死

rules.rule: 脊柱转移瘤不一律禁OMT，仅禁高力高冲击技术

rules.correct_reasoning: 仅高力高冲击OMT禁用，温和软组织OMT可用，选合适温和技术

rules.rule: 病理见分叶状嗜碱性团块需排查金葡菌落

rules.correct_reasoning: 非典型分枝杆菌HE下不形成大嗜碱性团块，慢性金葡感染也可表现为慢性溃疡窦道，分叶状嗜碱性团块符合金葡菌落

rules.rule: 充分切除膀胱固有肌层需同时见肌纤维弹性纤维筋膜周脂肪

rules.scenario_en: When evaluating adequacy of muscularis propria resection after transurethral bladder cancer resection via CLE
rules.checkpoint: 切除床是否同时存在肌纤维弹性纤维脂肪？
rules.checkpoint_en: Does resection bed have muscle, elastin, and fat?

rules.correct_reasoning: 充分切除贯穿全层，可见切断的肌纤维+弹性纤维+筋膜周脂肪，三者同存才提示充分

rules.rule: 阅肾动脉造影需仔细检查识别肾动脉是否闭塞

rules.correct_reasoning: 全程观察肾动脉，确认有无造影剂充盈中断判断闭塞

rules.rule: 解读病理描述需注意定语修饰范围

rules.rule: 膀胱钆增强T1WI低信号需排查早期增强膀胱癌

rules.rule: 肺癌双表现需同时匹配两个影像特征再诊断

rules.rule: 内侧胫骨平台较外侧更凹且位置更远

rules.error_behavior: 错误排除复发性肺栓塞，误称复发性PE会升高PCWP，混淆病因和慢性综合征
rules.correct_reasoning: 复发性PE可致PCWP正常的毛细血管前PH，癌症患者沉默复发性PE可表现为慢性进展性呼吸困难，需鉴别二者

rules.rule: 免疫缺陷患者新发皮损需优先排查隐球菌病
rules.rule_en: Prioritize cryptococcosis screening for immunodeficient patients with new skin lesions
rules.scenario: 严重免疫缺陷患者新发面部中央结痂丘疹结节待查病因
rules.scenario_en: Identifying the cause of a new centrally crusted papulonodular facial lesion in severely immunodeficient patients
rules.checkpoint: 是否优先排查了隐球菌病？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is cryptococcosis prioritized for screening?
rules.error_behavior: 错误排除隐球菌病，错误匹配杆菌性血管瘤病形态
rules.correct_reasoning: 严重免疫缺陷该皮损需先考虑隐球菌病，勿因播散排除，区分杆菌性血管瘤病形态

rules.rule: Verify FSH/LH values before diagnosing primary ovarian insufficiency
rules.rule_en: Verify FSH and LH values before diagnosing primary ovarian insufficiency
rules.scenario: Evaluating cause of secondary amenorrhea with elevated gonadotropins
rules.scenario_en: Evaluating cause of secondary amenorrhea with elevated gonadotropins
rules.checkpoint: Are FSH and LH values correctly interpreted?
rules.checkpoint_en: Are FSH and LH values correctly interpreted?
rules.error_behavior: Incorrectly claimed FSH > LH, misclassified POI as ovarian hyperstimulation
rules.correct_reasoning: Check actual FSH/LH values, confirm elevated gonadotropins plus low estradiol indicates POI, next test for associated autoimmune disease.

rules.rule: 有明确病变表现时，选具体诊断而非笼统病因
rules.rule_en: Choose specific diagnosis over general etiology with clear manifestations
rules.scenario: 临床给出多个不同层次诊断选项时选最准确的
rules.scenario_en: When multiple diagnostic options of different levels are provided
rules.checkpoint: 是否选择了最具体准确的诊断？
rules.checkpoint_en: Have you selected the most specific diagnosis?
rules.error_behavior: 错选笼统病因诊断，未选含具体病变的准确诊断
rules.correct_reasoning: 本例是CMV引发的多处皮肤溃疡，应选具体的CMV皮肤溃疡诊断

rules.rule: 宫颈癌MRI检查，需分别评估每侧宫旁和输尿管
rules.rule_en: For cervical cancer MRI, assess each parametrium and ureter individually
rules.scenario: 使用冠状位T2加权MRI进行宫颈癌分期时
rules.scenario_en: When staging cervical cancer using coronal T2-weighted MRI
rules.checkpoint: 宫旁和输尿管受累是单侧还是双侧？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is parametrial and ureteral involvement unilateral or bilateral?
rules.error_behavior: 错误将仅右侧的宫旁受累和输尿管梗阻认为是双侧病变
rules.correct_reasoning: 分别评估左右宫旁是否有肿瘤侵犯，再评估每侧输尿管是否梗阻，再确定FIGO分期

rules.rule: NSAID防胃肠道出血，先降为最低有效剂量再加药
rules.rule_en: Prevent NSAID GI bleeding: lower dose first before adding prophylaxis
rules.scenario: 使用NSAID镇痛需降低胃肠道出血风险时
rules.scenario_en: When using NSAIDs for analgesia and need to reduce GI bleeding risk
rules.checkpoint: 是否先考虑最低有效NSAID剂量？
rules.checkpoint_en: Do you first consider the lowest effective NSAID dose?
rules.error_behavior: 误认为降低剂量会影响镇痛，错选加PPI维持原剂量
rules.correct_reasoning: 最低有效剂量可维持镇痛，是预防出血的首要基础措施

rules.rule: 判断血管异物病因需结合病理组织学特征
rules.rule_en: Judge vascular foreign body etiology combined with histopathological features
rules.scenario: 判断医源性肺动脉狭窄的异物病因时适用
rules.scenario_en: It is applicable when judging the foreign body etiology of iatrogenic pulmonary artery stenosis
rules.checkpoint: 是否结合病理特征判断异物病因？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is the etiology judged based on pathological features?
rules.error_behavior: 忽略病理异物特征提示，错误排除亲水聚合物栓塞，选缝线异物狭窄
rules.correct_reasoning: 结合病理异物特征和有创操作史，判断病变病因

rules.rule: 高酸分泌胃溃疡，优先考虑胃窦而非胃角切迹
rules.rule_en: For peptic gastric ulcer with hyperacidity, prioritize antrum over angular incisure
rules.scenario: 判断伴显著高酸分泌的胃溃疡好发位置时
rules.scenario_en: When determining the most likely site of gastric ulcer with significant acid secretion
rules.checkpoint: 是否结合高酸情况判断溃疡位置？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is hyperacidity considered when judging ulcer site?
rules.error_behavior: 只按普通胃溃疡常见位置判断，忽略高酸改变位置特点
rules.correct_reasoning: 普通胃溃疡在胃小弯角切迹伴正常/低酸，高酸胃溃疡好发胃窦，需结合酸分泌判断位置

rules.rule: 存在缩窄性生理与心包增厚时，勿轻易排除渗出缩窄性心包炎
rules.rule_en: When constrictive physiology with thickened pericardium, do not rule out effusive-constrictive pericarditis
rules.scenario: 诊断合并缩窄性生理和心包增厚的心包疾病时
rules.scenario_en: When diagnosing pericardial disease with constrictive physiology and thickened pericardium
rules.checkpoint: 是否排除了渗出缩窄性心包炎？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is effusive-constrictive pericarditis ruled out?
rules.error_behavior: 因未明确提及心包积液就排除渗出缩窄性心包炎
rules.correct_reasoning: 急性心包炎后明显心包增厚伴缩窄性生理，应考虑本病

rules.rule: Acute fracture immediately after injury has normal alkaline phosphatase
rules.rule_en: Acute fracture presenting immediately after injury has normal alkaline phosphatase
rules.scenario: Evaluating lab values for acute fracture immediately after injury
rules.scenario_en: Evaluating laboratory values for acute fracture immediately after injury
rules.checkpoint: Is fracture presentation acute immediately after injury?
rules.checkpoint_en: Is fracture presentation acute immediately after injury?
rules.error_behavior: Incorrectly assumed alkaline phosphatase elevates acutely after fracture
rules.correct_reasoning: Alkaline phosphatase rises days to weeks post-fracture. Acute immediate presentation has normal ALP, osteoporosis has normal labs.

rules.rule: 侧位胸片读片需先确认人工瓣膜位置再诊断
rules.rule_en: Confirm prosthetic valve position before diagnosis on lateral CXR
rules.scenario: 分析侧位胸片上人工瓣膜相关瓣膜病时适用
rules.scenario_en: Applicable when analyzing valvular disease with prosthetic valve on lateral CXR
rules.checkpoint: 人工瓣膜位置定位是否正确？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is prosthetic valve position correctly located?
rules.error_behavior: 错误将人工瓣膜定位于主动脉瓣，误诊为梅毒
rules.correct_reasoning: 先准确定位人工瓣膜，风湿性心脏病更常需换瓣，优先考虑

rules.rule: 术后T2高信号残余病灶需考虑亚急性血肿
rules.rule_en: For post-surgical T2 hyperintense residual lesions, consider subacute hematoma
rules.scenario: 下丘脑肿瘤术后，评估MRI残留T2高信号病灶
rules.scenario_en: Evaluating residual T2 hyperintense lesion on MRI after hypothalamic tumor surgery
rules.checkpoint: 是否已排除亚急性术后血肿？
rules.checkpoint_en: Has subacute post-op hematoma been ruled out?
rules.error_behavior: 仅考虑慢性血肿T2低信号，错误排除亚急性血肿，误诊为残留肿瘤
rules.correct_reasoning: 亚急性术后血肿在T2WI呈高信号，需先考虑该诊断再考虑残留肿瘤

rules.rule: 室间隔矛盾运动提示右心室压力负荷过重而非单纯容量过载
rules.rule_en: Paradoxical septal motion indicates right ventricular pressure overload not isolated overload
rules.scenario: 心脏影像见室间隔改变合并心内左向右分流时
rules.scenario_en: Cardiac imaging shows septal change with left-to-right intracardiac shunt
rules.checkpoint: 是否存在右心室压力负荷增高？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is there right ventricular pressure overload?
rules.error_behavior: 错误将室间隔矛盾运动归因于单纯右心室容量过载，排除了合并肺动脉高压的正确选项
rules.correct_reasoning: 静脉窦缺损可致继发性肺高压，右心室压力负荷重才会引起室间隔矛盾运动，分流可解释肺血流量更高

rules.rule: 寻常型鱼鳞病特征病理为颗粒层缺失而非核潴留
rules.rule_en: Characteristic pathology of ichthyosis vulgaris is stratum granulosum absence not nuclear retention
rules.scenario: 分析寻常型鱼鳞病的特征性组织病理表现时
rules.scenario_en: When analyzing characteristic histopathology of ichthyosis vulgaris
rules.checkpoint: 是否记得寻常型鱼鳞病特征病理？
rules.checkpoint_en: Do you remember characteristic pathology of ichthyosis vulgaris?
rules.error_behavior: 误认角质层核潴留是特征病理，否认颗粒层完全缺失
rules.correct_reasoning: 寻常型鱼鳞病特征病理是颗粒层显著减少或缺失，无核潴留

rules.rule: 先正确识别尿结晶形态再明确肾绞痛病因
rules.rule_en: Identify urine crystal morphology before confirming renal colic etiology
rules.scenario: 肾绞痛患者行尿显微镜检查寻找病因时适用
rules.scenario_en: Applicable when searching etiology for renal colic via urine microscopy
rules.checkpoint: 是否正确识别了尿结晶形态？
rules.checkpoint_en: Have I correctly identified the urine crystal morphology?
rules.error_behavior: 误将棺盖形磷酸铵镁结晶识别为信封形草酸钙结晶，错选乙二醇中毒
rules.correct_reasoning: 先按形态判断结晶类型，棺盖形是磷酸铵镁结晶，与尿路感染相关

rules.rule: 评估治疗证据，高质量meta分析比单个研究更稳健
rules.rule_en: When evaluating treatment evidence, high-quality meta-analysis is more robust than single studies
rules.scenario: 比较治疗方案效果，寻找最稳健临床证据时
rules.scenario_en: When comparing treatment effects and seeking the most robust clinical evidence
rules.checkpoint: 是否需要找最稳健治疗证据？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is the most robust treatment evidence needed?
rules.error_behavior: 错误认为单个原发研究比meta分析更稳健，选错答案
rules.correct_reasoning: 高质量RCT的meta分析整合多研究数据，比单个研究证据更稳健

rules.rule: 疑细菌性脑膜炎无颅高压，尽早腰穿+合理选激素
rules.rule_en: Suspected bacterial meningitis without ICP, do LP early and select steroid properly
rules.scenario: 临床怀疑急性细菌性脑膜炎，无颅内压增高征象时
rules.scenario_en: When clinically suspected acute bacterial meningitis without intracranial hypertension
rules.checkpoint: 是否需要尽早行腰椎穿刺检查？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is an early lumbar puncture required?
rules.error_behavior: 错误排除含腰穿和甲泼尼龙的A，误选无腰穿的D，错判激素适应症
rules.correct_reasoning: 无颅高压时腰穿是必要诊断步骤，皮疹需警惕华佛综合征需用甲泼尼龙

rules.rule: 慢性胰腺炎脂肪泻，可用PPI，勿误判为SIBO
rules.rule_en: Chronic pancreatitis steatorrhea can be treated with PPI, don't misdiagnose as SIBO
rules.scenario: 酒精中毒史患者出现慢性脂肪泻伴低钙血症
rules.scenario_en: Patient with history of alcoholism has chronic steatorrhea with hypocalcemia
rules.checkpoint: 是否知晓慢性胰腺炎脂肪泻可用PPI？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is it known that PPI treats chronic pancreatitis steatorrhea?
rules.error_behavior: 错误认为病因是SIBO，选利福昔明，排除PPI
rules.correct_reasoning: 患者符合慢性胰腺炎外分泌不全致脂肪泻，PPI可改善，应选泮托拉唑

rules.rule: T2低信号低强化肾肿块伸入肾窦，先考虑移行细胞癌
rules.rule_en: For T2 hypointense hypoenhancing renal mass extending into renal sinus, prioritize TCC diagnosis
rules.scenario: MRI评估T2低信号、低强化且伸入肾窦的肾肿块时
rules.scenario_en: When evaluating T2 hypointense hypoenhancing renal mass extending into renal sinus on MRI
rules.checkpoint: 该肿块是否起源于肾窦尿路上皮？
rules.checkpoint_en: Does the lesion originate from renal sinus urothelium?
rules.error_behavior: 错误假设肿块起源于肾实质，排除移行细胞癌错诊为淋巴瘤
rules.correct_reasoning: 移行细胞癌起源于肾窦尿路上皮，T2低信号低强化是其典型表现，应优先考虑

rules.rule: 功能下降先排查外源装置问题，再排查颅内病变
rules.rule_en: Check exogenous device first before investigating intracranial lesions
rules.scenario: 患者头部带外源神经刺激装置，功能下降疑似卒中时
rules.scenario_en: Patient with external cranial nerve stimulation device, functional decline suspected of stroke
rules.checkpoint: 患者功能下降是否为装置问题？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is functional decline caused by the device?
rules.error_behavior: 误判为新发神经功能缺损，优先排查卒中忽略装置问题
rules.correct_reasoning: 症状回到装置作用前基线，无新发异常，应先查装置

rules.rule: 意识改变先纠正可逆病因再评估决策能力
rules.rule_en: Correct reversible causes before assessing decision capacity
rules.scenario: 患者存在可逆病因导致的意识改变，有生前预嘱拒治疗时
rules.scenario_en: Patient has altered mental status from reversible cause with advance directive refusing treatment
rules.checkpoint: 是否先纠正可逆病因再评估能力？
rules.checkpoint_en: Correct reversible cause before capacity assessment?
rules.error_behavior: 错误认为意识改变即丧失决策能力，直接遵从生前预嘱仅予支持治疗
rules.correct_reasoning: 意识改变原因可逆，需先纠正缺氧等病因，再评估决策能力，因此第一步先给氧

rules.rule: 先辨识足矫形器结构，再匹配适应症
rules.rule_en: Identify orthotic structure before matching indication
rules.scenario: 判断足矫形器对应的足部疾病适应症
rules.scenario_en: When determining indicated foot pathology for foot orthosis
rules.checkpoint: 你正确识别足矫形器结构了吗？
rules.checkpoint_en: Did you correctly identify the orthotic structure?
rules.error_behavior: 误将刚性前足板认作跖骨头减压垫，错选跖间神经瘤
rules.correct_reasoning: 先识别矫形器结构，该刚性前足板治疗拇僵症

rules.rule: 腮腺深叶病变需按位置选择活检入路避免神经损伤
rules.rule_en: Select biopsy approach by deep parotid lesion location to avoid nerve injury
rules.scenario: 选择不同位置腮腺深叶病变的活检入路时
rules.scenario_en: When selecting biopsy approach for deep parotid lesions at different locations
rules.checkpoint: 活检入路是否匹配病灶位置?
rules.checkpoint_en: Does biopsy approach match lesion location?
rules.error_behavior: 错误认为前上份腮腺深叶病变可行直接经腮腺活检
rules.correct_reasoning: 前上份腮腺深叶直接活检易损伤面神经，应选CT引导经面活检

rules.rule: 诊断肥厚性心肌病需先确认肥厚的具体部位
rules.rule_en: Confirm hypertrophy location before diagnosing hypertrophic cardiomyopathy
rules.scenario: 分析心脏MRI肥厚表现诊断肥厚性心肌病时
rules.scenario_en: When analyzing cardiac MRI hypertrophy to diagnose hypertrophic cardiomyopathy
rules.checkpoint: 是否明确了肥厚的具体部位？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is the location of hypertrophy confirmed?
rules.error_behavior: 错把不对称室间隔肥厚当成弥漫性对称性肥厚，混淆病变
rules.correct_reasoning: 结合弥漫性对称性肥厚、收缩期心尖闭塞诊断心尖肥厚型心肌病

rules.rule: 劳力性热射病合并高氯酸中毒，优先选乳酸林格液
rules.rule_en: Prefer lactated Ringer's for exertional heat stroke with hyperchloremic acidosis
rules.scenario: 劳力性热射病合并高氯血症代谢性酸中毒选择补液方案时
rules.scenario_en: When selecting fluid replacement for exertional heat stroke with hyperchloremic metabolic acidosis
rules.checkpoint: 是否合并高氯血症代谢性酸中毒？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is there concurrent hyperchloremic metabolic acidosis?
rules.error_behavior: 错误认为高钠低血容量首选生理盐水，忽略其会加重高氯血症酸中毒
rules.correct_reasoning: 患者热射病脱水合并高氯血症酸中毒，高氯的生理盐水会加重异常，乳酸林格钠浓度低于患者血清钠，可缓慢降钠且不加重电解质异常，应优先选择

rules.rule: 躯体功能障碍按放松位置命名，而非受限运动方向
rules.rule_en: Somatic dysfunction is named after position of ease, not restricted motion direction
rules.scenario: 根据体格检查结果诊断单节段胸椎躯体功能障碍时
rules.scenario_en: When diagnosing single-segment thoracic somatic dysfunction based on physical exam findings
rules.checkpoint: 功能障碍按什么位置命名？
rules.checkpoint_en: What position is somatic dysfunction named after?
rules.error_behavior: 错误认为屈曲受限提示屈曲功能障碍，右前横突提示右旋转
rules.correct_reasoning: 躯体功能障碍按放松位置命名，屈曲受限说明椎体卡在伸展位，是伸展功能障碍；椎体向右旋转时右侧横突向后，因此右侧前横突提示左旋转；单节段胸椎功能障碍旋转和侧屈方向相反，右旋转伴随左侧弯，因此正确诊断是ERLSL

rules.rule: When reading CT for kidney stones, check location and inflammation
rules.rule_en: When reading CT for kidney stones, check location and inflammation
rules.scenario: Evaluating kidney stones and associated inflammation on CT
rules.scenario_en: Evaluating kidney stones and associated inflammation on CT
rules.checkpoint: Is location and inflammation correctly identified?
rules.checkpoint_en: Is location and inflammation correctly identified?
rules.error_behavior: Mislocalized left stone to left descending ureter, missed bilateral inflammation
rules.correct_reasoning: Confirm both stones are one per kidney, then identify bilateral peripelvic inflammation

rules.rule: T1 MRI蝶窦低信号需先排除蛛网膜膨出，勿误判为空气
rules.rule_en: Low sphenoid signal on T1 MRI: rule out arachnoidocele first
rules.scenario: 读蝶鞍区矢状位T1 MRI，评估蝶窦信号时
rules.scenario_en: When evaluating sphenoid sinus signal on sagittal T1 MRI of sella
rules.checkpoint: 是否排除低信号为蛛网膜膨出？
rules.checkpoint_en: Have you ruled out arachnoidocele for low signal?
rules.error_behavior: 将蛛网膜膨出的T1低信号误判为空气，误诊为正常含气蝶窦
rules.correct_reasoning: 脑脊液和空气T1WI均呈低信号，需结合骨质改变排除蛛网膜膨出

rules.rule: 创伤按ATLS原则，先颈椎保护再处理
rules.rule_en: Follow ATLS for trauma, cervical protection first
rules.scenario: 高处坠落致多发创伤的初始急救处理
rules.scenario_en: Initial emergency management of multiple trauma from fall
rules.checkpoint: 是否先完成ATLS A步颈椎保护？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is cervical protection done in ATLS step A first?
rules.error_behavior: 误判为张力性气胸，将穿刺减压放于颈椎保护前
rules.correct_reasoning: 按ATLS ABCDE顺序，A步先做颈椎保护，高处坠落即使神经正常也需先戴颈托

rules.rule: ESRD透析后BUN肌酐升高不代表肾功恶化
rules.rule_en: Elevated BUN/Cr post dialysis in ESRD doesn't mean worsening renal function
rules.scenario: ESRD维持透析患者透析后发现BUN肌酐升高
rules.scenario_en: ESRD patients on maintenance dialysis have elevated BUN/Cr after dialysis
rules.checkpoint: 透析后BUN肌酐升高提示肾功恶化吗？
rules.checkpoint_en: Does elevated BUN/Cr post dialysis indicate worsening renal function?
rules.error_behavior: 错误认为透析后BUN肌酐升高提示肾功能恶化
rules.correct_reasoning: ESRD透析后BUN肌酐升高是预期蓄积，并非肾功恶化

rules.rule: 检测肾结石时，CT敏感性高于MRI，适用于克罗恩病

rules.rule: 考虑退行性脊柱滑脱为外侧隐窝狭窄病因

rules.rule: 纵隔肿块合并反复念珠菌病需排查相关自身免疫病

rules.rule: 弥漫肝内胆管扩张，先排胆总管结石再考虑Caroli病

rules.checkpoint: 是否先排除了胆总管结石？

rules.error_behavior: 错误认为胆总管结石不会引起弥漫肝内胆管扩张，误诊为Caroli病，漏诊胆总管结石
rules.correct_reasoning: 胆道梗阻引起梗阻近端胆管扩张，胆总管结石是弥漫肝内胆管扩张常见病因，需先排除再考虑Caroli病

rules.scenario_en: Determining stroke etiology in patient with atherosclerotic risk factors

rules.correct_reasoning: With atherosclerotic risk factors, no source means thrombotic is more likely

rules.correct_reasoning: 胸椎椎弓根横径并非从上到下单调递增，上段比中段宽，本题中T6平均横径最小

rules.correct_reasoning: 疑穿孔急腹症首选快速的腹部平片查游离腹腔气体

rules.rule: 区分脑脊液间隙伪影，先明确题干要求部位

rules.checkpoint_en: Is the required analysis location confirmed?

rules.correct_reasoning: 先明确题干要求分析的部位，再对应选项判断正确描述

rules.rule: Vestibular paroxysmia first-line treatment is carbamazepine

rules.scenario_en: Managing symptomatic vestibular paroxysmia caused by neurovascular compression of the vestibulocochlear nerve

rules.rule: 发现脑室扩大需先区分脑萎缩性与脑积水性

rules.checkpoint_en: Is enlargement from atrophy or CSF obstruction?
rules.error_behavior: 误将脑萎缩继发性脑室扩大诊断为梗阻性脑积水
rules.correct_reasoning: 阿尔茨海默病脑萎缩致脑室扩大，脑脊液压力正常，病理见淀粉样斑块

rules.rule: 宫颈癌MRI扫至肾静脉水平见淋巴结，不等于肾静脉以上转移

rules.checkpoint_en: Is there lymph node metastasis above the renal vein?
rules.error_behavior: 错误将扫至左肾静脉水平的肿大淋巴结认定为肾静脉以上远处转移，误分期为IVB期
rules.correct_reasoning: 题干仅说明扫描范围达左肾静脉水平，无证据提示淋巴结位于肾静脉以上；肾静脉水平及以下肿大淋巴结为区域淋巴结，宫旁浸润伴淋巴结肿大符合IIIB期

rules.rule: 儿童呕吐胃区见不透光影，需先排除急性铁剂中毒

rules.checkpoint: 是否已排除急性铁剂中毒？
rules.checkpoint_en: Has acute iron poisoning been excluded?
rules.error_behavior: 误判胃区高密度影为良性异物致机械性梗阻，酸碱推理基于错误诊断前提
rules.correct_reasoning: 首先考虑误服急性铁剂中毒，铁中毒引发乳酸性代谢性酸中毒

rules.rule: 新生儿高尖哭伴下斜睑裂优先排查5p缺失综合征

rules.rule: 热疗联合放疗主要靶向细胞周期的S期细胞

rules.rule: 区分手术指征与预后因素，勿泛化年龄影响

rules.checkpoint: 是否区分手术指征和预后因素？

rules.rule: 病变定位于环咽肌时，优先选特异性诊断而非宽泛诊断

rules.rule: In overdose with miosis, hypotension, bradycardia, confirm respiratory depression for opioids
rules.rule_en: In overdose with miosis, hypotension, bradycardia, confirm respiratory depression for opioids

rules.scenario_en: Evaluating intentional medication overdose with altered mental status, miosis, hypotension, bradycardia
rules.checkpoint: Is there classic opioid respiratory depression?
rules.checkpoint_en: Is there classic opioid respiratory depression?

rules.correct_reasoning: Methyldopa overdose can cause miosis, hypotension, bradycardia without respiratory depression. Opioid overdose requires respiratory depression as core feature.

rules.rule: 终末期肿瘤患者新发卧床拒食提示近期将出现意识迟钝

rules.rule: Evaluate entire cervical spine, not just upper craniocervical junction

rules.rule: 答题需结合题目给定信息，勿依赖通用模式猜测

rules.correct_reasoning: 应结合题目提供的方案信息，根据指南选择正确方案

rules.rule: REM睡眠氧饱下降需先匹配模式再定病因

rules.correct_reasoning: CHF相关CSAS为周期性氧饱波动，本例REM氧降符合肥胖致OSA，选肥胖

rules.rule: Gross hematuria workup needs cystoscopy as an initial core step

rules.rule: 多普勒PSV需对应y轴刻度准确判读数值

rules.correct_reasoning: 两幅图PSV均超过20cm/s，对应正确答案C

rules.rule: 前列腺超声发现囊肿需结合全部征象，勿仅看单一表现

rules.correct_reasoning: 结合边界不清低回声、不均增大、脓肿周边充血无内部血流，诊断前列腺脓肿

rules.rule: 手DIP平片勿将骨赘不规则误判为侵蚀骨膜炎

rules.scenario_en: Differentiating osteoarthritis and psoriatic arthritis on hand DIP radiograph
rules.checkpoint: 是否误将骨赘不规则判为侵蚀骨膜炎？
rules.checkpoint_en: Did you misinterpret osteophyte as erosion or periostitis?
rules.error_behavior: 误将骨赘骨质不规则判为侵蚀和骨膜炎，错诊为银屑病关节炎

rules.rule: OCT检查需定位病灶区分黄斑皱襞与BMT/PED

rules.checkpoint: OCT病灶位置是否判断正确？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is the OCT lesion location correctly identified?
rules.error_behavior: 错误将OCT病灶识别为BMT/PED而非黄斑皱襞，误判干眼病图案位置
rules.correct_reasoning: 先定位病灶，RPE平整连续提示无PED，病灶位于神经感觉视网膜上方提示黄斑皱襞，再确认干眼病图案位置

rules.rule: 判断尿道吊带类型需依据形态和位置
rules.rule_en: Judge urethral sling type based on morphology and position
rules.scenario: 经阴道超声判断尿道吊带类型时
rules.scenario_en: Judging urethral sling type via transvaginal ultrasound
rules.checkpoint: 是否依据形态位置判断吊带类型？
rules.checkpoint_en: Did you judge sling type by morphology and position?
rules.error_behavior: 错误套用经闭孔吊带特征，忽略题目U形特征
rules.correct_reasoning: 提取题目给定形态位置，U形符合耻骨后吊带特征

rules.rule: 含异位结肠黏膜的脐息肉应诊断为脐黏膜息肉
rules.rule_en: Umbilical polyp with ectopic colonic mucosa should be diagnosed as umbilical mucosal polyp

rules.scenario_en: Persistent bleeding umbilical polyp in infant with ectopic colonic mucosa on biopsy
rules.checkpoint: 是否应诊断为脐黏膜息肉？
rules.checkpoint_en: Should it be diagnosed as umbilical mucosal polyp?
rules.error_behavior: 错误将含异位结肠黏膜的脐息肉诊断为卵黄管息肉，否定脐黏膜息肉是特异性诊断
rules.correct_reasoning: 本例脐部出血息肉活检见异位结肠黏膜，无其他GI异常，符合脐黏膜息肉诊断

rules.rule: 评估华法林膳食相互作用时，西柚比蔓越莓更易致出血
rules.rule_en: When assessing warfarin-diet interactions, grapefruit causes more bleeding than cranberry
