rules.scenario_en: A patient on warfarin develops intracranial hemorrhage, need to identify causative dietary item
rules.checkpoint: 哪种膳食升高华法林出血风险最大？
rules.checkpoint_en: Which diet increases warfarin bleeding risk most?
rules.error_behavior: 夸大蔓越莓汁与华法林的相互作用，错误低估西柚汁的作用
rules.correct_reasoning: 西柚汁抑制CYP3A4影响R-华法林代谢，增强抗凝增出血；蔓越莓汁无一致临床相关相互作用

rules.rule: Diffuse T1 hypointense marrow can be normal red marrow
rules.rule_en: Diffuse T1 hypointense bone marrow can be normal red marrow
rules.scenario: 解读腰椎MRI见弥漫T1低信号骨髓、局灶椎体病变、椎间盘STIR高信号
rules.scenario_en: Interpreting lumbar MRI with diffuse T1 hypointense marrow, focal vertebral lesion and disc STIR hyperintensity
rules.checkpoint: 弥漫T1低信号骨髓都是浸润性病变吗？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is diffuse T1 hypointense marrow always infiltrative?
rules.error_behavior: 错误认为弥漫T1低信号骨髓一定是浸润性病变，否定了正确选项D
rules.correct_reasoning: 弥漫T1低信号骨髓可为正常红骨髓，局灶L2病变+L4-L5椎间盘炎符合D

rules.rule: 请求戒烟辅助品应归为行动阶段而非准备阶段
rules.rule_en: Requesting smoking cessation aid is Action not Preparation
rules.scenario: 对吸烟者戒烟的行为改变阶段进行分类
rules.scenario_en: Classifying a smoker's stage of behavior change for smoking cessation
rules.checkpoint: 患者是否处于行为改变行动阶段？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is the patient in Action stage of change?
rules.error_behavior: 错将请求戒烟辅助品归为准备阶段而非行动阶段
rules.correct_reasoning: 行动阶段包含请求戒烟辅助品等主动实施步骤，应归为行动阶段

rules.rule: 解读累计发病率需区分绝对风险和相对风险
rules.rule_en: Distinguish absolute vs relative risk when interpreting cumulative incidence
rules.scenario: 从药物广告发病率图得出临床结论时
rules.scenario_en: Drawing conclusions from cumulative incidence graph in pharmaceutical ad
rules.checkpoint: 是否区分了绝对风险和相对风险？
rules.checkpoint_en: Did I distinguish absolute vs relative risk?
rules.error_behavior: 误将绝对风险差错判为相对风险，选错结论
rules.correct_reasoning: 先计算绝对风险差，再判断结论是否符合数据

rules.rule: COPD患者PaO2≥60mmHg，氧疗无降死亡率获益
rules.rule_en: For COPD patients with PaO2≥60mmHg, oxygen therapy has no mortality benefit
rules.scenario: 判断COPD患者降死亡率干预措施时
rules.scenario_en: When judging mortality-reducing interventions for COPD patients
rules.checkpoint: 患者PaO2是否符合LTOT获益标准？
rules.checkpoint_en: Does PaO2 meet LTOT benefit criteria?
rules.error_behavior: 错误认为PaO2 60mmHg伴肺心病氧疗可降死亡率
rules.correct_reasoning: LTOT仅对PaO2≤55mmHg的COPD患者有降死亡率获益，本例PaO2 60mmHg，仅戒烟获益

rules.rule: Confirm radiotracer uptake location in breast on PET first
rules.rule_en: Confirm radiotracer uptake location in breast on PET first
rules.scenario: 评估PET图像乳腺区域是否存在代谢活性摄取
rules.scenario_en: Assessing if metabolic radiotracer uptake exists in breast region on PET
rules.checkpoint: 摄取灶是否位于乳腺组织内？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is the uptake located within breast tissue?
rules.error_behavior: 误将乳腺外的局灶摄取认定为乳腺区域摄取，错误选是
rules.correct_reasoning: 先确认局灶摄取的解剖位置，确认位于乳腺组织内再判断存在乳腺区域摄取，本例摄取位于乳腺外，答案为否

rules.rule: 激素避孕伴舒张压≥100mmHg，优先换非激素避孕
rules.rule_en: Prioritize switching to non-hormonal contraception for CHC users with DBP ≥100mmHg
rules.scenario: 年轻女性用激素避孕，体检发现舒张压≥100mmHg需定方案
rules.scenario_en: A young woman using hormonal contraception has diastolic BP ≥100mmHg on routine check-up, needs management
rules.checkpoint: 是否优先更换非激素避孕方法？
rules.checkpoint_en: Should we prioritize switching to non-hormonal contraception?
rules.error_behavior: 错误优先安排动态血压监测，未优先干预高风险激素避孕
rules.correct_reasoning: 激素避孕是年轻女性高血压可逆转病因，舒张压≥100mmHg需先停用换非激素避孕，优先干预高风险

rules.rule: 存在筋膜室肌肉缺血，优先诊断急性筋膜室综合征
rules.rule_en: Prioritize acute compartment syndrome when there is compartment muscle ischemia
rules.scenario: 下肢创伤后抗凝患者，发现血肿伴筋膜室肌肉缺血
rules.scenario_en: Anticoagulated patients after lower extremity trauma with hematoma and compartment muscle ischemia
rules.checkpoint: 是否存在筋膜室内肌肉缺血改变？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is there muscle ischemia in the osseofascial compartment?
rules.error_behavior: 误将致病血肿作为原发诊断，漏诊原发的急性筋膜室综合征
rules.correct_reasoning: 筋膜室内肌肉缺血是急性筋膜室综合征核心表现，血肿是病因，原发诊断应为急性筋膜室综合征

rules.rule: 运动诱发支气管痉挛预防首选ICS-福莫特罗而非SABA
rules.rule_en: Prefer ICS-formoterol over SABA for EIB prophylaxis
rules.scenario: 选择运动诱发支气管痉挛的预防用药时
rules.scenario_en: When selecting prophylaxis for exercise-induced bronchoconstriction
rules.checkpoint: EIB首选预防用药是什么？
rules.checkpoint_en: What is first-line prophylaxis for EIB?
rules.error_behavior: 错误认为EIB预防首选SABA，认为ICS-福莫特罗仅适用于持续性哮喘
rules.correct_reasoning: 根据GINA指南，孤立EIB预防首选低剂量ICS-福莫特罗，SABA不再一线

rules.rule: 判读胸部CT实变，需确认是否存在明确空气支气管征
rules.rule_en: When interpreting chest CT consolidation, confirm clear air bronchogram presence
rules.scenario: 判读胸部CT肺实变异常，明确是否存在特征性空气支气管征
rules.scenario_en: When interpreting abnormal lung consolidation on chest CT, confirm existence of characteristic air bronchogram
rules.checkpoint: 是否存在明确空气支气管征？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is there a clear air bronchogram?
rules.error_behavior: 错误识别实变中存在明确空气支气管征，得出错误结论
rules.correct_reasoning: 观察实变是否存在明确空气支气管征，本例仅见边界不清实变

rules.rule: 对于需转诊的严重开放性创伤，转诊时间是最强感染风险因素
rules.rule_en: For severe open trauma requiring transfer, transfer time is the strongest infection risk factor
rules.scenario: 严重高能量开放性四肢创伤需转诊至确定性创伤中心
rules.scenario_en: Severe high-energy open extremity trauma requiring transfer to definitive trauma center
rules.checkpoint: 哪个因素对感染风险影响最强？
rules.checkpoint_en: Which factor has the strongest influence on infection risk?
rules.error_behavior: 错误将6小时内清创认为是最强感染风险影响因素
rules.correct_reasoning: 初始机构无法提供确定性治疗，转诊时间影响最大

rules.rule: For sudden painless vision loss, correctly ID fundoscopy findings to distinguish RVO and CRAO
rules.rule_en: For sudden painless vision loss, correctly identify fundoscopy findings to distinguish RVO and CRAO
rules.scenario: Evaluating sudden unilateral painless vision loss via fundoscopic exam
rules.scenario_en: Evaluating sudden unilateral painless vision loss via fundoscopic exam
rules.checkpoint: Are fundoscopic findings correctly identified?
rules.checkpoint_en: Are fundoscopic findings correctly identified?
rules.error_behavior: Misinterpreted fundoscopic findings, incorrectly diagnosed CRAO instead of RVO
rules.correct_reasoning: CRAO has pale retina with cherry-red spot; RVO has diffuse hemorrhages and engorged veins matching the image

rules.rule: 近曲小管TF/P比浅升提示溶质水重吸收速率匹配
rules.rule_en: Shallow rise of proximal tubule TF/P indicates matched solute-water reabsorption
rules.scenario: 分析沿近曲小管的管液/血浆浓度比曲线时
rules.scenario_en: When analyzing TF/P concentration ratio curves along proximal convoluted tubule
rules.checkpoint: 浅升是否提示溶质水重吸收速率匹配?
rules.checkpoint_en: Does shallow rise indicate matched solute-water reabsorption?
rules.error_behavior: 错误将浅升TF/P曲线解读为溶质几乎无分泌重吸收
rules.correct_reasoning: 浅升TF/P提示溶质重吸收速率与水接近，存在明显溶质重吸收；若无溶质重吸收分泌，斜率会更陡

rules.rule: 白癜风合并广泛色素脱失，需排查自身免疫相关舌炎
rules.rule_en: For vitiligo with widespread depigmentation, screen for autoimmune-related glossitis
rules.scenario: 评估白癜风患者广泛色素脱失的相关伴随疾病时
rules.scenario_en: When evaluating associated conditions for vitiligo with widespread depigmentation
rules.checkpoint: 本例是否合并自身免疫相关舌炎？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is this case complicated with autoimmune-related glossitis?
rules.error_behavior: 错误将广泛色素脱失归因于PPD暴露，排除了合并舌炎
rules.correct_reasoning: 本例为自身免疫性白癜风，常合并其他自身免疫病，B12缺乏可致舌炎；PPD仅致接触性皮炎，不引发广泛色素脱失

rules.rule: Cysts at gastrocnemius origin: confirm etiology before diagnosis
rules.rule_en: For cysts at gastrocnemius origin: confirm etiology before diagnosis
rules.scenario: Evaluating multiseptated cyst at gastrocnemius tendon origin on MRI
rules.scenario_en: Evaluating multiseptated cyst at gastrocnemius tendon origin on MRI
rules.checkpoint: Does the lesion match the given etiology?
rules.checkpoint_en: Does the lesion match the given etiology?
rules.error_behavior: Misclassified gastrocnemius origin cyst as Baker cyst, incorrectly dismissed ganglion cyst
rules.correct_reasoning: Baker cyst is synovial herniation through capsule defect; not all gastrocnemius origin cysts are Baker cysts. Benign ganglion cyst from traction injury at tendon origin is the correct diagnosis here.

rules.rule: 无关节病变的肢端钙化不排除硬皮病钙化
rules.rule_en: Acral calcification without joint changes does not rule out scleroderma calcinosis
rules.scenario: 手部X线见肢端软组织钙化无关节异常时
rules.scenario_en: When hand X-ray shows acral soft tissue calcification without joint abnormalities
rules.checkpoint: 是否排除了硬皮病钙质沉着可能？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is scleroderma calcinosis incorrectly ruled out?
rules.error_behavior: 错误认为硬皮病钙化必须伴指骨吸收和关节病变，误选外源性颜料沉积
rules.correct_reasoning: 硬皮病尤其CREST综合征可仅表现为肢端软组织钙化，无关节病变和指骨吸收，题目提示为内源性软组织钙化，不应选外源性沉积

rules.rule: 不明原因乳酸酸中毒头外伤需排除创伤后癫痫
rules.rule_en: Rule out post-traumatic seizure in head trauma with unexplained lactic acidosis
rules.scenario: 评估钝性头外伤患者出现无法解释的乳酸酸中毒时
rules.scenario_en: Evaluating blunt head trauma patients with unexplained lactic acidosis
rules.checkpoint: 乳酸酸中毒是否无法用非癫痫病因解释？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is lactic acidosis unexplained by non-seizure causes?
rules.error_behavior: 因无明确癫痫发作描述排除该病，误诊断为弥漫性轴索损伤
rules.correct_reasoning: 不成比例乳酸酸中毒提示创伤后癫痫，弥漫性轴索损伤多伴持续意识障碍

rules.rule: 单侧小半胸透亮度增加，鉴别Macleod与支气管闭锁
rules.rule_en: Unilateral small hemithorax with hyperlucency, distinguish Macleod from bronchial atresia
rules.scenario: 胸部影像发现单侧小半胸伴肺透亮度增加、空气潴留时
rules.scenario_en: Chest imaging reveals unilateral small hemithorax with hyperlucency and air trapping
rules.checkpoint: 受累半胸体积是否真的缩小？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is the affected hemithorax volume reduced?
rules.error_behavior: 错误认为支气管闭锁会导致受累整个半胸缩小
rules.correct_reasoning: 支气管闭锁受累肺叶因空气潴留体积增大，Macleod综合征才会使受累半胸缩小

rules.rule: 壁细胞嗜酸性消失，需鉴别PPI胃病与自身免疫胃炎
rules.rule_en: Differentiate PPI gastropathy vs autoimmune gastritis when parietal cell eosinophilia lost
rules.scenario: 胃粘膜组织学见壁细胞嗜酸性消失，需鉴别诊断时
rules.scenario_en: When differential diagnosis for loss of parietal cell eosinophilia in gastric histology
rules.checkpoint: 是否区分了两类胃病组织学特征？
rules.checkpoint_en: Did you distinguish two gastritis histology features?
rules.error_behavior: 误将PPI胃病的壁细胞嗜酸性降低当成完全萎缩，错选自身免疫胃炎
rules.correct_reasoning: PPI胃病壁细胞空泡化致嗜酸性降低，无大量淋巴浸润，符合题干，自身免疫胃炎伴壁细胞完全丢失和明显淋巴炎症

rules.rule: 结肠增厚分界不清，先确认病变是否从远端开始
rules.rule_en: For thickened colon with unclear demarcation, confirm if it starts distally first
rules.scenario: CT读片见结肠壁增厚伴相邻肠段分界不清
rules.scenario_en: CT scan shows bowel wall thickening with unclear demarcation between adjacent colonic segments
rules.checkpoint: 是否确认病变起始于远端直肠？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is the lesion confirmed starting from distal rectum?
rules.error_behavior: 误将相邻受累肠段分界不清认作UC特点，忽略UC从远端起病
rules.correct_reasoning: 相邻受累肠段分界不清可见于缺血性结肠炎，UC需从直肠开始连续累及，孤立近端受累不支持UC

rules.rule: Down syndrome neck pain: check plain radiograph ADI first
rules.rule_en: For Down syndrome neck pain, check plain radiograph ADI first
rules.scenario: Evaluating Down syndrome patient with neck pain, cervical instability, normal plain film
rules.scenario_en: Evaluating Down syndrome patient with neck pain, cervical instability, normal plain radiograph
rules.checkpoint: Does plain radiograph show increased ADI?
rules.checkpoint_en: Does plain radiograph show increased atlanto-dental interval?

rules.correct_reasoning: Transverse ligament laxity shows increased ADI on plain film; normal plain film means alar ligaments affected, which primarily maintain rotation

rules.rule: Gd-153源衰减校正参考扫描需每日进行
rules.rule_en: Reference scan for Gd-153 attenuation correction must be done daily
rules.scenario: 使用钆-153密封源做衰减校正时确定参考扫描频率

rules.checkpoint: 参考扫描频率要求是否为每日？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is the required reference scan frequency daily?

rules.correct_reasoning: 标准质控要求：使用钆-153密封源做衰减校正需每日行参考扫描

rules.rule: 判断骨髓是否受累，需同时看T1和STIR信号
rules.rule_en: To judge bone marrow involvement, check both T1 and STIR signals
rules.scenario: MRI读片判断肿瘤与骨髓炎受累骨关系
rules.scenario_en: Judging relationship between tumor and osteomyelitis affected bone on MRI
rules.checkpoint: 受累区域STIR信号是否正常？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is STIR signal normal in affected area?
rules.error_behavior: 误将STIR高信号区判断为保留脂肪骨髓的未受累区
rules.correct_reasoning: 需同时结合T1和STIR信号判断骨髓是否受累，STIR高信号提示受累

rules.rule: 中周期疼痛可重度复发，需结合排卵时间诊断
rules.rule_en: Mittelschmerz can be severe and recurrent, diagnose by ovulation timing
rules.scenario: 年轻女性排卵期下腹痛，鉴别中周期痛与囊肿破裂
rules.scenario_en: Differentiating mittelschmerz from ruptured ovarian cyst in young female with midcycle abdominal pain
rules.checkpoint: 疼痛是否符合中周期时间特点？
rules.checkpoint_en: Does pain fit the timing of mittelschmerz?
rules.error_behavior: 错误认为中周期疼痛仅轻度，排除该病误选卵巢囊肿破裂
rules.correct_reasoning: 中周期疼痛可重度复发，符合排卵时间少量积液支持该病，无囊肿不支持破裂

rules.rule: 胰腺囊性病变：多普勒血流信号优先于分隔形态
rules.rule_en: For pancreatic cysts, prioritize Doppler vascularity over septation pattern
rules.scenario: 超声内镜下鉴别胰腺囊性神经内分泌肿瘤和黏液性囊性肿瘤
rules.scenario_en: Differentiating cystic neuroendocrine tumor from mucinous cystic neoplasm on EUS
rules.checkpoint: 多普勒是否显示明显血管化分隔？

rules.checkpoint_en: Does patient meet HIT diagnostic criteria?
rules.error_behavior: 血小板仅降38%、肝素用3天就误诊为HIT
rules.correct_reasoning: HIT需血小板降>50%、首次肝素后5-10天发病。本例为华法林诱导皮肤坏死，应停华法林予维生素K，维持肝素。

rules.rule: 儿童巨指症，骨骺阻滞时机参照双亲成人指长
rules.rule_en: For pediatric macrodactyly, epiphysiodesis timing refers to parent's adult digit length
rules.scenario: 儿童巨指症需干预获得比例合适手指时
rules.scenario_en: When intervention is needed for pediatric macrodactyly to get proportional finger size
rules.checkpoint: 是否参照双亲指长确定骨骺阻滞时机？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is epiphysiodesis timed based on parent's digit length?
rules.error_behavior: 错误认为骨骼成熟后截骨是最优方案，否定参照父指长的方案
rules.correct_reasoning: 男童巨指症参照父亲成人指长，患指达该长度时行骨骺阻滞是合理方案，优于成熟后截骨

rules.rule: 急性肺炎脓毒症肺浸润需排查三尖瓣病变
rules.rule_en: Check tricuspid lesions for acute pneumonia with sepsis and pulmonary infiltrates
rules.scenario: 急性肺炎伴脓毒症患者胸片见肺浸润，判断心脏杂音时
rules.scenario_en: Evaluating cardiac murmur in acute pneumonia with sepsis and CXR pulmonary infiltrates
rules.checkpoint: 是否排查了右心三尖瓣病变？
rules.checkpoint_en: Has tricuspid valve lesion been checked?
rules.error_behavior: 错误认为肺炎脓毒症常合并主动脉瓣心内膜炎，轻易排除三尖瓣反流
rules.correct_reasoning: 感染性心内膜炎不是肺炎脓毒症常见并发症，无颈静脉怒张不能排除早期三尖瓣反流，肺浸润可继发于右心三尖瓣病变

rules.rule: Do not let irrelevant distractors override actual exam findings
rules.rule_en: Do not allow irrelevant clinical distractors to override actual physical exam findings
rules.scenario: 评估皮肤病变时存在无关临床病史干扰因素
rules.scenario_en: When evaluating a skin lesion with an irrelevant clinical history distractor
rules.checkpoint: 病变表现符合临床病史提示吗？
rules.checkpoint_en: Does the lesion finding match the clinical history?
rules.error_behavior: 模型依赖暴露史干扰因素，错误推断皮疹形态，排除了正确选项诊断为病毒感染
rules.correct_reasoning: 优先尊重实际体格检查发现，排除无关干扰因素，本例樱桃红色丘疹是樱桃状血管瘤，为良性毛细血管增生

rules.rule: 确认终末器官低灌注后再判定房颤为不稳定
rules.rule_en: Confirm hypoperfusion before classifying AFib as unstable

rules.scenario_en: When evaluating urgent cardioversion for AFib with hypotension and heart failure
rules.checkpoint: 是否存在终末器官低灌注？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is there end-organ hypoperfusion?
rules.error_behavior: 将无终末低灌注的稳定房颤误判为不稳定房颤选电复律
rules.correct_reasoning: 无终末低灌注的房颤为稳定房颤，合并收缩性心衰首选地高辛控制心室率

rules.rule: 20°无进展特发性脊柱侧弯首选定期影像学随访
rules.rule_en: 20-degree non-progressive idiopathic scoliosis prefers regular imaging follow-up
rules.scenario: 青春前期发现20°特发性脊柱侧弯无进展，确定下一步处理
rules.scenario_en: Determine next step for prepubertal patient with 20° non-progressive idiopathic scoliosis
rules.checkpoint: 20°无进展侧弯需立即支具治疗吗？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is immediate bracing needed for 20° non-progressive scoliosis?
rules.error_behavior: 错误认为20°特发性脊柱侧弯青春前期需立即支具治疗
rules.correct_reasoning: 骨骼未成熟者＜25°无进展特发性侧弯只需定期随访，≥25°才需支具

rules.rule: 一过性横行带并非猫食管，需排查贲门失弛缓症
rules.rule_en: Transient transverse bands are not feline esophagus, check for achalasia
rules.scenario: 食管造影发现一过性横行带、螺旋食管及GE部鸟嘴征时
rules.scenario_en: When esophagram shows transient transverse bands, corkscrew esophagus and bird's beak at GE junction
rules.checkpoint: 诊断是否涵盖所有影像表现？
rules.checkpoint_en: Does the diagnosis cover all imaging findings?
rules.error_behavior: 模型误认为一过性横行带是猫食管特征性表现，错误排除原发性贲门失弛缓症
rules.correct_reasoning: 一过性横行带可由失弛缓收缩产生，原发性贲门失弛缓可同时出现全部三种表现

rules.rule: 轴位CT：患者右侧对应图像左侧，符合放射学常规
rules.rule_en: On axial CT, patient's right corresponds to image left per radiologic convention
rules.scenario: 定位轴位CT肺动脉造影中的肺动脉栓塞时
rules.scenario_en: Localizing pulmonary embolism in axial CT pulmonary angiography
rules.checkpoint: 是否正确识别了影像侧别方位？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is image side orientation correctly identified?
rules.error_behavior: 混淆轴位CT侧别对应关系，误将PE定位于左侧肺动脉
rules.correct_reasoning: 标准轴位CT中患者右侧对应图像左侧，本例PE位于右侧肺动脉，应选D

rules.rule: 扩张肝段胆管汇入门提示影响手术可切除性
rules.rule_en: Dilated segmental duct with hilar unification indicates operability-impairing obstruction
rules.scenario: 评估胆道梗阻对胆囊癌手术可切除性影响时
rules.scenario_en: When assessing impact of biliary obstruction on gallbladder cancer operability
rules.checkpoint: 扩张汇入门肝段胆管是否影响可切除性？
rules.checkpoint_en: Does it affect operability if dilated duct unifies at hilum?
rules.error_behavior: 错误认为汇入门的扩张肝段胆管不影响手术可切除性
rules.correct_reasoning: 汇入门的扩张肝段胆管提示中央胆道梗阻，会影响手术可切除性

rules.rule: 胫前皮损先排除慢性静脉淤滞再诊粘液水肿
rules.rule_en: Exclude chronic venous stasis before diagnosing pretibial myxedema
rules.scenario: 鉴别诊断下肢胫前区伴水疱皮损时
rules.scenario_en: Differential diagnosis of pretibial bullous lesions on lower extremity
rules.checkpoint: 是否排除了慢性静脉淤滞？
rules.checkpoint_en: Has chronic venous stasis been excluded?
rules.error_behavior: 错误排除慢性静脉淤滞，误诊为胫前粘液水肿
rules.correct_reasoning: 严重慢性静脉淤滞可出现胫前水疱增厚，需先排除；胫前粘液水肿无典型广泛水疱，不应优先诊断

rules.rule: 新生儿先心病需整合低钙及面容特征鉴别
rules.rule_en: Integrate hypocalcemia and facial features for neonatal CHD differential
rules.scenario: 新生儿呼吸困难喂养困难，疑诊先天性心脏病
rules.scenario_en: Neonate with dyspnea and feeding difficulty, suspected CHD
rules.checkpoint: 是否整合低钙与异常面容？
rules.checkpoint_en: Have hypocalcemia and abnormal face been integrated?
rules.error_behavior: 误读胸片，记错疾病特点，未整合低钙和异常面容
rules.correct_reasoning: 低钙合并异常面容提示锥干畸形，共同动脉干符合影像表现，排除HLHS

rules.rule: 全大脑半球弥漫灌注异常优先考虑近端颈动脉狭窄
rules.rule_en: Diffuse whole cerebral hemisphere perfusion abnormality favors proximal carotid stenosis
rules.scenario: 分析脑部CT灌注，见单侧全脑半球CBF降低、CBV正常时
rules.scenario_en: When analyzing brain CT perfusion with unilateral whole hemisphere decreased CBF and normal CBV
rules.checkpoint: 是否为全大脑半球弥漫灌注异常？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is it diffuse whole hemisphere perfusion abnormality?
rules.error_behavior: 错误认为重度颈动脉狭窄必然导致CBV升高，误选急性缺血性卒中伴半暗带
rules.correct_reasoning: 重度颈动脉狭窄合并充分侧支代偿时可表现为正常CBV，全半球弥漫病变符合近端颈动脉狭窄，急性卒中半暗带多为局灶性

rules.rule: 评估冠脉狭窄前需先确认造影投照体位
rules.rule_en: Confirm projection before assessing coronary stenosis
rules.scenario: 评估冠脉造影中冠脉狭窄位置和程度时
rules.scenario_en: Evaluating location and degree of stenosis on coronary angiography
rules.checkpoint: 是否确认了正确的造影投照体位？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is the correct angiographic projection confirmed?
rules.error_behavior: 错将LAO投照识别为RAO，误把左主干开口狭窄判为LAD弥漫狭窄
rules.correct_reasoning: 先确认造影正确投照体位，再识别冠脉解剖，本病例为LAO位，左主干开口70%狭窄，LAD无弥漫狭窄

rules.rule: 慢性Lisfranc损伤无后足病变，不做三关节融合
rules.rule_en: Chronic Lisfranc injury: avoid triple arthrodesis without hindfoot lesions
rules.scenario: 制定慢性Lisfranc损伤手术方案时适用
rules.scenario_en: When formulating surgical plan for chronic Lisfranc injury
rules.checkpoint: 是否存在后足病变或畸形？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is there any hindfoot lesion or deformity?
rules.error_behavior: 无影像学证据默认存在后足病变，选择三关节融合
rules.correct_reasoning: 慢性疼痛Lisfranc不稳只需融合1-3跗跖关节，无证据不做三关节融合

rules.rule: 胰腺肿瘤术前CT需准确定位后再选术式
rules.rule_en: Accurately localize pancreatic tumor on CT before surgery selection
rules.scenario: 术前经CT评估胰腺肿瘤，选择手术方案时适用
rules.scenario_en: Applicable when selecting surgical approach after CT evaluation of pancreatic tumor
rules.checkpoint: 胰腺肿瘤的定位是否正确？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is pancreatic tumor localization correct?
rules.error_behavior: 错误将肿瘤定位于胰头，误判门静脉侵犯，选错手术方案
rules.correct_reasoning: 先准确定位胰腺肿瘤，明确门静脉受累情况再选术式，本例肿瘤位于胰体尾，无门静脉受累，应选远端胰腺切除术

rules.rule: Add follow-up time to post-op total for correct timeframe
rules.rule_en: Add follow-up time to post-op total for correct timeframe
rules.scenario: Calculating brake response normalization after ankle ORIF at 8-week follow-up
rules.scenario_en: Calculating brake response normalization after ankle ORIF at 8-week follow-up
rules.checkpoint: Did you add follow-up time to post-op total?
rules.checkpoint_en: Did you add follow-up time to post-op total?
rules.error_behavior: Misaligned post-op time with follow-up time, got wrong recovery interval
rules.correct_reasoning: Normalization is 9 weeks post-op; 8-week follow-up means 1 week from visit

rules.rule: 双侧枕叶颅内钙化优先考虑乳糜泻而非甲旁亢
rules.rule_en: Bilateral occipital intracranial calcification favors celiac disease over hyperparathyroidism
rules.scenario: CT见双侧枕叶颅内钙化需鉴别诊断时
rules.scenario_en: Differential diagnosis of bilateral occipital intracranial calcification on CT
rules.checkpoint: 钙化主要位于枕叶还是基底节？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is calcification in occipital lobe or basal ganglia?
rules.error_behavior: 误将双侧枕叶颅内钙化诊断为甲旁亢，错误排除乳糜泻
rules.correct_reasoning: 甲旁亢颅内钙化好发基底节，双侧枕叶钙化是乳糜泻的表现

rules.rule: 先确认CT序列和成像平面再解读主动脉病变
rules.rule_en: Confirm CT sequence and plane before interpreting aortic lesions
rules.scenario: 解读主动脉病变CT影像时
rules.scenario_en: When interpreting CT images of aortic lesions
rules.checkpoint: 是否确认了CT序列和成像平面？
rules.checkpoint_en: Have you confirmed CT sequence and imaging plane?
rules.error_behavior: 模型错误识别CT序列和成像平面，得出错误结论
rules.correct_reasoning: 先正确识别CT序列和成像平面，再判断病变进展

rules.rule: CT见膀胱壁内气体提示气肿性膀胱炎
rules.rule_en: Intramural bladder gas on CT indicates emphysematous cystitis
rules.scenario: 血尿患者CT发现膀胱气体需鉴别诊断时
rules.scenario_en: When differentiating bladder gas on CT in hematuria patients
rules.checkpoint: 气体位于膀胱壁内还是仅在膀胱腔？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is gas in bladder wall or only lumen?
rules.error_behavior: 误将膀胱壁内气体归为憩室炎所致膀胱结肠瘘，选错下一步处理
rules.correct_reasoning: 膀胱壁内气体提示气肿性膀胱炎，初始处理为保守抗生素治疗

rules.rule: 确诊肺栓塞伴近期出血性卒中，禁用抗凝选下腔静脉滤器
rules.rule_en: For PE with recent hemorrhagic stroke, use IVC filter instead of anticoagulation
rules.scenario: 确诊肺栓塞且患者近期有出血性卒中病史选择治疗方案
rules.scenario_en: When selecting treatment for confirmed PE with recent hemorrhagic stroke
rules.checkpoint: 患者是否存在抗凝禁忌证？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is there a contraindication to anticoagulation?
rules.error_behavior: 未识别近期出血性卒中为抗凝禁忌，错误选择抗凝治疗
rules.correct_reasoning: 先明确近期出血性卒中是抗凝禁忌，因此选择下腔静脉滤器

rules.rule: 确认盆腔CT高密度结构再诊断假体
rules.rule_en: Confirm high-density pelvic CT structures before diagnosing prosthesis
rules.scenario: 阅片盆腔CT进行Pipkin骨折分型时
rules.scenario_en: When reading pelvic CT for Pipkin fracture classification
rules.checkpoint: 是否正确区分了高密度影性质？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is the high-density property correctly identified?
rules.error_behavior: 错将正常皮质骨认成髋关节假体，致图像匹配错误
rules.correct_reasoning: 先逐一识别所有图像特征，再匹配分型选答案

rules.rule: 下肢沿浅静脉走行皮损勿误判为脂性硬皮病
rules.rule_en: Do not misdiagnose lower extremity lesions along superficial veins as lipodermatosclerosis
rules.scenario: 下肢沿浅静脉走行红斑色素沉着皮损的鉴别诊断
rules.scenario_en: Differential diagnosis of erythematous hyperpigmented lesions along lower extremity superficial veins
rules.checkpoint: 皮损是否沿浅静脉走行分布？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is the lesion along superficial vein?
rules.error_behavior: 误将沿浅静脉走行的线性皮损判为脂性硬皮病弥漫静息改变
rules.correct_reasoning: 沿浅静脉走行线性皮损符合浅静脉血栓性静脉炎，脂性硬皮病好发小腿踝周呈弥漫改变

rules.rule: 分析病因需严格遵循题干给出的临床时间线
rules.rule_en: Etiology analysis must strictly follow the given clinical timeline
rules.scenario: 分析肝移植术后患者皮疹伴胃肠症状病因
rules.scenario_en: Analyzing etiology of rash and GI symptoms post liver transplant
rules.checkpoint: 是否严格遵循题干给出的临床时间线？
rules.checkpoint_en: Does it strictly follow the given clinical timeline?
rules.error_behavior: 错把蜂蜇当致病抗原，混淆时间线误判为III型超敏
rules.correct_reasoning: 症状早于蜂蜇，免疫抑制不支持III型，IV型可累及皮胃肠，正确选D

rules.rule: 读腹部CT先定位病变，再排除憩室炎
rules.rule_en: When reading abdominal CT, localize lesion before ruling out diverticulitis
rules.scenario: 急诊腹痛患者行腹部CT读片时
rules.scenario_en: Reading abdominal CT for emergency patients with abdominal pain
rules.checkpoint: 是否正确定位了原发病变位置？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is the primary lesion correctly located?
rules.error_behavior: 误将病变定位于右下腹，误诊为阑尾炎，错误排除憩室炎
rules.correct_reasoning: 先正确定位原发异常病灶，不要仅凭错误初始定位排除憩室炎，检查乙状结肠是否有肠壁增厚和脂肪条索

rules.rule: CT见肠道不规则结构，先区分肠壁增厚/肿块再诊断
rules.rule_en: For irregular bowel structure on CT, distinguish wall thickening vs mass first
rules.scenario: 读CT片发现肠道区域不规则边界不清结构时
rules.scenario_en: When reading CT and finding irregular indistinct structure in bowel region
rules.checkpoint: 该结构是肠壁增厚还是肿块？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is it bowel wall thickening or a mass?
rules.error_behavior: 将增厚肠壁误判为局灶肿块，误诊为肠道恶性肿瘤
rules.correct_reasoning: 确认异常结构是增厚肠壁，符合炎症性肠病表现，应选A

rules.rule: 排除选项前需核对每个选项的所有组成部分
rules.rule_en: Check all components of each option before elimination
rules.scenario: 从多个不同组成的手术选项中选宫颈癌治疗方案
rules.scenario_en: Select cervical cancer treatment from multiple surgical options
rules.checkpoint: 是否核对了每个选项的所有组成？
rules.checkpoint_en: Did you check all components of each option?
rules.error_behavior: 错误将含清扫的选项和不含清扫的归为一类，用错理由排除正确选项
rules.correct_reasoning: 逐一核对每个选项内容，确认选项I包含淋巴结清扫，不应按无清扫排除，选出正确答案

rules.rule: 原始细胞>20%不能直接排除慢粒
rules.rule_en: >20% blasts cannot directly exclude CML
rules.scenario: 诊断白血病，外周血检出>20%原始细胞时
rules.scenario_en: Leukemia diagnosis with >20% blasts in peripheral blood
rules.checkpoint: 是否排除了慢性粒细胞白血病急变？
rules.checkpoint_en: Has CML blast crisis been ruled out?
rules.error_behavior: 错误认为>20%原始细胞可排除CML，无既往史排除急变
rules.correct_reasoning: CML可首发为急变期，存在>20%原始细胞，不能直接排除CML

rules.rule: 确认前列腺旁不对称致密结构的解剖再下诊断
rules.rule_en: Confirm anatomy of asymmetric periprostatic dense structure before diagnosis
rules.scenario: 读盆腔CT发现前列腺旁不对称致密结构时适用
rules.scenario_en: Applicable when asymmetric periprostatic dense structure found on pelvic CT
rules.checkpoint: 该前列腺旁结构是不是淋巴结？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is this periprostatic structure a lymph node?
rules.error_behavior: 误将前列腺旁肿大致密结构识别为精囊腺，排除淋巴结病变
rules.correct_reasoning: 先明确解剖结构，非精囊的不对称肿物需考虑淋巴结肿大

rules.rule: 评估脊髓空洞，先确认T2短缩/强化提示交通性
rules.rule_en: When evaluating syrinx, check T2 shortening/enhancement for communicating type
rules.scenario: MRI发现脊髓分隔样空洞，需明确病因时
rules.scenario_en: When septated spinal syrinx is found on MRI for etiology confirmation
rules.checkpoint: 是否存在T2短缩和空洞强化？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is there T2 shortening and syrinx enhancement?
rules.error_behavior: 错误否定交通性脊髓空洞，无依据假设空洞底部存在含血强化病灶
rules.correct_reasoning: 交通性空洞因脑脊液流动可出现T2短缩，造影剂进入可强化，需依影像判断

rules.rule: 膝外伤伴足背麻木先排查膝关节脱位
rules.rule_en: Check for knee dislocation after knee trauma with dorsum numbness
rules.scenario: 膝外伤后弹响卡压伴足背麻木读片时
rules.scenario_en: Reading knee imaging after trauma with popping, catching and dorsum numbness
rules.checkpoint: 是否存在膝关节脱位？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is knee dislocation present?
rules.error_behavior: 漏诊膝关节脱位，仅诊断半月板撕裂选错治疗

rules.correct_reasoning: 正确识别远端右主肺动脉充盈缺损同时延伸入右肺上下叶动脉，选择匹配选项

rules.checkpoint_en: Is the procedure matched to indication correctly?

rules.correct_reasoning: 外侧柱缩短需外侧延长截骨，该手术恢复跟骨高度可纠正跟骨畸形愈合继发的前踝撞击

rules.rule: 每条静脉回流曲线都有独立x截距，需正确识别

rules.checkpoint_en: Does each venous return curve have a distinct x-intercept?
rules.error_behavior: 模型错误认为所有静脉回流曲线x截距都在同一点
rules.correct_reasoning: 每条静脉回流曲线都有独立x截距，仅最上方曲线截距在V点，正确点是III点

rules.rule: 后入路髋臼手术，髋伸膝屈对坐骨神经压力最小
rules.rule_en: In posterior acetabular surgery, hip extension knee flexion exerts least sciatic nerve pressure

rules.checkpoint_en: Is the knee in option H flexed or extended?

rules.correct_reasoning: 屈膝放松坐骨神经降低张力，髋伸直缩短神经路径降压力，髋伸膝屈压力最小

rules.rule: <5岁儿童近期结核密接，阴性TST也需LTBI预防

rules.checkpoint: 本例是否需要预防性抗结核治疗？
rules.checkpoint_en: Does this case need prophylactic anti-TB therapy?
rules.error_behavior: 错误认为阴性TST就无需处理，忽略了儿童密接高风险
rules.correct_reasoning: 5岁以下近期结核密接，即使TST阴性，也需潜伏结核预防

rules.rule: 鉴别内膜增生vs癌，优先考虑弥漫光滑增厚而非囊肿

rules.scenario_en: Differentiating endometrial hyperplasia and endometrial carcinoma on pelvic MRI
rules.checkpoint: 病变是否为弥漫性光滑内膜增厚？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is the lesion diffusely smooth endometrial thickening?
rules.error_behavior: 高估了内膜高信号囊肿的特异性，低估了弥漫光滑增厚的诊断价值
rules.correct_reasoning: 高信号囊肿也可见于子宫内膜癌，无特异性；弥漫光滑内膜增厚更支持增生，癌多为不规则结节状增厚

rules.rule: Retroperitoneal mass near aorta: check aorta caliber first

rules.checkpoint_en: Is the aorta of normal caliber?
rules.error_behavior: Misidentified separate retroperitoneal mass as dilated aorta with mural thrombus
rules.correct_reasoning: First confirm aorta caliber. If normal, lesion is separate mass; heterogeneous enhancement suggests sarcoma

rules.rule: 急性肌肉血肿3天内无液体中明显血凝块
rules.rule_en: Acute muscle hematoma within 3 days has no distinct clots in fluid

rules.scenario_en: When evaluating ultrasound progression of muscle tear hematoma
rules.checkpoint: 急性血肿是否有液体中明显血凝块？
rules.checkpoint_en: Does acute hematoma have distinct clots in fluid?
rules.error_behavior: 错误认为36小时急性血肿已有液体中小凝血块
rules.correct_reasoning: 36h急性血肿仍处凝固期，无液体血块分离，该表现出现于液化后

rules.rule: 读胸部CT先识别胸腔积液再判断肺气肿分布
rules.rule_en: Identify pleural effusion first before assessing emphysema on chest CT
rules.scenario: 解读慢阻肺胸部CT，判断肺气肿及并发症时
rules.scenario_en: When interpreting chest CT for COPD to assess emphysema and complications
rules.checkpoint: 是否正确识别出右侧胸腔积液？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is right pleural effusion correctly identified?
rules.error_behavior: 未识别右侧胸腔积液，误判肺气肿分布和双侧皮下气肿
rules.correct_reasoning: 先识别右侧胸腔积液，再判断左肺中心小叶型肺气肿伴左为主蜂窝影

rules.rule: 疑似李斯特菌感染孕妇，先培养确诊再经验性治疗
rules.rule_en: For pregnant women with suspected Listeria, culture first before empiric therapy
rules.scenario: 孕妇出现非特异性症状，有乳制品暴露史，疑似李斯特菌感染时
rules.scenario_en: When pregnant woman has non-specific symptoms and dairy exposure, suspected Listeria
rules.checkpoint: 是否先做培养再经验性治疗？
rules.checkpoint_en: Do you culture before empiric therapy?
rules.error_behavior: 模型认为应直接予经验性氨苄西林，无需先培养确诊
rules.correct_reasoning: 仅非特异性症状加暴露史未确诊，应先培养明确诊断再治疗

rules.rule: Distinguish congenital vs acquired lung hypoplasia in tumor assessment
rules.rule_en: Distinguish congenital versus acquired lung hypoplasia in tumor assessment

rules.scenario_en: Assessing tumor progression sequence on chest CT with lung hypoplasia

rules.checkpoint_en: Is lung hypoplasia congenital or acquired?

rules.correct_reasoning: Confirm if lung hypoplasia is congenital or acquired before selecting answer

rules.rule: 腹平片见扩张肠袢，需排除脏器穿孔
rules.rule_en: When abdominal X-ray shows dilated bowel loops, exclude visceral perforation
rules.scenario: 腹平片见扩张肠袢阶梯征，无明确膈下游离气体
rules.scenario_en: Abdominal X-ray shows dilated bowel loops with stepladder sign, no obvious free subdiaphragmatic air
rules.checkpoint: 是否排除了脏器穿孔可能？
rules.checkpoint_en: Has visceral perforation been excluded?
rules.error_behavior: 仅见扩张肠袢阶梯征就诊断肠梗阻，排除穿孔
rules.correct_reasoning: 穿孔可继发肠梗阻，无游离气不能排除脏器穿孔

rules.rule: 胎儿SVT合并心衰/水肿，初始治疗首选地高辛
rules.rule_en: Digoxin is first-line initial treatment for fetal SVT with heart failure or hydrops
rules.scenario: 胎儿超声心动图提示SVT合并心衰水肿，选择初始治疗方案时
rules.scenario_en: When selecting initial treatment for fetal SVT with heart failure or hydrops detected by fetal echocardiography
rules.checkpoint: 胎儿SVT合并心衰初始治疗首选什么？
rules.checkpoint_en: What is the first-line treatment for fetal SVT with heart failure?
rules.error_behavior: 错误认为胎儿SVT合并心衰时β受体阻滞剂是一线初始治疗
rules.correct_reasoning: 先评估是否存在胎儿心衰水肿，合并心衰水肿时初始治疗首选地高辛，无合并心衰时首选β受体阻滞剂

rules.rule: Confirm HbA presence to differentiate sickle trait vs disease

rules.scenario_en: Interpreting sickle cell electrophoresis after abnormal newborn screen

rules.checkpoint_en: Is HbA present to distinguish trait vs disease?

rules.rule: EUS判断消化道病灶层次，需准确区分黏膜与黏膜下层

rules.rule: CT读片需依据影像，勿误判无膀胱结石为存在

rules.rule: 排除常见胰腺炎病因后，需考虑药物诱因

rules.scenario_en: When looking for specific etiology of acute pancreatitis

rules.checkpoint_en: Are common causes ruled out? Any drug etiology?
rules.error_behavior: 错误排除药物诱导胰腺炎，仅诊断笼统急性胰腺炎
rules.correct_reasoning: 排除常见病因后，2型糖友需考虑DPP-4抑制剂诱导胰腺炎

rules.rule: 评估慢性出血MRI时，需考虑所有血红蛋白分解成分

rules.scenario_en: When interpreting MRI signal characteristics of soft tissue hemorrhage in anticoagulated patients
rules.checkpoint: 是否考虑了所有血红蛋白分解成分？

rules.rule: 选答案前需确认疾病与病理图的对应关系

rules.scenario_en: Case question requiring matching clinical presentation to pathological figure
rules.checkpoint: 是否确认疾病与病理图对应关系？
rules.checkpoint_en: Have you confirmed disease-figure matching?

rules.correct_reasoning: 先明确对应疾病，再逐一核对病理图对应疾病后选答案

rules.checkpoint: 是否正确区分了两个外侧髁的位置?
rules.checkpoint_en: Did I correctly distinguish the two lateral epicondyles?

rules.correct_reasoning: 网球肘是肱骨外上髁炎，发病位置为肱骨外侧髁，而非股骨外侧髁

rules.rule: 定位WPW旁路先确认冠状窦电极远近端方向

rules.scenario_en: During electrophysiology study for WPW pathway localization
rules.checkpoint: 确认冠状窦电极的近端远端方向了吗？
rules.checkpoint_en: Have you confirmed CS electrode orientation?

rules.rule: 制定甲状腺癌手术方案前需确认CT上实际侵犯部位

rules.rule: Do not dismiss matching specific diagnosis for lack of explicit mention
rules.rule_en: Do not dismiss a matching specific diagnosis for lack of explicit mention

rules.scenario_en: Evaluating differential diagnosis of parotid neoplasm with ACTH-dependent Cushing syndrome
rules.checkpoint: Does diagnosis match all available clinical findings?
rules.checkpoint_en: Does diagnosis match all available clinical findings?

rules.rule: 盆腔复杂混信号肿块，勿忘卵巢皮样囊肿
rules.rule_en: Don't forget ovarian dermoid cyst for complex mixed-signal pelvic mass
rules.scenario: 读盆腔MRI发现复杂混合信号占位伴膀胱移位时

rules.checkpoint: 是否考虑了卵巢皮样囊肿可能？
rules.checkpoint_en: Have you considered ovarian dermoid cyst?

rules.rule: 问远期并发症时，选晚期病变而非早期表现

rules.checkpoint: 该并发症是早期还是晚期表现？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is this complication an early or late stage manifestation?

rules.correct_reasoning: 远期并发症指疾病晚期并发症，左室肥厚舒张功能不全是肢端肥大症心肌病早期表现，长期进展后才会出现心输出量降低

rules.rule: 诊断CTPA鞍状肺栓塞前，需确认双侧动脉受累

rules.correct_reasoning: 需确认充盈缺损是否同时伸入左右主肺动脉，仅累及右肺动脉则不是鞍状栓塞

rules.rule: 指骨边界清溶骨病变需考虑局限性骨髓炎

rules.checkpoint_en: Can a focal coronary lesion be pediatric vasculitis?
rules.error_behavior: 误将冠脉异常判为先天性畸形，错误认为血管炎仅引起多灶病变
rules.correct_reasoning: 儿童血管炎可出现局灶冠脉病变，不能仅因局灶病变排除血管炎

rules.rule: 脊髓损伤后重性抑郁障碍患病率范围为5-20%
rules.rule_en: The prevalence range of MDD after spinal cord injury is 5-20%
rules.scenario: 询问脊髓损伤患者重性抑郁障碍患病率范围时
rules.scenario_en: When inquiring MDD prevalence range in SCI patients
rules.checkpoint: 脊髓损伤后MDD患病率范围是多少？
rules.checkpoint_en: What is MDD prevalence after SCI?
rules.error_behavior: 错误记为15-40%，排除了正确范围5-20%
rules.correct_reasoning: 循证证据证实脊髓损伤后重性抑郁障碍患病率范围为5-20%

rules.rule: 孤立肌皮神经缺损提示损伤在神经而非外侧索
rules.rule_en: Isolated musculocutaneous deficit indicates nerve injury not lateral cord
rules.scenario: 定位臂丛损伤结构，存在孤立肌皮神经功能缺损时
rules.scenario_en: When localizing brachial plexus injury with isolated musculocutaneous deficit
rules.checkpoint: 是否存在所有预期损伤的功能缺损？
rules.checkpoint_en: Are all expected deficits present after injury?
rules.error_behavior: 错误将孤立肌皮神经功能缺损定位于外侧索，误认G为桡神经
rules.correct_reasoning: 外侧索损伤会同时累及肌皮神经和正中神经外侧根，出现额外缺损，孤立缺损提示损伤在肌皮神经本身

rules.rule: 腹膜反折下方低位直肠癌可保肛时首选LAR联合TME
rules.rule_en: Low rectal cancer below peritoneal reflection prefers LAR with TME for sphincter preservation
rules.scenario: 选择距肛缘3-5cm、腹膜反折下方可切除直肠癌手术方式时
rules.scenario_en: When selecting surgical approach for resectable rectal cancer 3-5cm from anal verge below peritoneal reflection
rules.checkpoint: 该肿瘤适合行LAR联合TME吗？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is the tumor suitable for LAR with TME?
rules.error_behavior: 错误将低位前切除术(LAR)限制于腹膜反折以上的高位直肠癌
rules.correct_reasoning: 腹膜反折下方距肛缘3-5cm未累及括约肌的直肠癌可行LAR联合TME

rules.rule: 诊断长骨佩吉特骨病需确认病变从骺/干骺端延伸
rules.rule_en: Confirm Paget's of long bone extends from epiphysis/metaphysis
rules.scenario: 阅片判断长骨佩吉特骨病时适用
rules.scenario_en: When diagnosing Paget's disease of long bone on X-ray
rules.checkpoint: 病变符合佩吉特骨病典型分布吗？
rules.checkpoint_en: Does lesion match typical Paget's distribution?
rules.error_behavior: 将长骨骨干局灶硬化病变误判为佩吉特骨病
rules.correct_reasoning: 佩吉特骨病长骨病变从骺/干骺端开始节段延伸，需符合分布再诊断

rules.rule: CT见肠外空气+造影剂，需先排除肠穿孔
rules.rule_en: When CT shows air+contrast outside bowel, rule out perforation first
rules.scenario: CT发现肠腔外混合空气与口服造影剂时
rules.scenario_en: When CT detects air mixed with oral contrast outside bowel lumen
rules.checkpoint: 是否已先排除肠穿孔？
rules.checkpoint_en: Has bowel perforation been ruled out first?
rules.error_behavior: 因无大量游离气体就排除肠穿孔，误诊为胃肠道瘘
rules.correct_reasoning: 少量肠外空气和造影剂仍符合肠穿孔，不能直接诊断瘘

rules.rule: 无视交叉压迫不能排除垂体大腺瘤，需评估垂体形态
rules.rule_en: Absence of optic chiasm compression cannot rule out pituitary macroadenoma, assess pituitary morphology
rules.scenario: 鞍区MRI检查需排除垂体大腺瘤时适用
rules.scenario_en: Applicable when ruling out pituitary macroadenoma on sellar MRI
rules.checkpoint: 是否仅靠无视交叉压迫排除大腺瘤？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is no chiasm compression enough to rule out macroadenoma?
rules.error_behavior: 错误认为无视交叉压迫即可排除垂体大腺瘤，错选B
rules.correct_reasoning: 垂体大腺瘤可局限于鞍内不压迫视交叉，正常形态垂体可排除诊断

rules.rule: 主动脉根部短轴超声需辨冠脉，勿漏右冠脉瘤样扩张
rules.rule_en: Identify coronary artery in short-axis aortic root echo, don't miss RCA aneurysmal dilatation
keywords_en: aneurysmal dilatation of right coronary artery
rules.scenario: 解读主动脉根部短轴超声心动图图像时
rules.scenario_en: When interpreting short-axis aortic root echocardiography images
rules.checkpoint: 你找到右冠脉了吗？它有没有扩张？
rules.checkpoint_en: Have you found the RCA and checked its dilation?
rules.error_behavior: 模型漏看右冠脉瘤样扩张，误判仅存二叶主动脉瓣选E
rules.correct_reasoning: 先辨认右冠脉观察管径，本例存在瘤样扩张应选C

rules.rule: 无异常体征性交疼痛，一线选认知行为治疗
rules.rule_en: For dyspareunia with normal exam, CBT is first-line
rules.scenario: 选择无异常体征性交疼痛患者的一线治疗方案
rules.scenario_en: Selecting first-line treatment for dyspareunia with normal exam
rules.checkpoint: 盆腔检查是否提示肌肉痉挛异常？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is there pelvic exam abnormality indicating spasm?
rules.error_behavior: 误判为阴道痉挛，错选盆底物理治疗为一线
rules.correct_reasoning: 患者盆腔检查正常无阴道痉挛证据，非器质性性交疼痛一线选CBT

rules.rule: 肺上叶肿瘤先确认位置，再判断临床表现
rules.rule_en: Confirm location of upper lobe lung tumor before judging clinical manifestations
rules.scenario: 已知右上肺鳞癌，推断对应临床表现时
rules.scenario_en: When inferring clinical manifestations for right upper lobe squamous cell carcinoma
rules.checkpoint: 是否确认了肿瘤的具体位置？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is the exact location of the tumor confirmed?
rules.error_behavior: 误将右上肺尖Pancoast瘤判为纵隔肺门肿块，错选SVC综合征
rules.correct_reasoning: 确认肿瘤为右上肺尖Pancoast瘤，其侵犯颈交感链致Horner综合征，出现瞳孔不等大

rules.rule: 评估肿瘤对比摄取时，需评估整个病灶而非仅边缘
rules.rule_en: When assessing tumor contrast uptake, evaluate entire lesion not just rim
rules.scenario: 对比增强MRI上鉴别不同脑肿瘤时
rules.scenario_en: When differentiating different brain tumors on contrast-enhanced MRI
rules.checkpoint: 是否评估了整个肿瘤的对比摄取?
rules.checkpoint_en: Was entire tumor contrast uptake evaluated?
rules.error_behavior: 错误仅评估肿瘤活性边缘，未评估整个肿瘤的对比摄取
rules.correct_reasoning: 评估肿瘤整体对比均匀性时需包含所有成分，第一例存在中央无坏死区，整体不均匀，排除A

rules.rule: 多发自发肌腱断裂合并小睾丸，需留尿查代谢病
rules.rule_en: Multiple spontaneous tendon ruptures with small testes: test urine for metabolic disorder
rules.scenario: 青年男性多发自发肌腱断裂伴小睾丸，选择检测标本
rules.scenario_en: Young male with multiple spontaneous tendon ruptures, selecting test specimen
rules.checkpoint: 是否整合了所有关键临床表现？
rules.checkpoint_en: Have you integrated all key clinical findings?
rules.error_behavior: 误判为遗传性结缔组织病，选择血液检测，未整合全表现
rules.correct_reasoning: 整合全部表现提示代谢病，需选择尿液标本检测

rules.rule: 胃内淡黄色物质，先区分性质再诊断
rules.rule_en: Distinguish type of yellowish gastric material before diagnosis
rules.scenario: 分析胃镜下胃炎表现，见胃内淡黄色液体时
rules.scenario_en: Analyzing gastritis findings on gastroscopy with yellowish fluid
rules.checkpoint: 是否区分淡黄色物质是渗出还是胆汁？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is yellowish material identified as exudate or bile?
rules.error_behavior: 误将淡黄色物质认定为胆汁，误诊为胆汁反流性胃炎
rules.correct_reasoning: 淡黄色物质可为急性糜烂性胃炎的炎性渗出，符合所有描述表现，应诊断该病

rules.rule: CTPA需仔细检查所有肺静脉有无充盈缺损
rules.rule_en: On CTPA, carefully check all pulmonary veins for filling defects
rules.scenario: 阅CT肺动脉造影片排查肺栓塞时
rules.scenario_en: When reviewing CTPA for pulmonary embolism
rules.checkpoint: 所有肺静脉都没有充盈缺损吗？
rules.checkpoint_en: Any filling defects in pulmonary veins?
rules.error_behavior: 模型漏诊肺静脉内充盈缺损，错误认为无充盈缺损
rules.correct_reasoning: 确认肺静脉数目后逐一检查每支有无充盈缺损

rules.rule: 双卵巢多发病变需对应匹配每个病变再诊断
rules.rule_en: Match each lesion of bilateral ovaries before diagnosis
rules.scenario: 超声发现双卵巢多发病变，鉴别多种卵巢囊肿时
rules.scenario_en: When multiple lesions found in bilateral ovaries on ultrasound for differential diagnosis
rules.checkpoint: 是否对应匹配每个卵巢病变？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is each ovarian lesion matched correctly?
rules.error_behavior: 错误将子宫内膜异位囊肿对应为分隔囊肿，误排正确选项
rules.correct_reasoning: 一侧小肿块为子宫内膜异位囊肿，另一侧为伴分隔单纯囊肿，符合选项B

rules.rule: 评估子宫肌瘤黏液变性DWI需考虑T2穿透效应
rules.rule_en: When evaluating DWI of myxoid fibroid, consider T2 shine-through
rules.scenario: 盆腔MRI评估子宫肌瘤黏液样变性时
rules.scenario_en: Evaluating myxoid degeneration of uterine fibroid on pelvic MRI
rules.checkpoint: 是否考虑了T2穿透效应对DWI的影响
rules.checkpoint_en: Did you account for T2 shine-through on DWI
rules.error_behavior: 错误认为高ADC信号必然对应低DWI信号，忽略T2穿透效应
rules.correct_reasoning: 黏液变性子宫肌瘤含水量高，即使ADC高(扩散自由)，DWI也可因T2穿透效应呈高信号

rules.rule: 未接种麻疹患儿，首要需警惕SSPE并发症
rules.rule_en: Unvaccinated children with measles should first alert for SSPE
rules.scenario: 未接种疫苗的麻疹患儿判断首要并发症
rules.scenario_en: Identifying primary complication for unvaccinated children with measles
rules.checkpoint: 未接种麻疹患儿首要需警惕SSPE吗？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is SSPE the primary complication of concern?
rules.error_behavior: 模型错误认为急性麻疹首要并发症是急性脑炎，排除SSPE
rules.correct_reasoning: 确诊麻疹后，SSPE是最严重致死并发症，未接种患儿需首要警惕

rules.rule: 高危神经母细胞瘤放疗需加诱导化疗后持续MIBG转移灶
rules.rule_en: Add persistent MIBG-avid metastases after induction chemotherapy for RT
rules.scenario: 确定高危神经母细胞瘤放疗靶区范围时
rules.scenario_en: When determining radiation target volume for high-risk neuroblastoma
rules.checkpoint: 是否加诱导化疗后持续MIBG转移灶?
rules.checkpoint_en: Add persistent MIBG metastasis after induction chemotherapy?
rules.error_behavior: 错误认为需加预防性区域淋巴结放疗，选错答案
rules.correct_reasoning: 仅需加诱导化疗后持续MIBG亲和转移灶，正确答案是D

rules.rule: 鹰嘴骨折先评估可重建性，而非固定百分比阈值
rules.rule_en: Olecranon fracture: evaluate reconstructibility not fixed percentage threshold
rules.scenario: 老年患者合并骨质疏松、RA，近端鹰嘴重度粉碎骨折选术式
rules.scenario_en: Elderly patient with osteoporosis and RA, selecting surgery for severely comminuted proximal olecranon fracture
rules.checkpoint: 该骨折是否可稳定重建？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is this fracture stably reconstructible?
rules.error_behavior: 错误用固定50%阈值判断，忽略重度粉碎和差骨质量无法固定
rules.correct_reasoning: 先评估骨折可重建性，本例重度粉碎+骨质疏松+RA，骨质量差无法固定，选碎骨切除+三头肌前移

rules.rule: 非二氢吡啶类CCB也可引起牙龈增生
rules.rule_en: Non-dihydropyridine CCB can also cause gingival hyperplasia
keywords: 非二氢吡啶类钙通道阻滞剂
rules.scenario: 判断非二氢吡啶类CCB用于房颤的最可能不良反应
rules.scenario_en: When determining the most likely adverse effect of non-dihydropyridine CCB used for atrial fibrillation
rules.checkpoint: 非二氢吡啶类CCB会引起牙龈增生吗？
rules.checkpoint_en: Can non-DHP CCB cause gingival hyperplasia?
rules.error_behavior: 错误认为牙龈增生仅见于二氢吡啶类CCB，误选便秘
rules.correct_reasoning: 非二氢吡啶类CCB也可引起牙龈增生，需牢记该不良反应

rules.rule: 胸水超声见回声颗粒需考虑渗出性胸水
rules.rule_en: Consider exudative pleural effusion when echogenic particles are seen on ultrasound
rules.scenario: 超声检查评估胸腔积液性质时
rules.scenario_en: When evaluating the nature of pleural effusion by ultrasound
rules.checkpoint: 胸水是否存在回声漂浮颗粒？
rules.checkpoint_en: Are there echogenic floating particles in pleural fluid?
rules.error_behavior: 误将含回声漂浮颗粒的渗出性胸水认作无回声漏出性胸水
rules.correct_reasoning: 观察胸水内部回声，存在回声颗粒提示渗出性胸水

rules.rule: 4th branchial fistula causes unilateral not bilateral thyroid infection
rules.rule_en: Fourth branchial fistula causes unilateral not bilateral thyroid infection
rules.scenario: Evaluating bilateral thyroid infection with left embryological predisposition
rules.scenario_en: Evaluating bilateral thyroid infection with left embryological predisposition
rules.checkpoint: Does 4th branchial fistula cause bilateral infection?
rules.checkpoint_en: Does fourth branchial fistula cause bilateral infection?
rules.error_behavior: Misrepresented 4th branchial fistula presentation, incorrectly thought it causes bilateral thyroid infection, selected wrong option F
rules.correct_reasoning: 4th branchial arch fistula almost always causes unilateral left-sided thyroid infection, not bilateral. Extensive bilateral thyroid infection in immunocompromised patients is bacterial thyroiditis, matching option A.

rules.rule: 热退4天后出疹先考虑微小病毒B19感染
rules.rule_en: If rash occurs 4 days after fever resolution, suspect parvovirus B19 first
rules.scenario: 幼儿发热退后出疹，鉴别HHV6和微小病毒B19
rules.scenario_en: Differentiating HHV-6 and parvovirus B19 in toddler with post-febrile rash
rules.checkpoint: 出疹距离发热消退间隔多久？
rules.checkpoint_en: How long after fever resolution did rash appear?
rules.error_behavior: 错将热退4天后出疹诊为HHV-6幼儿急疹，误排微小病毒B19
rules.correct_reasoning: 幼儿急疹热退24h内出疹，躯干先发；本例热退4天面部先发疹，符合微小病毒B19感染

rules.rule: 勿将无关图像标注误用作当前病例诊断依据
rules.rule_en: Do not misapply unrelated image labels as diagnostic basis
rules.scenario: 分析多图病例，部分为其他病例示例时
rules.scenario_en: When analyzing multi-image cases with some being other examples
rules.checkpoint: 是否误用了无关图像标注做诊断？
rules.checkpoint_en: Did you misapply unrelated image labels for diagnosis?
rules.error_behavior: 误将其他病例图像的JRA标注用作当前病例诊断依据
rules.correct_reasoning: 先明确各图对应内容，基于当前病例表现推导诊断

rules.rule: Tile C不稳定骨盆骨折，前后环联合内固定稳定性最优
rules.rule_en: For unstable Tile C pelvic fracture, combined internal fixation of both rings is most stable
rules.scenario: 评估Tile C型不稳定骨盆骨折固定方式稳定性
rules.scenario_en: Evaluating stability of fixation for Tile C unstable pelvic fracture
rules.checkpoint: 是否已比较整体固定结构稳定性？
rules.checkpoint_en: Has overall construct stability been compared?
rules.error_behavior: 错误认为后环桥接+前环外固定更稳定，未考虑前环内固定刚性更强，引入无关临床因素
rules.correct_reasoning: Tile C骨盆骨折需比较整体稳定性，前后环联合内固定稳定性更高

rules.rule: 分级IPP需遵循大小阈值，同时检查是否存在钙化
rules.rule_en: Grade IPP by size thresholds and check for calcification
rules.scenario: 对膀胱内前列腺突出进行分级，评估钙化和外周带受压时
rules.scenario_en: When grading intravesical prostatic protrusion and assessing calcification and peripheral zone compression
rules.checkpoint: 是否按大小阈值分级并检查钙化？
rules.checkpoint_en: Did you grade by size thresholds and check calcification?
rules.error_behavior: 错误将1级膀胱内前列腺突出评为3级，漏诊钙化
rules.correct_reasoning: 先按突出大小分级IPP，<5mm为1级，再确认钙化及外周带受压。本例为1级，伴钙化和外周带受压。

rules.rule: 准确记忆Spencer手法各阶段操作内容
rules.rule_en: Accurately remember operation of each stage of Spencer technique
rules.scenario: 确定Spencer技术第六阶段操作的场景
rules.scenario_en: When identifying the operation of the sixth stage of Spencer technique
rules.checkpoint: 是否准确记忆Spencer第六阶段操作？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is 6th stage of Spencer technique correctly remembered?
rules.error_behavior: 错误混淆了Spencer手法各阶段操作内容，误选D
rules.correct_reasoning: 准确记忆各阶段操作，第六阶段对应H选项描述的操作

rules.rule: 一级亲属60岁前患结直肠癌，筛查从40岁或早10年开始
rules.rule_en: Screening starts at 40 or 10y earlier if 1st-degree relative gets CRC <60y
rules.scenario: 制定有一级亲属结直肠癌家族史患者的筛查方案
rules.scenario_en: Formulating screening plan for patient with 1st-degree relative CRC history
rules.checkpoint: 是否按USPSTF规则计算筛查起始年龄？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is starting age calculated per USPSTF guidelines?
rules.error_behavior: 错误限定筛查仅限本次产检，误判了筛查起始年龄
rules.correct_reasoning: 本题不限筛查为产前项目，按USPSTF，本例应40岁开始结肠镜筛查

rules.rule: 肾上腺CT低密度灶先区分囊液脂肪再诊断
rules.rule_en: Distinguish cystic fluid from fat first for low-density adrenal lesions on CT
rules.scenario: 判断含钙化肾上腺低密度CT病变性质时
rules.scenario_en: When determining the nature of calcified low-density adrenal lesions on CT
rules.checkpoint: 是否区分了病灶是囊液还是脂肪？
rules.checkpoint_en: Has cystic fluid or fat been distinguished?
rules.error_behavior: 将中央囊性低密度误判为脂肪密度，错选髓脂肪瘤
rules.correct_reasoning: 先区分低密度性质，本例中央囊性低密度符合囊液，对应出血后内皮囊肿

rules.rule: 盆腔病变先确认准确解剖位置再诊断
rules.rule_en: Confirm accurate anatomical location before diagnosing pelvic lesions
rules.scenario: 尿路X线造影读片判断肾脏位置和盆腔尿道病变时
rules.scenario_en: When reading urinary tract radiography for renal position and pelvic urethral lesions
rules.checkpoint: 是否确认病变准确解剖位置？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is accurate anatomical location of the lesion confirmed?
rules.error_behavior: 误将左盆腔输尿管结石认作阴茎尿道结石，错排右异位肾
rules.correct_reasoning: 先确认右肾不在正常肾窝提示右异位盆腔肾，再确认盆腔高密度位于左输尿管而非尿道，结合造影见阴茎尿道狭窄

rules.rule: 盆腔附件异质性肿块需T1压脂排除卵巢皮样囊肿

rules.checkpoint: 肋骨功能障碍依据什么命名？
rules.checkpoint_en: What is rib dysfunction named based on?
rules.error_behavior: 模型错误按受限运动方向命名，颠倒了命名规则
rules.correct_reasoning: 按卡住位置命名：卡吸气位是吸气功能障碍，卡呼气位是呼气功能障碍

rules.rule: 当多个选项符合SLE时，选择满足经典SLE诊断标准的选项
rules.rule_en: When multiple options fit SLE, select the one meeting classic SLE diagnostic criteria
rules.scenario: 多个选项均描述与利班萨克斯心内膜炎相关的SLE患者
rules.scenario_en: Multiple answer options all describe SLE patients associated with Libman-Sacks endocarditis
rules.checkpoint: 哪个选项满足经典SLE诊断标准？
rules.checkpoint_en: Which option meets classic SLE diagnostic criteria?
rules.error_behavior: 模型无合理理由选择了非经典SLE表现的选项G，未选正确的A
rules.correct_reasoning: 病变为SLE相关的利班萨克斯心内膜炎，A和G均为SLE，A满足经典SLE诊断标准，应选A

rules.rule: 单侧肺容积缩小需先排查纤维化再诊发育不全
rules.rule_en: Check fibrosis before hypoplasia for unilateral lung volume loss
rules.scenario: 胸部CT见单侧肺容积缩小伴对侧代偿性增大
rules.scenario_en: Chest CT shows unilateral lung volume loss with contralateral compensatory enlargement
rules.checkpoint: 是否存在纤维化相关影像学改变？
rules.checkpoint_en: Are there fibrosis-related imaging findings?
rules.error_behavior: 错误排除纤维化病因，无依据诊断先天性肺发育不全
rules.correct_reasoning: 先排查纤维化改变，优先考虑炎症后纤维化致容积损失

rules.rule: 勿忽略肾上极描述，需考虑肾脏病变诊断
rules.rule_en: Do not ignore upper pole descriptor, consider renal diagnosis
rules.scenario: 题干同时提及肾上极和尿道异常的超声诊断
rules.scenario_en: Ultrasound diagnosis where question mentions both renal upper pole and urethral abnormalities
rules.checkpoint: 是否考虑了肾上极病变提示？
rules.checkpoint_en: Did you consider upper pole lesion clue?
rules.error_behavior: 忽视肾上极描述，错误排除慢性肾盂肾炎
rules.correct_reasoning: 覆盖题干所有描述，肾上极提示肾病，慢性肾盂肾炎可解释二者表现

rules.rule: 定位肺栓塞时，需准确区分肺动脉各叶分支
rules.rule_en: When localizing PE, accurately distinguish pulmonary artery lobar branches
keywords_en: left upper lobe pulmonary artery branch
left lower lobe pulmonary artery branch
rules.scenario: CT肺血管造影定位肺栓塞叶段延伸范围时
rules.scenario_en: Localizing lobar extension of pulmonary embolism on CT pulmonary angiography
rules.checkpoint: 是否准确区分了肺动脉各叶分支位置？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is the location of pulmonary artery branches accurately distinguished?
rules.error_behavior: 错误将左肺动脉肺栓塞延伸定位到左下叶分支而非左上叶
rules.correct_reasoning: 先明确左肺动脉各叶分支走行，确认栓子延伸入左上叶分支再判断

rules.rule: 判断胆总管病理扩张需结合后方声影，不唯直径
rules.rule_en: Judge pathological CBD dilation by posterior acoustic shadowing
rules.scenario: 超声评估老年患者胆总管扩张是否为病理性
rules.scenario_en: Evaluating pathological CBD dilation in elderly patients on ultrasound
rules.checkpoint: 是否结合后方声影判断？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is posterior acoustic shadowing considered?
rules.error_behavior: 错误认为直径越大越肯定是病理性，忽略后方声影提示梗阻的价值
rules.correct_reasoning: 病理扩张需要梗阻征象，不能仅以直径判断，大直径也可为生理改变

rules.rule: 诊断需基于患者自身表现，而非接触者病变
rules.rule_en: Diagnosis should be based on patient's own findings, not contact's lesions
rules.scenario: 患者存在皮肤病变且有接触他人皮肤病史时
rules.scenario_en: When a patient has a skin lesion and a history of contact with another person's skin disease
rules.checkpoint: 诊断是否基于患者自身皮肤表现？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is the diagnosis based on the patient's own skin findings?
rules.error_behavior: 错误将祖父的水疱病变套用到患者身上，忽略患者自身的樱桃状血管瘤皮损，误诊为病毒感染
rules.correct_reasoning: 诊断需基于患者自身的皮损表现，本例为樱桃状血管瘤，属于良性毛细血管增生，接触史是干扰信息

rules.rule: Before hip fracture management, first correctly classify fracture location
rules.rule_en: Before hip fracture management, first correctly classify fracture location
rules.scenario: Elderly fall patient with clinical hip fracture planning management
rules.scenario_en: Elderly fall patient with clinical hip fracture planning management
rules.checkpoint: Is the fracture intracapsular or intertrochanteric?
rules.checkpoint_en: Is the fracture intracapsular or intertrochanteric?
rules.error_behavior: Misclassified intertrochanteric fracture as displaced intracapsular femoral neck fracture
rules.correct_reasoning: First confirm fracture location on x-ray: intertrochanteric fractures use intramedullary nail fixation, displaced intracapsular fractures in elderly use hemiarthroplasty

rules.rule: 诊断食管动力障碍需整合所有提供的影像结果
rules.rule_en: Diagnose esophageal motility disorder using all provided imaging findings
rules.scenario: 诊断食管动力障碍且提供多幅影像资料时
rules.scenario_en: When diagnosing esophageal motility disorder with multiple images provided
rules.checkpoint: 是否整合了所有影像结果进行诊断？
rules.checkpoint_en: Are all imaging findings integrated for diagnosis?
rules.error_behavior: 仅依据第一幅图像误诊为弥漫性食管痉挛，未整合全部影像
rules.correct_reasoning: 整合所有影像表现，识别无蠕动、重力排空符合硬皮病食管

rules.rule: 颈动脉造影先确认早期海绵窦显影，再判断MCA闭塞
rules.rule_en: Confirm early cavernous sinus opacification before judging MCA occlusion on carotid angiography
rules.scenario: 读颈动脉脑血管造影，判断颅内血管病变时
rules.scenario_en: When interpreting carotid cerebral angiography for intracranial vascular lesions
rules.checkpoint: 是否存在早期海绵窦显影？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is there early cavernous sinus opacification?
rules.error_behavior: 错误否认早期海绵窦显影，误将CCF诊断为MCA闭塞
rules.correct_reasoning: 先观察动脉期造影是否存在早期海绵窦显影，存在则支持CCF，无则再判断MCA是否闭塞

rules.rule: 连续ECG节律条应视为单条记录，不能拆分解读
rules.rule_en: A continuous ECG rhythm strip should be treated as a single recording, cannot be split
rules.scenario: 解读胸痛患者带有连续节律条的心电图时
rules.scenario_en: Interpreting ECG with continuous rhythm strip for chest pain patient
rules.checkpoint: 该节律条是连续单条还是分段的？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is the rhythm strip a single continuous one?
rules.error_behavior: 误将单条连续节律条拆分为基线和异常两个独立节段
rules.correct_reasoning: 连续单条节律条来自同一记录周期，所有心搏形态一致，需整体解读

rules.rule: 胃结肠瘘伴胃结肠间增厚优先考虑腺癌侵犯
rules.rule_en: Gastrocolic fistula with interposed thickening prioritize adenocarcinoma invasion
rules.scenario: CT发现胃结肠瘘伴胃结肠间增厚鉴别病因
rules.scenario_en: Differential diagnosis of CT-found gastrocolic fistula with thickening between stomach and colon
rules.checkpoint: 增厚是否为肿瘤直接侵犯？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is the thickening caused by direct tumor invasion?
rules.error_behavior: 错误将增厚归为炎性改变，优先考虑克罗恩病
rules.correct_reasoning: 胃结肠瘘伴胃结肠间增厚应首先考虑腺癌直接侵犯

rules.rule: 髋关节融合术应保留5°轻度内收优化预后
rules.rule_en: Hip arthrodesis requires 5° slight adduction for optimal outcome
rules.scenario: 髋关节融合术治疗股骨头骨骺滑脱继发重度髋关节炎
rules.scenario_en: Hip arthrodesis for severe hip arthritis secondary to slipped capital femoral epiphysis
rules.checkpoint: 髋关节融合术允许轻度5°内收吗？
rules.checkpoint_en: Does hip arthrodesis allow 5° slight adduction?
rules.error_behavior: 错误认为髋关节融合术不能存在内收，排除正确选项
rules.correct_reasoning: 髋关节融合术最优功能位需轻度5°内收，利于步态和骨盆对位

rules.rule: 区分乳腺吸收剂量与全身有效辐射剂量
rules.rule_en: Distinguish absorbed dose from effective dose in mammography
rules.scenario: 比较CAC扫描与乳腺摄影辐射剂量，判断男女CAC患病率
rules.scenario_en: When comparing radiation dose of CAC scan and mammography, and judging CAC prevalence between men and women of similar age and risk factor burden
rules.checkpoint: 是否区分吸收剂量与有效剂量？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is absorbed dose distinguished from effective dose?
rules.error_behavior: 混淆乳腺吸收剂量与全身有效剂量，高估乳腺辐射剂量，错选答案
rules.correct_reasoning: 乳腺筛查摄影有效剂量约0.4-1.0mSv，同年龄同危险因素女性CAC患病率低于男性

rules.rule: 无症状房颤率已控制，优先 lifestyle 改而非用药
rules.rule_en: Asymptomatic AF with controlled rate, prioritize lifestyle modification over meds
rules.scenario: 无症状心房颤动，静息心室率已控制达标
rules.scenario_en: Asymptomatic atrial fibrillation with well-controlled resting ventricular rate
rules.checkpoint: 心室率已经得到良好控制了吗？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is ventricular rate already well controlled?
rules.error_behavior: 错误认为需要加用降心率药物，误将心率差归为脉搏短绌，低估生活方式干预的地位
rules.correct_reasoning: 无症状房颤且心室率已达标无需额外药物，肥胖是可纠正危险因素，指南推荐生活方式调整作为一线附加管理

rules.rule: 头颅CT勿将正常大脑镰误判为硬膜下出血
rules.rule_en: Do not misinterpret normal falx cerebri as subdural hemorrhage on head CT
rules.scenario: 阅读头颅CT判断是否存在硬膜下出血时
rules.scenario_en: When reading head CT to judge presence of subdural hemorrhage
rules.checkpoint: 是否误将正常结构判为出血？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is normal structure misjudged as hemorrhage?
rules.error_behavior: 将正常大脑镰误判为双侧亚临床硬膜下出血
rules.correct_reasoning: 先区分正常解剖结构，确认是否存在病理出血征象

rules.rule: 诊断焦虑时，应优先选择贴合情境的最特异诊断
rules.rule_en: When diagnosing anxiety, prefer the most specific diagnosis fitting the context
rules.scenario: 面对存在明确特定学业应激源的焦虑病例时
rules.scenario_en: When dealing with anxiety cases with clear specific academic stressors
rules.checkpoint: 是否选择了最具特异性的诊断？
rules.checkpoint_en: Have you selected the most specific diagnosis?
rules.error_behavior: 错误套用通用诊断框架，排除更特异的正确诊断
rules.correct_reasoning: 优先选择最贴合临床情境的特异性诊断，而非宽泛分类

rules.rule: Base diagnosis on provided image findings, not external knowledge
rules.rule_en: Base diagnosis on provided image findings, not external knowledge
rules.scenario: Diagnosing pneumonia from given chest radiograph findings
rules.scenario_en: Diagnosing pneumonia from given chest radiograph findings
rules.checkpoint: Are you using only provided image findings?
rules.checkpoint_en: Are you using only provided image findings?
rules.error_behavior: Reliance on external prior knowledge instead of given image findings led to wrong diagnosis
rules.correct_reasoning: Use only explicitly provided image information to match findings to diagnosis

rules.rule: 见意面样支气管血管改变，先区分分布再诊断
rules.rule_en: Distinguish distribution first for maggie noodle bronchovascular changes
rules.scenario: 胸片鉴别肺纤维化病因时
rules.scenario_en: Differential diagnosis of pulmonary fibrosis on chest radiograph
rules.checkpoint: 是否正确区分了纤维化分布？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is fibrosis distribution correctly distinguished?
rules.error_behavior: 错将沿支气管血管束走行的意面样改变归为结节病
rules.correct_reasoning: 从肺门到外周指走行方向，IPF也可呈该表现

rules.rule: 腰椎MRI阅片需留意椎间盘下方游离碎片
rules.rule_en: Check for sequestrated fragment below lumbar disc on MRI
rules.scenario: 阅读腰椎MRI判断腰椎间盘病变时
rules.scenario_en: When evaluating lumbar disc disease via lumbar MRI
rules.checkpoint: 是否存在椎间盘游离碎片？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is there any sequestrated disc fragment?
rules.error_behavior: 误将L4-L5下方游离碎片认作弥漫性椎间盘膨出
rules.correct_reasoning: 观察椎间盘间隙及周围，识别与原发椎间盘分离的游离碎片

rules.rule: 环形焦痂致骨筋膜室综合征首选焦痂切开
rules.rule_en: Escharotomy is first-line for circumferential eschar-induced compartment syndrome
rules.scenario: 环形烧伤并发焦痂诱导性骨筋膜室综合征诊疗
rules.scenario_en: Clinical diagnosis and treatment of eschar-induced compartment syndrome after circumferential burn
rules.checkpoint: 是否为焦痂诱导的骨筋膜室综合征？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is it eschar-induced compartment syndrome?
rules.error_behavior: 错误将筋膜切开作为本病首选，优先于焦痂切开
rules.correct_reasoning: 环形焦痂诱导骨筋膜室综合征首选焦痂切开，筋膜切开仅用于焦痂切开无效后

rules.rule: 胆汁酸螯合剂最常见不良反应为脂肪吸收不良而非胆石
rules.rule_en: The most common adverse effect of bile acid sequestrants is fat malabsorption not gallstones
rules.scenario: 判断胆汁酸螯合剂降脂治疗的最可能不良反应
rules.scenario_en: Judging the most likely adverse effect of bile acid sequestrant lipid-lowering therapy
rules.checkpoint: 是否为胆汁酸螯合剂常见不良反应？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is it a common adverse effect of bile acid sequestrants?
rules.error_behavior: 错误认为胆石症是胆汁酸螯合剂的常见不良反应
rules.correct_reasoning: 胆汁酸螯合剂结合肠道胆汁酸，减少脂肪乳化吸收，最常见不良反应是脂肪吸收不良，胆石症不是其常见不良反应

rules.rule: 排除肺栓塞不能仅靠无楔形梗死灶
rules.rule_en: Pulmonary embolism can't be ruled out only by absent wedge infarct
rules.scenario: 读胸部X线片鉴别呼吸困难病因时
rules.scenario_en: When identifying dyspnea etiology via chest radiograph
rules.checkpoint: 是否仅靠无楔形灶排除肺栓塞？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is PE ruled out only by absent wedge infarct?
rules.error_behavior: 误判不存在肺静脉头化和淤血，仅靠无楔形灶排除肺栓塞，错选二尖瓣狭窄
rules.correct_reasoning: 楔形梗死灶对肺栓塞不敏感，不能仅靠它排除；本例无二尖瓣狭窄典型影像，不应诊断

rules.rule: 鉴别UBC和ABC需看位置和液液平面数量
rules.rule_en: Differentiate UBC and ABC by location and fluid-fluid level count
rules.scenario: 青少年股骨近端囊性骨病变鉴别诊断
rules.scenario_en: Differential diagnosis of cystic bone lesions in adolescent proximal femur
rules.checkpoint: 是否核对病灶位置和液液平面数量？
rules.checkpoint_en: Did you check lesion location and fluid level count?
rules.error_behavior: 错误认定存在多个液液平面，误称单纯性骨囊肿不会有液液平面，忽略位置差异
rules.correct_reasoning: 单纯性骨囊肿多位于干骺端中央，可单个液液平面；动脉瘤样骨囊肿多偏心，有多个液液平面

rules.rule: 芳香化酶缺陷可致胎儿期高雄激素外阴男性化
rules.rule_en: Aromatase deficiency can cause fetal hyperandrogenism and genital virilization
rules.scenario: 鉴别先天性类固醇异常所致原发性闭经伴高雄激素
rules.scenario_en: Differential diagnosis of primary amenorrhea with hyperandrogenism
rules.checkpoint: 芳香化酶缺陷会有外阴男性化吗
rules.checkpoint_en: Does aromatase deficiency cause genital virilization
rules.error_behavior: 错误认为芳香化酶缺陷无出生时外阴男性化，排除正确选项
rules.correct_reasoning: 芳香化酶缺陷使雄激素无法转化为雌激素，胎儿期高雄激素会致外阴男性化，符合本例表现

rules.rule: 前列腺PI-RADS 5可含可疑EPE，需区分是否确诊EPE
rules.rule_en: PI-RADS 5 prostate lesions can have suspicious EPE, distinguish definite EPE
rules.scenario: 前列腺MRI PI-RADS评分判断前列腺癌分期时
rules.scenario_en: When staging prostate cancer with PI-RADS scoring on prostate MRI
rules.checkpoint: 是否区分可疑与确诊的包膜外延伸？
rules.checkpoint_en: Did you distinguish suspicious vs definite EPE?
rules.error_behavior: 错误认为PI-RADS 5必须有确诊EPE，误判可疑EPE为确诊EPE
rules.correct_reasoning: PI-RADS 5可满足PI-RADS 4加≥1.5cm或确诊EPE，仅可疑EPE也可归为PI-RADS 5

rules.rule: 确认提供的检验参数后再进行推理
rules.rule_en: Confirm the provided lab parameters before reasoning
rules.scenario: 题目提及含未知实验室结果的图表时
rules.scenario_en: When the question references a figure with unknown lab results
rules.checkpoint: 你确认过提供的检验参数吗？
rules.checkpoint_en: Have you confirmed the provided lab parameters?
rules.error_behavior: 错误假设检验是血钠和尿渗透压，未确认实际参数
rules.correct_reasoning: 先明确提供的具体检验参数，再结合诊断推理

rules.rule: Do not misattribute hypopigmentation to CGD
rules.rule_en: Do not misattribute hypopigmentation to CGD
rules.scenario: Diagnosing pediatric primary immunodeficiency from clinical features
rules.scenario_en: Diagnosing pediatric primary immunodeficiency from clinical features
rules.checkpoint: Is hypopigmentation a feature of CGD?
rules.checkpoint_en: Is hypopigmentation a feature of CGD?
rules.error_behavior: Incorrectly claimed hypopigmentation/blond hair is a feature of CGD
rules.correct_reasoning: CGD NADPH oxidase is phagocyte-specific, doesn't cause hypopigmentation; delayed cord separation is not CGD feature, CGD doesn't cause recurrent viral infections

rules.rule: 新生儿胎粪排出延迟：用直肠指检区分巨结肠与胎粪性肠梗阻
rules.rule_en: For neonatal failure to pass meconium: use DRE findings to distinguish Hirschsprung from meconium ileus
rules.scenario: 评估新生儿胎粪排出延迟、胆汁性呕吐合并唐氏特征时
rules.scenario_en: When evaluating neonate with failure to pass meconium, bilious vomiting and Down syndrome features
rules.checkpoint: 直肠指检是否排出粪便和气体？
rules.checkpoint_en: Does digital rectal exam release stool and gas?
rules.error_behavior: 错误排除先天性巨结肠，误判直肠指检结果且错联唐氏与胎粪性肠梗阻
rules.correct_reasoning: 直肠指检排粪排气符合先天性巨结肠，唐氏是前者危险因素而非胎粪性肠梗阻

rules.rule: 急腹症腹部CT先查结肠，再判断小肠梗阻
rules.rule_en: Check colon first before diagnosing SBO on acute abdomen CT
rules.scenario: 急诊科急腹症患者行腹部CT阅片诊断
rules.scenario_en: Reading abdominal CT for acute abdomen patient in ED
rules.checkpoint: 是否观察到结肠异常征象？
rules.checkpoint_en: Have colon abnormalities been found?
rules.error_behavior: 误判充盈小肠为扩张梗阻，漏诊乙状结肠憩室炎
rules.correct_reasoning: 全面观察肠段，本例见乙状结肠肠壁增厚伴脂肪条索影，符合憩室炎，无SBO证据

rules.rule: 描述T2信号强度需以肌层/肌肉为参照，而非尿液
rules.rule_en: Characterize T2 signal relative to myometrium/muscle not urine
rules.scenario: 读MRI T2图像判断宫颈癌分期，描述病变信号时
rules.scenario_en: Reading MRI T2 images for cervical carcinoma staging, describing lesion signal
rules.checkpoint: 是否以肌层/肌肉为参照描述T2信号？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is T2 signal referenced to myometrium/muscle?

rules.rule: 见远端股骨锥形瓶畸形应首先考虑戈谢病

rules.rule: 发热性中性粒细胞减少先分层，低风险可门诊口服

rules.correct_reasoning: 先确认股骨头位置正常，正常髋臼后软骨下份比上份厚

rules.rule: 寻找影像学鉴别特征时，勿选择镜下组织学发现
rules.rule_en: When seeking imaging distinguishing features, ignore microscopic histology findings
rules.scenario: 基于影像学鉴别子宫平滑肌肉瘤和变性肌瘤
rules.scenario_en: Distinguishing uterine leiomyosarcoma from degenerating fibroid based on imaging
rules.checkpoint: 该发现是影像学特征吗？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is the finding an imaging-based feature?
rules.error_behavior: 模型选择镜下组织学发现而非影像学发现，忽略了子宫边界侵犯
rules.correct_reasoning: 题目要求影像学特征，E是镜下表现；子宫边界侵犯是平滑肌肉瘤恶性征象，因此选C

rules.rule: MPO缺乏伴严重复发性念珠菌病需排查额外免疫损伤
rules.rule_en: Severe recurrent candidiasis with MPO deficiency requires checking for additional immune impairment
rules.scenario: 确诊MPO缺乏症患者出现长期严重复发性黏膜念珠菌病时
rules.scenario_en: When a patient with confirmed MPO deficiency presents with long-term severe recurrent mucosal candidiasis
rules.checkpoint: 是否合并其他免疫损伤？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is there any additional immune impairment?
rules.error_behavior: 错误将严重复发性念珠菌病直接归因于单纯MPO缺乏，错误排除合并其他免疫损伤可能
rules.correct_reasoning: 单纯原发性MPO缺乏很少引起严重长期复发性念珠菌病，该表现提示很可能合并其他潜在免疫损伤

rules.rule: 优先选择对应核心病变的具体诊断而非宽泛病因
rules.rule_en: Prioritize specific diagnosis of core lesion over broad etiology
rules.scenario: 需给出诊断，存在基础病变合并核心靶器官病变时
rules.scenario_en: When making a diagnosis with underlying disease combined with core target organ lesion
rules.checkpoint: 是否优先选择核心病变的具体诊断？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is specific diagnosis of core lesion prioritized?
rules.error_behavior: 错误优先选择宽泛病因诊断，忽略核心病变的具体诊断
rules.correct_reasoning: 核心症状病理符合慢性胃缺血伴复发溃疡，优先选对应诊断

rules.rule: HIV职业针刺暴露：基线血清学+立即三联PEP
rules.rule_en: Occupational HIV needlestick: baseline serology + immediate triple PEP
keywords: 三联抗逆转录病毒治疗
rules.scenario: 处理HIV阳性高病毒量源的职业性针刺暴露时
rules.scenario_en: Managing occupational needlestick exposure from HIV-positive source with high viral load
rules.checkpoint: 是否安排基线HIV血清学检测并立即启动PEP？
rules.checkpoint_en: Did you arrange baseline HIV serology and initiate PEP immediately?
rules.error_behavior: 错误认为不需要立即行基线HIV血清学检测，遗漏该步骤
rules.correct_reasoning: 职业HIV针刺暴露需立即行基线HIV血清学检测，同时启动三联PEP

rules.rule: RA合并长期激素使用及劳力性上腹痛，需先排除冠心病再查胃肠疾病
rules.rule_en: For RA with long steroid use and exertional epigastric pain, rule out CAD before GI workup
rules.scenario: 长期类风湿关节炎患者有激素使用史，出现劳力性上腹痛休息后缓解，初始检查正常
rules.scenario_en: Patient with long-standing RA and history of steroid use has exertional epigastric pain relieved by rest, initial workup normal
rules.checkpoint: 是否先排除了心源性病因导致的上腹痛
rules.checkpoint_en: Have we ruled out cardiac causes of epigastric pain first
rules.error_behavior: 忽略RA和长期激素使用是冠心病危险因素，误将劳力性上腹痛归为胃肠疾病
rules.correct_reasoning: 长期RA合并长期激素使用是冠心病主要危险因素，劳力性上腹痛休息后缓解符合心绞痛，正常ECG和心肌酶仅排除心梗，不能排除缺血，应先行心脏负荷试验排查冠心病

rules.rule: Type-specific DFA can identify HSV subtypes for genital ulcers
rules.rule_en: Type-specific DFA can identify HSV subtypes for genital ulcers
rules.scenario: Evaluating patients with painful non-vesicular genital ulcers for causative organism subtype
rules.scenario_en: Evaluating patients with painful non-vesicular genital ulcers for causative organism subtype
rules.checkpoint: Can type-specific DFA identify HSV subtypes?
rules.checkpoint_en: Can type-specific DFA identify HSV subtypes?
rules.error_behavior: Incorrectly claimed DFA cannot identify HSV subtypes, chose PCR over DFA
rules.correct_reasoning: Type-specific DFA with monoclonal antibodies can distinguish HSV-1 and HSV-2 subtypes directly from clinical specimens for genital ulcer disease

rules.rule: When asked if postmenopausal estrogen affects libido, state no evidence it modulates libido
rules.rule_en: When asked if postmenopausal estrogen affects libido, state no evidence it modulates libido
rules.scenario: 绝经后女性询问雌激素下降是否影响性欲
rules.scenario_en: Postmenopausal woman asks if estrogen decline affects her libido
rules.checkpoint: 是否有证据显示雌激素调节性欲？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is there evidence estrogen modulates libido?
rules.error_behavior: 混淆雌激素对阴道健康和性欲的作用，错选A
rules.correct_reasoning: 雌激素不调节性欲，需直接回答患者关于雌激素的疑问，选F

rules.rule: Anti-M2 positive acute cholestasis: rule out Q fever before PBC
rules.rule_en: For anti-M2 positive acute cholestasis, rule out Q fever before PBC diagnosis
rules.scenario: Evaluating acute febrile cholestasis with positive anti-M2
rules.scenario_en: Evaluating acute febrile cholestasis with positive anti-M2
rules.checkpoint: Does presentation fit chronic PBC or acute Q fever?
rules.checkpoint_en: Does presentation fit chronic PBC or acute Q fever?
rules.error_behavior: Mistook anti-M2 positivity as exclusive to PBC, ignored acute presentation inconsistent with PBC
rules.correct_reasoning: Anti-M2 can be transient in Q fever, acute febrile presentation with lobular microgranulomas favors Q fever over PBC

rules.rule: 测量SVA需准确定位S1后上角位置
rules.rule_en: Accurately locate S1 posterior-superior corner when measuring SVA
rules.scenario: 判断脊柱矢状位平衡测量标记位置正误
rules.scenario_en: Judging marker position correctness in spinal sagittal balance measurement
rules.checkpoint: 标记是否正确位于S1后上角？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is the marker correctly on S1 posterior-superior corner?
rules.error_behavior: 模型误认S1椎体水平，错将低位骶骨标记当正确位置
rules.correct_reasoning: 明确SVA标记在S1后上角，逐一核对各图标记位置

rules.rule: CT肺实变内见气影，需先排查肺栓塞梗死
rules.rule_en: For CT pulmonary consolidation with air lucency, rule out PE infarct first
rules.scenario: CT见肺局灶实变含气影，需鉴别肺梗死和肺脓肿
rules.scenario_en: CT shows focal consolidation with air lucency, differentiate infarct and abscess
rules.checkpoint: 是否排除肺动脉栓塞引起的肺梗死？
rules.checkpoint_en: Have you ruled out pulmonary infarct from PE?
rules.error_behavior: 将肺梗死内空气支气管征误判为脓肿坏死空洞，排除肺梗死
rules.correct_reasoning: 急性肺梗死实变内可有空气支气管征，含气影不能排除肺梗死，需结合血管关系评估

rules.rule: 判读上肺CT先找局灶肿块，勿误判弥漫改变为原发异常
rules.rule_en: When interpreting upper lung CT, first find focal mass, do not mistake diffuse changes as primary abnormality
rules.scenario: 识别胸部CT上肺野原发病变，同时存在弥漫改变和局灶肿块时
rules.scenario_en: When identifying primary abnormality of upper lung on chest CT with both diffuse changes and focal mass
rules.checkpoint: 是否已识别出存在局灶性肿块？
rules.checkpoint_en: Has the focal mass lesion been identified?
rules.error_behavior: 误将弥漫间质改变判定为主要异常，未识别出右肺尖局灶肿块，错误认为存在胸膜下保留
rules.correct_reasoning: 先全面观察影像，识别出右肺尖局灶肿块，确认不存在胸膜下保留，主要异常是右肺尖肿瘤

rules.rule: 读膝冠状位MRI需按规范确认内侧半月板位置
rules.rule_en: Confirm medial meniscus location by convention on coronal knee MRI
rules.scenario: 判断左膝冠状位MRI是否存在内侧半月板撕裂时
rules.scenario_en: When judging medial meniscal tear on coronal left knee MRI
rules.checkpoint: 你确认内侧半月板位置正确了吗
rules.checkpoint_en: Have you confirmed correct medial meniscus location
rules.error_behavior: 错误将左膝冠状位MRI内侧半月板定位于图像右侧，误判为撕裂
rules.correct_reasoning: 按放射学规范，左膝内侧半月板位于图像左侧，先定位再判断

rules.rule: 对于CDI，静脉甲硝唑可达肠道治疗浓度，不应直接排除
rules.rule_en: For CDI, IV metronidazole reaches therapeutic gut concentration, do not rule out outright
rules.scenario: 抗生素治疗后并发艰难梭菌感染，选择用药方案时
rules.scenario_en: When selecting treatment for CDI after antibiotic therapy
rules.checkpoint: 是否错误排除了所有静脉抗生素用于CDI？
rules.checkpoint_en: Did you incorrectly exclude all IV antibiotics for CDI?
rules.error_behavior: 错误认为所有静脉抗生素都达不到肠道治疗浓度，直接排除静脉甲硝唑
rules.correct_reasoning: 静脉甲硝唑可经胆道排泄达到肠道治疗浓度，不应直接排除；本例非重症初发CDI首选口服非达霉素

rules.rule: 掌指关节侵蚀需先确认形态部位再诊断
rules.rule_en: Confirm MCP erosion morphology before arthritis diagnosis
rules.scenario: 手部MRI阅片诊断掌指关节侵蚀性关节炎时
rules.scenario_en: When reading hand MRI to diagnose erosive MCP arthritis
rules.checkpoint: 侵蚀形态部位是否符合类风湿关节炎？
rules.checkpoint_en: Does erosion fit RA morphology and location?
rules.error_behavior: 误将尺侧边缘侵蚀误认为痛风穿凿样侵蚀伴悬边，误诊痛风
rules.correct_reasoning: 掌指关节尺侧边缘侵蚀是类风湿关节炎典型表现，应诊断RA

rules.rule: 膝关节梯度回波MRI低信号灶需排查含铁血黄素沉积
rules.rule_en: Check hemosiderin deposition for low signal foci on knee gradient-echo MRI
rules.scenario: 读膝关节梯度回波MRI判断主要异常时
rules.scenario_en: When identifying primary abnormality on knee gradient-echo MRI
rules.checkpoint: 是否识别出MRI低信号含铁血黄素沉积？
rules.checkpoint_en: Have low signal hemosiderin deposits been identified?
rules.error_behavior: 模型误认高信号组织为软骨植入物肥大，漏诊低信号含铁血黄素沉积
rules.correct_reasoning: 梯度回波MRI多发极低信号是含铁血黄素沉积典型表现，为本例主要异常

rules.rule: 纵隔肿块邻食管，需结合EUS定位明确囊肿来源
rules.rule_en: When mediastinal mass adjacent to esophagus, confirm cyst origin via EUS localization
rules.scenario: FNA术后感染的纵隔囊性肿块鉴别诊断
rules.scenario_en: Differential diagnosis of infected mediastinal cystic mass after FNA
rules.checkpoint: 是否结合EUS定位判断囊肿来源？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is cyst origin confirmed via EUS localization?
rules.error_behavior: 仅因肿块邻近食管就扩大诊断范围，忽略EUS定位等关键信息
rules.correct_reasoning: 根据EUS示病变位于食管外排除食管重复囊肿，结合气道受压、呼吸道致病菌，诊断支气管源性囊肿感染

rules.rule: 有开腹肌瘤切除史妊娠36周偶发宫缩应剖宫产
rules.rule_en: Patients with history of open myomectomy at 36w gestation with occasional contractions should get C-section
rules.scenario: 妊娠36周，既往开腹子宫肌瘤切除史，偶发宫缩
rules.scenario_en: 36 weeks gestation with history of open myomectomy and occasional contractions
rules.checkpoint: 是否存在高风险子宫瘢痕需剖宫产？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is there a high-risk uterine scar requiring C-section?
rules.error_behavior: 错误排除剖宫产选项，低估开腹肌瘤切除后子宫破裂风险，误选生物物理评分
rules.correct_reasoning: 开腹切大黏膜下肌瘤需全层子宫切口，形成高风险瘢痕，36周偶发宫缩应剖宫产

rules.rule: 一线外用治痤疮1月无效，应加外用抗生素而非继续原方案
rules.rule_en: If first-line topical acne fails after 1 month, add topical antibiotics instead of continuing
rules.scenario: 痤疮患者经一线外用治疗1月无改善，需确定下一步处理
rules.scenario_en: Acne has no improvement after 1 month of first-line topical therapy, need next step
rules.checkpoint: 治疗1月无改善是否需要调整方案？
rules.checkpoint_en: Should we adjust regimen after 1 month of no improvement?
rules.error_behavior: 模型错误认为1月时间不足，选择继续原有治疗方案
rules.correct_reasoning: 1月已足够评估疗效，无效应加用外用抗生素

rules.rule: 新发肝酶异常，优先考虑近期新增治疗药物副作用
rules.rule_en: New-onset abnormal liver enzymes, prioritize drug side effect of recent new treatment
rules.scenario: 患者新发肝酶异常，近期开始针对疾病的专科治疗
rules.scenario_en: Patient has new-onset abnormal liver enzymes, recently started specialist treatment for disease
rules.checkpoint: 是否近期有新增治疗？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is there any recent new treatment?
rules.error_behavior: 忽略近期开始专科治疗的提示，错误认为肝酶升高由RA慢性炎症导致，排除药物副作用
rules.correct_reasoning: 患者既往肝功正常，近期开始针对RA的专科治疗，新发肝酶升高最可能是治疗药物的副作用，RA慢性炎症为长期过程，不会突发肝酶异常

rules.rule: 增强CT精囊密度增高优先考虑精囊炎而非出血
rules.rule_en: On contrast-enhanced CT, increased seminal vesicle attenuation indicates seminal vesiculitis over hemorrhage
rules.scenario: 评估增强盆腔CT上精囊腺密度增高病因时
rules.scenario_en: When evaluating cause of increased seminal vesicle attenuation on contrast-enhanced pelvic CT
rules.checkpoint: 该CT是否为增强扫描？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is this CT scan contrast-enhanced?
rules.error_behavior: 将增强CT左精囊密度增高误判为出血，错误排除精囊炎
rules.correct_reasoning: 先确认CT为增强，增强CT精囊增大伴密度增高首先考虑急性精囊炎

rules.rule: Clinical acute mastoiditis: start IV antibiotics first, no delay for CT
rules.rule_en: Clinical acute mastoiditis: start IV antibiotics first, do not delay for CT
rules.scenario: 临床确诊急性乳突炎为急性中耳炎并发症时
rules.scenario_en: When acute mastoiditis is clinically diagnosed as a complication of acute otitis media
rules.checkpoint: 是否需要延迟抗生素等待CT检查？
rules.checkpoint_en: Should I delay IV antibiotics for CT imaging?
rules.error_behavior: 错误认为急性乳突炎需先做CT再开始抗生素治疗
rules.correct_reasoning: 急性乳突炎可临床确诊，需立即启动静脉抗生素，不应因影像检查延迟治疗

rules.rule: 脊柱T1WI骨髓信号低于肌间盘，需排除弥漫浸润病变
rules.rule_en: On spine T1WI, rule out diffuse infiltration if marrow signal is lower than muscle and disc
rules.scenario: 评估脊柱MRI T1加权像椎体骨髓信号改变时
rules.scenario_en: Evaluating vertebral bone marrow signal change on T1-weighted spine MRI
rules.checkpoint: 骨髓信号是否低于肌肉和椎间盘？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is marrow signal lower than muscle and intervertebral disc?
rules.error_behavior: 误将正常年轻造血骨髓认作信号低于肌肉椎间盘
rules.correct_reasoning: 正常造血骨髓T1信号高于肌间盘，信号更低需考虑弥漫病理浸润

rules.rule: 右半肝切除可切除性先评估病肝动脉完整性
rules.rule_en: Assess right hepatic artery integrity first for right hepatectomy resectability
rules.scenario: 术前CT评估右半肝肿瘤切除可切除性
rules.scenario_en: Preoperative CT assessment of resectability for right hepatectomy
rules.checkpoint: 是否评估了病肝动脉完整性？
rules.checkpoint_en: Has the right hepatic artery integrity been assessed?
rules.error_behavior: 误将可切除性理解为残留肝存活，选错关键因素
rules.correct_reasoning: 可切除性指能否完整切除病灶，需先评估病肝动脉完整性

rules.rule: 解读结果需先结合已知临床背景，再决定是否行紧急检查
rules.rule_en: Correlate findings with known clinical context before emergent testing
rules.scenario: 已知患者有肢体发育不全，出现无预期运动诱发电位需紧急处理时
rules.scenario_en: When patient with limb agenesis has absent expected MEPs needing emergent management
rules.checkpoint: 是否结合已知临床背景解读检查结果？
rules.checkpoint_en: Have you correlated findings with known clinical context?
rules.error_behavior: 忽略已知肢体发育不全病史，误将无运动诱发电位归因颅内出血，选择紧急CT检查
rules.correct_reasoning: 无运动诱发电位是肢体发育不全的预期结果，应先获取更多临床信息评估

rules.rule: DTI: arcuate fasciculus is red, connects temporal-frontal for language
rules.rule_en: DTI: arcuate fasciculus is red, connects temporal-frontal for language
rules.scenario: Interpreting DTI fiber tract for arcuate fasciculus identification
rules.scenario_en: Interpreting DTI fiber tract for arcuate fasciculus identification
rules.checkpoint: Is arcuate fasciculus correctly color coded?
rules.checkpoint_en: Is arcuate fasciculus correctly color coded?
rules.error_behavior: Misidentified arcuate fasciculus as blue tract, selected wrong option F
rules.correct_reasoning: Arcuate connects temporal to frontal for language, DTI codes it red, so B is correct

rules.rule: 停药后脑肿瘤再生长属于原有肿瘤进展
rules.rule_en: Brain tumor regrowth after treatment cessation is progression of original tumor
rules.scenario: 评估停药后脑肿瘤再生长的性质时
rules.scenario_en: When evaluating the nature of brain tumor regrowth after stopping treatment
rules.checkpoint: 该再生长是否为原有肿瘤进展？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is this regrowth progression of the original tumor?
rules.error_behavior: 错误将肿瘤进展仅定义为治疗中发生，误解不规则边界和外周血管化
rules.correct_reasoning: 停药后原有治疗过肿瘤再生长属于肿瘤进展，分叶轮廓属于不规则边界

rules.rule: 钼靶侧位定上下，头尾位定内外方位
rules.rule_en: Mammography lateral view localizes superior-inferior, CC localizes medial-lateral
rules.scenario: 乳腺钼靶针定位前的病变三角定位
rules.scenario_en: Triangulation of lesion before mammographic needle localization
rules.checkpoint: 钼靶两个体位各定哪个方位？
rules.checkpoint_en: Which orientation does each mammographic view localize?
rules.error_behavior: 错误将侧位定内外，头尾位定上下，导致定位错误
rules.correct_reasoning: 侧位定上下方位，头尾位定内外方位，再正确三角定位选入路

rules.rule: 问髌骨低位相关术式，优先记高发类型
rules.rule_en: When asked about patella baja associated surgery, prioritize the most common
rules.scenario: 题目询问哪项手术最常引发髌骨低位
rules.scenario_en: When the question asks which surgery most commonly causes patella baja
rules.checkpoint: 是否为最常见引发髌骨低位的术式？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is this the most common surgery causing patella baja?
rules.error_behavior: 错误认为全膝置换最常引发髌骨低位，错误否定高位胫骨截骨致病
rules.correct_reasoning: 高位胫骨截骨是最常并发髌骨低位的手术，需牢记不同术式致病概率

rules.rule: 中央型椎间盘突出需逐层排查偏侧神经根压迫
rules.rule_en: Check sequential slices for unilateral nerve root compression in central disc protrusion
rules.scenario: CT观察L5-S1水平中央型椎间盘突出时
rules.scenario_en: When observing broad central disc protrusion at L5-S1 on CT
rules.checkpoint: 是否存在偏侧神经根压迫？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is there unilateral nerve root compression?
