rules.error_behavior: 错误识别T波形态，将高钾血症的ECG改变误判为低钾血症
rules.correct_reasoning: 高耸T波伴QRS增宽提示高钾血症，hungry骨综合征不导致低钾血症

rules.rule: 非特异性胃炎组织学应诊为慢性胃炎，勿乱下特异性病因诊断
rules.rule_en: Non-specific gastritis histology should be diagnosed as chronic gastritis, not specific etiology without evidence
rules.scenario: 胃组织学检查提示非特异性炎症特征时的诊断选择
rules.scenario_en: Diagnosis selection when gastric histology shows non-specific inflammatory features
rules.checkpoint: 是否有特异性病因的组织学证据？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is there histological evidence of specific etiology?
rules.error_behavior: 错误将非特异性炎症特征诊断为幽门螺杆菌相关性胃炎
rules.correct_reasoning: 题干特征是慢性胃炎非特异性表现，无特异病因证据应诊为慢性胃炎

rules.rule: 膝内翻不稳需修复深外侧副韧带而非浅表层结构
rules.rule_en: Varus knee instability requires repairing deep LCL not superficial structures
rules.scenario: 胫骨平台骨折ORIF术后膝内翻不稳，确定需修复的结构
rules.scenario_en: After ORIF of tibial plateau fracture with varus instability, confirm the structure to repair
rules.checkpoint: 是否为致内翻不稳的深外侧副韧带？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is it the deep LCL causing varus instability?
rules.error_behavior: 误将浅表层髂胫束认作致内翻不稳的外侧副韧带
rules.correct_reasoning: 膝内翻不稳由深外侧副韧带损伤导致，应修复深韧带

rules.rule: 多发皮肤结节伴发热超1月需首先排除淋巴瘤
rules.rule_en: Multiple skin nodules with fever over 1 month need to rule out lymphoma first
rules.scenario: 多发皮肤结节伴反复发热，需鉴别诊断时
rules.scenario_en: When differential diagnosis for multiple skin nodules with recurring fever
rules.checkpoint: 是否首先排除淋巴瘤？
rules.checkpoint_en: Should we rule out lymphoma first?
rules.error_behavior: 错误排除淋巴瘤，误将多发亚急性皮损诊断为蜘蛛咬伤
rules.correct_reasoning: 蜘蛛咬伤多单发急性起病，本例符合淋巴瘤表现，应诊断淋巴瘤

rules.rule: 儿童跟骨骨骺碎裂是正常表现，不是骨折假象
rules.rule_en: Pediatric calcaneal apophyseal fragmentation is normal, not a fracture mimic
rules.scenario: 评估儿童腕部和跟骨损伤的X线读片时适用
rules.scenario_en: Applicable when interpreting X-rays of pediatric wrist and calcaneal injuries
rules.checkpoint: 儿童跟骨骨骺碎裂是正常的吗？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is calcaneal apophyseal fragmentation normal in children?
rules.error_behavior: 错误将正常儿童跟骨骨骺碎裂描述为模拟骨折的跟骨碎裂，排除正确选项A
rules.correct_reasoning: 认识到儿童跟骨骨骺生理性碎裂是正常变异，识别尺骨远端青枝骨折、桡骨远端隆突骨折和正常跟骨骨骺，选择A

rules.rule: Hb SC disease requires both Hb S and Hb C electrophoresis bands
rules.rule_en: Hb SC disease requires both Hb S and Hb C electrophoresis bands
rules.scenario: Interpreting alkaline pH cellulose acetate hemoglobin electrophoresis
rules.scenario_en: Interpreting alkaline pH cellulose acetate hemoglobin electrophoresis
rules.checkpoint: Does the result have both Hb S and Hb C bands?
rules.checkpoint_en: Does the result have both Hb S and Hb C bands?
rules.error_behavior: Misidentified a single Hb S band result as having both Hb S and Hb C bands
rules.correct_reasoning: Hb SC is compound heterozygous for S and C, so electrophoresis must show two distinct bands at S and C migration positions

rules.rule: 阅冠脉造影时，需先排查左冠脉近段有无异常
rules.rule_en: When reading coronary angiogram, check proximal left coronary for anomalies first
rules.scenario: 判断冠脉造影中哪段冠状动脉存在异常时
rules.scenario_en: When identifying abnormal coronary artery segment on coronary angiogram
rules.checkpoint: 左冠状动脉近段是否存在异常？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is there anomaly in proximal left coronary artery?
rules.error_behavior: 误判左前降支近中段闭塞，漏诊左冠脉近段异常
rules.correct_reasoning: 先排查左冠脉近段是否异常，确认远段显影可排除LAD闭塞

rules.rule: 心功能正常时外周水肿不会导致血清BNP升高
rules.rule_en: Peripheral edema does not elevate serum BNP with normal cardiac function
rules.scenario: 心脏结构功能正常伴外周水肿，判断BNP水平时
rules.scenario_en: Judging BNP level in patient with normal cardiac function and peripheral edema
rules.checkpoint: 患者心脏功能是否正常？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is the patient's cardiac function normal?
rules.error_behavior: 错误认为心功能正常时外周水肿会升高BNP，误选C
rules.correct_reasoning: BNP因心室壁张力升高释放，心功能正常时外周水肿不升高BNP，糖尿病常伴LDL升高，应选D

rules.rule: 阅腰椎MRI需全面扫查椎管，勿漏诊椎管内占位
rules.rule_en: When reading lumbar MRI, fully scan the spinal canal to avoid missing intraspinal mass
rules.scenario: 判读腰椎MRI脊柱病变类型时适用
rules.scenario_en: Applicable when judging spinal abnormality type on lumbar MRI
rules.checkpoint: 是否漏诊了椎管内占位病变？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is the intraspinal mass lesion missed?
rules.error_behavior: 模型错误否认椎管内占位，误判为退变椎间盘伴高信号区
rules.correct_reasoning: 应全面扫查椎管确认有无占位，勿只关注椎间盘漏诊病变

rules.rule: 描述PAH右室改变需基于直接观察影像表现
rules.rule_en: Describe RV changes in PAH based on directly observed imaging findings
rules.scenario: 分析严重PAH右心室代谢改变的影像学试题
rules.scenario_en: Analyzing imaging questions about RV metabolic changes in severe PAH
rules.checkpoint: 是否基于直接观察的影像学表现？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is it based on directly observed imaging findings?
rules.error_behavior: 错将病理推论当作观察结果，选了不符合的F选项
rules.correct_reasoning: 应匹配直接观察的影像改变，A符合观察结果要求

rules.rule: 新发单克隆丙种球蛋白病先无创评估终末器官损伤
rules.rule_en: Assess end-organ damage non-invasively first for new monoclonal gammopathy
rules.scenario: 新发单克隆丙种球蛋白病的初始诊断流程
rules.scenario_en: Initial diagnostic workup of newly detected monoclonal gammopathy
rules.checkpoint: 是否先无创评估终末器官损伤？
rules.checkpoint_en: Has end-organ damage been assessed non-invasively first?
rules.error_behavior: 错误优先选择有创骨髓活检，颠倒了正确诊断顺序
rules.correct_reasoning: 新发单克隆丙种球蛋白病应先无创评估终末器官损伤，发现损伤后再行骨髓活检

rules.rule: 解读血管造影先确认解剖位置再匹配选项
rules.rule_en: Confirm anatomy location before matching options when reading angiograms
rules.scenario: 解读血管造影多选题，选项涉及不同位置血管病变
rules.scenario_en: Interpreting multiple-choice angiogram questions with different vessel locations
rules.checkpoint: 是否确认了血管造影的正确解剖位置？
rules.checkpoint_en: Have I confirmed the correct angiogram anatomy location?
rules.error_behavior: 错误定位血管造影解剖区域，错误排除正确选项
rules.correct_reasoning: 先确认血管造影的解剖区域，排除位置不匹配的选项再评估

rules.rule: For organic ED with preserved libido, prioritize prolactin over testosterone testing
rules.rule_en: For organic erectile dysfunction with preserved libido, prioritize prolactin over testosterone testing
rules.scenario: Initial workup of organic erectile dysfunction with preserved sexual libido
rules.scenario_en: Initial workup of organic erectile dysfunction with preserved sexual libido
rules.checkpoint: Should prolactin be prioritized over testosterone testing here?
rules.checkpoint_en: Should prolactin be prioritized over testosterone testing here?
rules.error_behavior: Incorrectly prioritized testosterone testing over prolactin testing
rules.correct_reasoning: Hypogonadism causes reduced libido; with preserved libido, hyperprolactinemia is more likely, prioritize prolactin first

rules.rule: 疑重度CDI伴腹肌强直，优先做腹部CT排查并发症
rules.rule_en: For suspected severe CDI with abdominal rigidity, first get CT abdomen
rules.scenario: 怀疑重度难辨梭菌感染，患者存在腹肌强直时
rules.scenario_en: When severe CDI is suspected and patient has abdominal rigidity
rules.checkpoint: 是否优先安排腹部CT检查？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is abdominal CT prioritized first?
rules.error_behavior: 模型错误选择静脉万古霉素，未优先做CT评估并发症
rules.correct_reasoning: 腹肌强直提示腹腔并发症可能，需先做CT明确病情

rules.rule: 肾移植术后早期肾功能不全，先活检再干预
rules.rule_en: Early post kidney transplant dysfunction, biopsy before intervention
rules.scenario: 肾移植术后早期肌酐升高，超声见肾周积液伴肾积水
rules.scenario_en: Early post kidney transplant with elevated creatinine, perinephric fluid and hydronephrosis on ultrasound
rules.checkpoint: 是否优先活检明确病因？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is biopsy prioritized to confirm etiology?
rules.error_behavior: 错误排除急性排斥，误判肾周积液为感染直接引流
rules.correct_reasoning: 术后早期该表现首先考虑急性排斥，应先行肾活检确诊

rules.rule: CT见左侧腹部肠异常，不可仅因位置排除憩室炎
rules.rule_en: For left abdominal bowel abnormality on CT, do not exclude diverticulitis only by location
rules.scenario: CT发现左侧腹部肠管异常伴收缩胆囊，需鉴别诊断时
rules.scenario_en: When CT detects left abdominal bowel abnormality with contracted gallbladder for differential diagnosis
rules.checkpoint: 该肠异常是否可排除憩室炎？
rules.checkpoint_en: Can this bowel abnormality rule out diverticulitis?
rules.error_behavior: 错误认为憩室炎仅发生于左下腹，因病灶位于左上腹排除正确诊断
rules.correct_reasoning: 憩室炎好发左下腹乙状结肠，但也可累及左上腹降结肠、脾曲，不能仅靠位置排除

rules.rule: 孕前血糖控制极差，先排查先天畸形致围生期死亡
rules.rule_en: Rule out major congenital anomaly first for poorly controlled pre-pregnancy diabetes causing perinatal mortality
rules.scenario: 判断孕前血糖控制不佳孕妇围生期死亡最可能原因
rules.scenario_en: Determining the most probable cause of perinatal mortality in pregnant women with poorly controlled pre-pregnancy diabetes
rules.checkpoint: 是否优先考虑先天畸形致围生期死亡？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is major congenital anomaly as cause of perinatal mortality prioritized?
rules.error_behavior: 错将胎盘功能不全认为是最可能原因，低估先天畸形风险
rules.correct_reasoning: 孕前极差血糖控制大幅增加致命先天畸形风险，是该情况围生期死亡首要原因

rules.rule: 心力衰竭患者合并肺阴影，先利尿再复查胸片
rules.rule_en: For heart failure patients with lung opacity, diurese first then repeat CXR
rules.scenario: 心力衰竭患者胸部X线发现肺阴影，需评估下一步处理
rules.scenario_en: Heart failure patient has lung opacity on CXR, need next step evaluation
rules.checkpoint: 肺阴影合并心衰是否立即做CT?
rules.checkpoint_en: Should we do CT immediately for lung opacity in HF?
rules.error_behavior: 忽略患者心衰体征，直接认定肺阴影为肿瘤选择CT
rules.correct_reasoning: 患者有心衰体征，先利尿后复查胸片明确阴影性质再考虑CT

rules.rule: 脊柱横突突出需考虑侧凸，勿仅归因旋转
rules.rule_en: Consider sidebending for transverse process prominence, not only rotation
rules.scenario: 判断脊柱躯体功能障碍的运动方向时
rules.scenario_en: When judging motion direction of spinal somatic dysfunction
rules.checkpoint: 横突突出考虑侧凸因素了吗？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is sidebending considered for transverse prominence?
rules.error_behavior: 错误将横突突出仅归因于旋转，排除了侧凸因素
rules.correct_reasoning: 横突突出反映侧凸凸侧，结合组织改变判断慢性侧凸功能障碍

rules.rule: For newborn macrocytic anemia, distinguish DBA from vitamin deficiency
rules.rule_en: For newborn macrocytic anemia, distinguish DBA from vitamin deficiency
rules.scenario: Evaluating a term newborn with macrocytic anemia and radial ray anomaly
rules.scenario_en: Evaluating a term newborn with macrocytic anemia and radial ray anomaly
rules.checkpoint: Does finding match the correct pathophysiology?
rules.checkpoint_en: Does the finding match correct pathophysiology?
rules.error_behavior: Incorrectly linked radial ray defects to vitamin deficiency, wrongly dismissed DBA
rules.correct_reasoning: DBA causes macrocytic anemia, elevated RBC adenosine deaminase, and radial ray defects. Water-soluble vitamin deficiency does not cause radial ray anomalies, so C is correct.

rules.rule: 核对症状发作与潜在诱因的时间关系
rules.rule_en: Verify temporal relationship between symptom onset and potential trigger
rules.scenario: 慢性症状出现在近期用药后，需要明确病因时
rules.scenario_en: When chronic symptoms occur after recent medication use and etiology needs clarification
rules.checkpoint: 症状发作是否早于潜在诱因？
rules.checkpoint_en: Does symptom onset predate the potential trigger?
rules.error_behavior: 错误将慢性腹泻归因于近期抗生素，忽略症状早于用药
rules.correct_reasoning: 腹泻数月早于近期抗生素，应排除抗生素相关急性腹泻，找慢性病因

rules.rule: 远外侧腰椎间盘突出压迫同水平发出神经根
rules.rule_en: Far lateral lumbar disc herniation compresses same-level exiting nerve root
rules.scenario: 判断腰椎MRI远外侧椎间盘突出受累神经根时
rules.scenario_en: When identifying affected nerve root of far lateral lumbar disc herniation on MRI
rules.checkpoint: 是否正确定位了椎间盘突出节段？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is the disc herniation level correctly localized?
rules.error_behavior: 错误计数椎体，将L3-L4远外侧突出错判为L4-L5
rules.correct_reasoning: 先正确计数确定突出节段，远外侧突出压迫同水平发出神经根，L3-L4远外侧突出压迫L3神经根

rules.rule: 诊断需同时结合解剖部位与增强模式，不能忽略部位
rules.rule_en: Diagnosis must combine anatomical location and enhancement pattern, don't ignore location
rules.scenario: 要求结合解剖部位和增强模式诊断病变时
rules.scenario_en: When diagnosis requires combining anatomical location and enhancement pattern
rules.checkpoint: 是否同时考虑解剖部位和增强模式？
rules.checkpoint_en: Did you consider both location and enhancement pattern?
rules.error_behavior: 明知病变位于胫骨，仍忽略解剖部位，仅依环形增强选颅内胶质母细胞瘤
rules.correct_reasoning: 先明确病变解剖部位，排除不发生于此的病变，再结合增强模式诊断

rules.rule: 高钙草酸钙结晶尿，先明确病变再判断尿pH
rules.rule_en: For hypercalcemia with calcium oxalate crystalluria, confirm lesion before judging urine pH
rules.scenario: 疑MEN1合并高钙血症，尿见草酸钙结晶需判结果
rules.scenario_en: Suspected MEN1 with hypercalcemia, calcium oxalate crystals in urine
rules.checkpoint: 是否区分病变类型和结晶生长环境？
rules.checkpoint_en: Has lesion type and crystal growth environment been distinguished?
rules.error_behavior: 误将罕见迟发远端RTA作为结果，忽略草酸钙好发于酸性尿
rules.correct_reasoning: MEN1高钙高尿钙，草酸钙结晶易在低pH尿析出，故尿pH降低

rules.rule: 诊断乳头状肾细胞癌需考虑不同亚型影像特征
rules.rule_en: Diagnosing papillary renal cell carcinoma requires considering imaging features of different subtypes
rules.scenario: 肾脏MRI阅片，诊断乳头状肾细胞癌时
rules.scenario_en: When reading renal MRI to diagnose papillary renal cell carcinoma
rules.checkpoint: 是否考虑了PRCC不同亚型的影像特征？
rules.checkpoint_en: Have imaging features of all PRCC subtypes been considered?
rules.error_behavior: 错误窄化PRCC影像特征，仅认可经典实性亚型，忽略囊性亚型特征
rules.correct_reasoning: 知晓PRCC存在不同亚型，各亚型影像不同，囊性PRCC可表现为延迟期更显著的周围结节样强化

rules.rule: 先区分螺钉位置，再判定螺钉类型功能
rules.rule_en: Determine screw position before judging screw type and function
rules.scenario: 分析混合锁定钢板固定股骨假体周围骨折螺钉功能时
rules.scenario_en: When analyzing screw function in hybrid locked plate fixation for periprosthetic distal femur fracture
rules.checkpoint: 是否先区分了螺钉位置？
rules.checkpoint_en: Has screw position been identified first?
rules.error_behavior: 错误反向归类不同位置螺钉的类型，颠倒功能
rules.correct_reasoning: 先按位置判断：远端A是锁定螺钉提供固定角支撑，近端B是非锁定螺钉用于复位钢板

rules.rule: 卡马西平相关轻度无症状白细胞减少，先观察，避免早期停药
rules.rule_en: For mild asymptomatic carbamazepine-induced leukopenia, observe first, avoid early discontinuation
rules.scenario: 患者使用卡马西平后出现轻度无症状白细胞减少，选择下一步处理
rules.scenario_en: When mild asymptomatic leukopenia occurs after carbamazepine initiation, selecting next management
rules.checkpoint: 白细胞减少是否为轻度无症状？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is the leukopenia mild and asymptomatic?
rules.error_behavior: 错误推荐升白治疗和提前停用卡马西平，未选择观察
rules.correct_reasoning: 轻度无症状卡马西平相关白细胞减少多为一过性，首选定期监测，无需提前停药

rules.rule: 确认MRI序列类型再解读阴道残端病变信号
rules.rule_en: Confirm MRI sequence type before interpreting vaginal cuff lesion signal
rules.scenario: 子宫切除术后盆腔MRI评估阴道残端病变
rules.scenario_en: Pelvic MRI evaluation of vaginal cuff lesion after hysterectomy
rules.checkpoint: 序列类型是否正确识别？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is the sequence type correctly identified?
rules.error_behavior: 将增强后实性强化结节错判为囊性T2高信号子宫内膜异位症，排除了复发恶性肿瘤
rules.correct_reasoning: 先确认序列类型，识别增强后高信号是复发恶性肿瘤的结节强化，而非子宫内膜异位囊肿的T2高信号

rules.rule: 气管偏移方向提示患侧肺容积变化
rules.rule_en: Tracheal deviation direction indicates affected lung volume change
rules.scenario: 判断儿童单侧气道梗阻的流量-容积环形态时适用
rules.scenario_en: Applicable when judging flow-volume loop morphology of unilateral airway obstruction in children
rules.checkpoint: 气管偏移方向对应何种肺容积改变？
rules.checkpoint_en: What lung volume change does tracheal deviation indicate?
rules.error_behavior: 误认气管向患侧偏移提示空气潴留，错认流量-容积环分侧显肺功能
rules.correct_reasoning: 气管向患侧偏移提示患侧肺容积减少（肺不张），标准流量-容积环反映整体肺功能，单侧肺不张致总肺活量降低，表现为形态正常的小流量-容积环

rules.rule: 稳定无脱水药物中毒患者仅需观察，无需常规补液
rules.rule_en: Stable non-dehydrated drug poisoning patients only need observation, no routine IV fluids
rules.scenario: 药物中毒患者血流动力学稳定无脱水，选择治疗方案
rules.scenario_en: Selecting treatment for hemodynamically stable non-dehydrated drug poisoning patients
rules.checkpoint: 患者是否血流动力学稳定且无脱水？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is the patient hemodynamically stable without dehydration?
rules.error_behavior: 错误认为稳定无脱水中毒患者必须补液，否定观察方案
rules.correct_reasoning: 患者稳定无脱水低灌注，无需常规补液，仅需观察即可

rules.rule: 诊断Hp慢性活动性胃炎，优先识别螺旋形病原体而非仅中性浸润
rules.rule_en: For diagnosing H. pylori chronic active gastritis, prioritize spiral-shaped pathogens over just neutrophilic infiltration
rules.scenario: HE染色组织切片识别幽门螺杆菌活动性胃炎特征时
rules.scenario_en: When identifying features of H. pylori induced chronic active gastritis on H&E stained histological sections

rules.checkpoint_en: Is Staphylococcus aureus bacterial tracheitis considered?
rules.error_behavior: 错误排除金葡菌，误将难治性喘鸣归为副流感病毒
rules.correct_reasoning: 难治性喘鸣不缓解于肾上腺素伴黄痰提示细菌性气管炎，最常见为金葡菌，需优先考虑

rules.rule: 站立屈曲试验评估骨盆功能障碍，非髂腰肌病变

rules.checkpoint: 站立屈曲试验用于评估什么病变？
rules.checkpoint_en: What pathology does standing flexion test assess?
rules.error_behavior: 错误将阳性站立屈曲试验解读为髂腰肌痉挛/短缩征象
rules.correct_reasoning: 站立屈曲试验筛查骨盆功能障碍，Thomas试验评估髂腰肌，本例应诊断下耻骨剪切

rules.rule: Scleroderma fingertip calcinosis can be large; normal tufts don't rule it out
rules.rule_en: Scleroderma fingertip calcinosis can be large; normal tufts do not rule it out

rules.checkpoint_en: Does this presentation rule out scleroderma calcinosis?
rules.error_behavior: 错误认为硬皮病钙质沉着均为小结节且必须伴指端吸收，错误排除硬皮病
rules.correct_reasoning: 硬皮病指尖钙质沉着可表现为大块致密沉积，指端吸收并非普遍存在，正常指端不排除硬皮病

rules.rule: 处理下肢水肿先解决近端左第一肋淋巴梗阻
rules.rule_en: Address proximal left 1st rib lymphatic obstruction first for lower extremity edema
rules.scenario: 急性创伤性下肢水肿行整骨手法治疗时
rules.scenario_en: When performing OMT for acute traumatic lower extremity edema
rules.checkpoint: 是否先处理近端淋巴引流梗阻？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is proximal lymphatic obstruction addressed first?
rules.error_behavior: 错误排除左第一肋干预，错误选择外周踝泵作为初始治疗
rules.correct_reasoning: 胸导管引流下肢淋巴汇入左第一肋水平，左第一肋功能障碍阻碍淋巴流出，需先处理近端梗阻再行外周干预

rules.rule: 孤立距下关节病变疼痛，选距下而非三关节融合
rules.rule_en: For isolated subtalar pain, choose subtalar not triple arthrodesis

rules.scenario_en: Chronic isolated subtalar pathology fails conservative treatment needing surgery
rules.checkpoint: 是否为孤立距下关节病变？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is it isolated subtalar joint pathology?
rules.error_behavior: 错误认为刚性后足痛需三关节融合，排除距下关节融合
rules.correct_reasoning: 患者疼痛局限跗骨窦（距下关节区），仅距下活动诱发痛，踝活动无痛，无其他后足关节病变，保守无效应选距下关节融合

rules.rule: 评估FCL撕裂需确认其与联合腱正常附着关系
rules.rule_en: When assessing FCL tears, confirm normal attachment with conjoined tendon
rules.scenario: 膝关节MRI评估FCL撕裂，判断其与联合腱附着关系时
rules.scenario_en: When evaluating FCL tear and its attachment relationship with conjoined tendon on knee MRI
rules.checkpoint: 是否确认FCL与联合腱正常附着关系？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is the normal attachment relationship confirmed?
rules.error_behavior: 错误误解FCL与联合腱的正常解剖附着关系，误排正确选项
rules.correct_reasoning: 先牢记二者远端腓骨处共同附着的正常解剖，再结合撕裂位置判断

rules.rule: 局限性支气管扩张，勿误归为大叶分布疾病
rules.rule_en: Do not misclassify focal bronchiectasis as lobar predominant disease
rules.scenario: 胸部CT判断支气管扩张病因时
rules.scenario_en: When diagnosing the cause of bronchiectasis on chest CT
rules.checkpoint: 是否确认支气管扩张分布范围？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is the distribution of bronchiectasis confirmed?
rules.error_behavior: 仅见病变位于上叶，就将局限性扩张误归因于COPD
rules.correct_reasoning: 先确认分布是局限性而非弥漫大叶分布，COPD不引起固定支气管扩张，局灶性支气管炎可致局限性扩张

rules.rule: 免疫低下合并肾损伤带状疱疹首选泛昔洛韦
rules.rule_en: Prefer famciclovir for immunocompromised herpes zoster with AKI
rules.scenario: 免疫低下化疗后合并急性肾损伤的带状疱疹选药
rules.scenario_en: Selecting antiviral for herpes zoster in immunocompromised post-chemotherapy patients with AKI
rules.checkpoint: 本例首选哪种抗病毒药物？
rules.checkpoint_en: Which antiviral is preferred in this case?
rules.error_behavior: 误认三种抗VZV药物均适合本例，忽略肾损伤风险差异
rules.correct_reasoning: 本例免疫低下合并急性肾损伤，伐昔洛韦不推荐免疫患者，阿昔洛韦肾损伤风险更高，泛昔洛韦肾安全性更好，为首选

rules.rule: C1-C2压迫原发病因是不稳定，不是前脱位
rules.rule_en: Primary cause of C1-C2 compression is instability not subluxation
rules.scenario: 确定C1-C2水平严重脊髓压迫的原发病因时
rules.scenario_en: When determining the primary cause of severe C1-C2 spinal cord compression
rules.checkpoint: C1-C2脊髓压迫原发病因是什么？
rules.checkpoint_en: What is the primary cause of C1-C2 compression?
rules.error_behavior: 错误认为C1前脱位是原发病因，误判压迫来自Chiari畸形
rules.correct_reasoning: C1前脱位是C1-C2不稳定的继发结果，原发病因是不稳定

rules.rule: 阅片需检查所有CT层面，勿漏诊髋臼骨折
rules.rule_en: Check all CT slices before ruling out acetabular fracture
rules.scenario: 评估大腿软组织CT病变时，排查是否合并髋臼骨折
rules.scenario_en: When evaluating soft tissue pathology on thigh CT, rule out concomitant acetabular fracture
rules.checkpoint: 髋臼是否在CT层面上可见？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is the acetabulum visible on any CT slice?
rules.error_behavior: 误判CT解剖层面，认为髋臼未显影，漏诊骨折
rules.correct_reasoning: 先确认所有CT层面可见的解剖结构，再评估是否存在髋臼骨折，本例可见左侧髋臼骨折

rules.rule: 应用道义论时需尊重患者知情同意的资源分配选择
rules.rule_en: When applying deontology, respect competent patient's informed consent for resource allocation
rules.scenario: 稀缺医疗资源分配的道义论伦理决策场景
rules.scenario_en: Deontological ethical decision-making scenario for scarce medical resource allocation
rules.checkpoint: 患者是否知情同意资源重新分配？
rules.checkpoint_en: Does the patient consent to resource reallocation?
rules.error_behavior: 未考虑患者对资源重新分配的有效知情同意，错误将道义论义务限定为仅提供原计划治疗
rules.correct_reasoning: 道义论医学伦理核心原则包含尊重患者自主权，具备决策能力的患者自愿知情放弃既定治疗的选择具有约束力，尊重该选择才符合对患者的伦理义务

rules.rule: 免疫低下持续发热皮下结节先排查镰刀菌病
rules.rule_en: For immunocompromised patients with persistent fever and subcutaneous nodules, rule out fusariosis first
rules.scenario: 免疫低下患者经广谱抗菌抗真菌治疗仍发热，伴多发皮下结节需诊断
rules.scenario_en: An immunocompromised patient has persistent fever despite antibiotics and antifungals with multiple subcutaneous nodules, requiring diagnosis
rules.checkpoint: 是否首先排查了镰刀菌病？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is fusariosis ruled out first?
rules.error_behavior: 错误排除镰刀菌病，误认BCG用于白血病治疗，错选播散性BCG病
rules.correct_reasoning: 镰刀菌好发免疫低下患者，常耐常规抗真菌，表现符合本例；播散BCG病罕见，不符合本例

rules.rule: 基于题目给出的组织病理学特征诊断，勿依赖图像标签
rules.rule_en: Diagnose based on given histopathological features, not image labels
keywords: 幽门螺杆菌相关性胃炎
rules.scenario: 根据题目给定的组织病理学特征进行胃炎诊断时
rules.scenario_en: When diagnosing gastritis based on given histopathological features
rules.checkpoint: 是否基于给定特征而非图像标签诊断？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is diagnosis based on given features not image labels?
rules.error_behavior: 依赖图像标签而非给定组织学特征，误选幽门螺杆菌相关性胃炎
rules.correct_reasoning: 给定特征符合慢性活动性胃炎定义，幽门螺杆菌胃炎需病原体证据，未提供故不选

rules.rule: 尼鲁米特诱导肺损伤典型HRCT为双侧无分区倾向阴影
rules.rule_en: Typical HRCT manifestation of nilutamide-induced lung injury is bilateral opacities without zonal predilection

rules.scenario_en: When judging the typical HRCT manifestation of nilutamide-induced interstitial pulmonary damage
rules.checkpoint: 尼鲁米特肺损伤典型CT表现是什么？
rules.checkpoint_en: What is the typical CT manifestation of nilutamide-induced lung injury?
rules.error_behavior: 错误将斑片磨玻璃伴小叶中心结节等认作典型表现，排除正确选项
rules.correct_reasoning: 尼鲁米特诱导肺间质损伤典型HRCT为双侧阴影无分区倾向，需记住该特定特征

rules.rule: WPW pattern可表现为间歇性预激伴交替QRS
rules.rule_en: WPW pattern can present as intermittent pre-excitation with alternating QRS
rules.scenario: 慢性心衰患者心电图见间歇性预激伴交替QRS的诊断
rules.scenario_en: Diagnosis of intermittent pre-excitation with alternating QRS on ECG in chronic heart failure
rules.checkpoint: 间歇性预激是否可诊断WPW pattern？
rules.checkpoint_en: Can intermittent pre-excitation be diagnosed as WPW pattern?
rules.error_behavior: 错误认为WPW必须持续预激，误将物质诱导心肌病诊断为致心律失常性心肌病，误排心衰加重
rules.correct_reasoning: WPW pattern可表现为间歇性预激，本例符合WPW pattern合并心衰加重，不是致心律失常性心肌病

rules.rule: CT head trauma: Isodense SDH identified by sulcal effacement, heterogeneous from rebleeding
rules.rule_en: In head trauma CT: isodense subdural hematoma identified by sulcal effacement, heterogeneous from rebleeding

rules.scenario_en: Evaluating stage and characteristics of subdural hematoma on post-traumatic head CT
rules.checkpoint: 血肿密度是否匹配脑实质密度？
rules.checkpoint_en: Does hematoma density match brain parenchyma density?
rules.error_behavior: 错误认为等密度硬膜下血肿不能显见，误分类为急转慢硬膜下血肿
rules.correct_reasoning: 等密度硬膜下血肿密度匹配脑实质，可通过脑沟消失识别，异质性源于反复出血

rules.rule: 胸部CT上需区分皮下皮肤标记与骨皮质骨折
rules.rule_en: Distinguish subcutaneous skin markers from cortical bone fractures on chest CT
rules.scenario: 胸部CT寻找肺栓塞栓子并评估骨结构时适用
rules.scenario_en: Applicable when looking for pulmonary embolism on chest CT and evaluating bones
rules.checkpoint: 该高密度影是皮肤标记还是骨折？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is this opacity a skin marker or a fracture?
rules.error_behavior: 误将皮下皮肤标记认定为肋骨和锁骨骨折
rules.correct_reasoning: 先确认骨皮质连续性，骨外皮下高密度是皮肤标记而非骨折

rules.rule: 胸片见右半膈边缘模糊，先排查肺空气腔疾病
rules.rule_en: For indistinct hemidiaphragm on CXR, first check airspace disease

rules.scenario_en: Chest X-ray shows indistinct right hemidiaphragm with abnormal lucency
rules.checkpoint: 是否优先排查肺空气腔疾病？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is airspace disease prioritized for checking?
rules.error_behavior: 错误排除右肺下叶空气腔疾病，误判透亮度位置诊断膈疝
rules.correct_reasoning: 右半膈模糊符合轮廓征，空气腔疾病可致该表现，透亮度来自病灶内充气支气管

rules.rule: 慢性胃肠症状合并AKI，勿排除蛋白质沉积病因
rules.rule_en: For chronic GI symptoms with AKI, do not dismiss protein deposition as a cause
rules.scenario: 评估合并慢性胃肠症状患者的AKI病因时
rules.scenario_en: When evaluating the cause of AKI in patients with chronic GI symptoms
rules.checkpoint: 是否排除了蛋白质沉积病因？
rules.checkpoint_en: Has protein deposition as a cause been ruled out?
rules.error_behavior: 错误排除蛋白质沉积，将AKI归因于癫痫相关肌肉损伤，忽略矛盾实验室结果
rules.correct_reasoning: 慢性胃肠症状可继发蛋白质沉积，可解释本例异常结果，黄尿、ALT更高不支持肌肉损伤

rules.rule: 识别滑液晶体需先明确形态和双折射特征
rules.rule_en: Identify synovial crystals by morphology and birefringence first
rules.scenario: 鉴别晶体性关节病，判读滑液偏振镜结果时
rules.scenario_en: When differentiating crystal arthropathies and interpreting synovial polarized microscopy results
rules.checkpoint: 是否正确识别晶体形态和双折射特征？
rules.checkpoint_en: Are crystal morphology and birefringence correctly identified?
rules.error_behavior: 误将CPPD阳性双折射菱形晶体认作痛风阴性双折射针状晶体
rules.correct_reasoning: 先根据晶体形态和双折射明确诊断，CPPD典型影像学表现是软骨钙化症

rules.rule: 判断胰管胆总管位置，勿误认胰管越胆总管
rules.rule_en: Do not misidentify pancreatic duct crossing common bile duct
rules.scenario: 读MRCP判断胰管与胆总管相对位置时
rules.scenario_en: Judging relative position of pancreatic duct and common bile duct on MRCP
rules.checkpoint: 胰管是否越过胆总管？
rules.checkpoint_en: Does pancreatic duct cross common bile duct?
rules.error_behavior: 错误认为胰管走行越过胆总管前方
rules.correct_reasoning: 该MRCP中胰管并未越过胆总管，正确答案为否

rules.rule: 经皮胆管造影中，显影分支是胆管而非门静脉分支
rules.rule_en: On percutaneous cholangiogram, opacified branches are biliary ducts not portal veins
rules.scenario: 判断经皮肝穿刺胆管造影显示的操作类型时
rules.scenario_en: When identifying procedure on percutaneous transhepatic cholangiogram
rules.checkpoint: 显影分支是胆管还是门静脉？
rules.checkpoint_en: Are opacified branches biliary or portal veins?
rules.error_behavior: 将显影的分支胆管错认为门静脉分支，误选栓塞术
rules.correct_reasoning: 该图像是胆管造影，显影分支为胆管，操作是胆道结扎

rules.rule: CRBSI合并难置换导管，应尝试保留行锁治疗+全身抗生素
rules.rule_en: For CRBSI with hard-to-replace CVC, attempt salvage with lock + systemic antibiotics

rules.scenario_en: When hemodialysis patients develop CRBSI with difficult venous access
rules.checkpoint: 该中心导管是否难以置换？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is the central venous catheter hard to replace?
rules.error_behavior: 错误建议拔除中心导管，未考虑困难静脉通路
rules.correct_reasoning: 稳定患者难置换导管CRBSI，予抗生素锁联合全身万古霉素

rules.rule: 青少年急性重度月经出血首选大剂量口服避孕药减量
rules.rule_en: High-dose oral contraceptive pill taper is first-line for acute adolescent heavy menstrual bleeding

rules.scenario_en: Acute heavy menstrual bleeding in non-pregnant adolescents with suspected bleeding diathesis
rules.checkpoint: 青少年急性月经出血首选口服避孕药减量吗？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is OCP taper first-line for acute adolescent menorrhagia?
rules.error_behavior: 错误认为口服避孕药减量仅用于慢性管理，不适用于急性出血
rules.correct_reasoning: 大剂量口服避孕药减量是青少年急性重度月经出血公认一线初始干预，可快速止血

rules.rule: 无CT证据勿假设多发脑病变，需排查原发肿瘤
rules.rule_en: Do not assume multiple lesions without CT evidence, check for primary malignancy

rules.scenario_en: Diagnosing brain mass in elderly patient with increased intracranial pressure
rules.checkpoint: CT是否提示多发脑占位病变？
rules.checkpoint_en: Does CT confirm multiple brain lesions?
rules.error_behavior: 错误假设CT存在多发脑病变，无原发肿瘤史诊断转移瘤
rules.correct_reasoning: 基于实际CT判断病变数量，无原发肿瘤史先考虑原发脑肿瘤

rules.rule: 肉毒毒素题目需评估所有正确毒素性质，不只看作用机制
rules.rule_en: For botulinum toxin questions, evaluate all true toxin properties not just mechanism
rules.scenario: 临床疑诊肉毒中毒，询问毒素性质的选择题
rules.scenario_en: Multiple-choice questions asking for toxin properties when botulism is suspected
rules.checkpoint: 是否已评估所有符合毒素性质的选项？
rules.checkpoint_en: Have all toxin property matching options been evaluated?

rules.correct_reasoning: 先诊断肉毒中毒，明确肉毒毒素可诱导宿主产生高滴度抗体，因此选项B描述正确

rules.rule: Check lesion location when diagnosing intramedullary spinal cord tumors
rules.rule_en: Check lesion location when diagnosing intramedullary spinal cord tumors
rules.scenario: Differentiating ependymoma from astrocytoma on spinal cord MRI
rules.scenario_en: Differentiating ependymoma from astrocytoma on spinal cord MRI
rules.checkpoint: Is the lesion central or eccentric?
rules.checkpoint_en: Is the lesion central or eccentric?
rules.error_behavior: Mischaracterized lesion location as eccentric, incorrectly ruled out ependymoma
rules.correct_reasoning: Central location favors ependymoma, eccentric favors astrocytoma. Ependymoma can have patchy irregular enhancement.

rules.rule: HVLA engages the restrictive barrier, not its opposite
rules.rule_en: HVLA direct technique engages the restrictive barrier, not its opposite
rules.scenario: Positioning for lumbar HVLA treatment of somatic dysfunction
rules.scenario_en: Positioning for lumbar HVLA treatment of somatic dysfunction
rules.checkpoint: Does this position engage the restrictive barrier?
rules.checkpoint_en: Does this position engage the restrictive barrier?
rules.error_behavior: Reversed position of ease and restrictive barrier, incorrectly claimed HVLA positions opposite the barrier
rules.correct_reasoning: Posterior transverse process less prominent in extension means the segment is held in flexion (position of ease) and restricted in extension (restrictive barrier). HVLA is direct technique that engages the barrier before thrust.

rules.rule: 运动相关无症状肌块勿排除肌肉撕裂假性肿瘤

rules.checkpoint: 是否排除了肌肉撕裂假性肿瘤？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is muscle tear pseudotumor excluded?

rules.correct_reasoning: 慢性过度使用肌肉撕裂可无症状，符合表现应诊断该病

rules.rule: Acalculous cholecystitis diagnosis needs active disease findings not just no stones

rules.rule: 读胸部CT需准确辨认支气管解剖避免肿瘤错定位

rules.rule: 小转子下前向后交锁钉更易伤及股神经股深动脉分支

rules.checkpoint_en: Is anterior-to-posterior placement below lesser trochanter higher risk?
rules.error_behavior: 错误判断侧向内置钉风险最高，错误定位神经血管位置
rules.correct_reasoning: 小转子下股神经股深动脉分支位于股骨前方，前向后置钉需穿过这些结构，风险更高

rules.rule: 解读阴茎ED多普勒，勿加未提供临床信息

rules.correct_reasoning: PSV低于阈值提示动脉不足，选混合病因不 extrapolate

rules.rule: 距门齿24cm食管狭窄位于上纵隔，牢记解剖分区

rules.correct_reasoning: 根据距离对应关系，24cm食管狭窄位于上纵隔，排除错误选项

rules.rule: 主肺动脉宽于升主动脉时，勿排除肺动脉瓣狭窄

rules.scenario_en: When imaging shows main pulmonary artery diameter larger than ascending aorta

rules.checkpoint_en: Did you incorrectly exclude pulmonary valve stenosis?
rules.error_behavior: 模型错误认为弥漫主肺动脉增宽仅见于肺动脉高压，排除了肺动脉瓣狭窄
rules.correct_reasoning: 二者均可致主肺动脉宽于升主动脉，需评估肺动脉瓣明确诊断

rules.rule: Post CDH intubation, first perform nasogastric decompression

rules.correct_reasoning: After CDH diagnosis and intubation, first place NG tube to decompress herniated bowel. Definitive surgery is done after stabilization, not immediately.

rules.rule: 垂体腺瘤考题，勿强制答案覆盖所有腺瘤类型
rules.rule_en: For pituitary adenoma questions, don't force answer to cover all adenoma types

rules.correct_reasoning: 题目只需选符合要求的单个 scenario，无需覆盖所有腺瘤；伴视交叉压迫的非分泌大腺瘤需手术，B不符合规范，C正确

rules.rule: When distinguishing spinal schwannoma vs myeloma, check cortical preservation despite bone loss
rules.rule_en: When distinguishing spinal schwannoma vs myeloma, check cortical preservation despite bone loss

rules.scenario_en: Distinguishing spinal schwannoma from myeloma on spinal imaging

rules.checkpoint_en: Is cortical preserved despite bone loss?
rules.error_behavior: Incorrectly claimed schwannoma has bone remodeling without lytic destruction, rejected option A
rules.correct_reasoning: Slow-growing spinal schwannoma causes bone loss with preserved cortical margins, while myeloma causes cortical breach. Cortical preservation favors schwannoma

rules.rule: Subcutaneous edema without bone marrow edema favors skin infection over chronic osteomyelitis
rules.rule_en: Subcutaneous edema without bone marrow edema favors skin infection over chronic osteomyelitis

rules.scenario_en: MRI shows T1 hypointense changes, subcutaneous edema, absent bone marrow edema
rules.checkpoint: Is bone marrow edema absent with subcutaneous edema?
rules.checkpoint_en: Is bone marrow edema absent with subcutaneous edema?
rules.error_behavior: Incorrectly assumed quiescent chronic osteomyelitis causes subcutaneous edema without bone marrow edema
rules.correct_reasoning: Quiescent chronic osteomyelitis doesn't cause active subcutaneous edema; this presentation favors reactive skin infection not progressed to osteomyelitis

rules.rule: 坐骨神经旁圆形卵石样病变，先排查脱出钙化椎间盘碎片

rules.rule: 胰腺肿块伴钙化，勿漏诊黏液性囊性肿瘤恶变

rules.rule: 诊断需核对选项核心特征是否匹配题干表现
rules.rule_en: Check if option core features match the given findings

rules.scenario_en: When matching diagnostic options to given intracranial imaging findings
rules.checkpoint: 选项核心特征是否符合题干表现？

rules.correct_reasoning: 早期骨髓炎会取代脂肪骨髓导致T1信号降低，本例符合痛风伴侵蚀囊肿表现，正确答案为C

rules.rule: 代理请求与生前预嘱冲突时，先讨论再遵患愿

rules.rule: 肾囊性病灶需整体评估，勿拆分多模态影像

rules.correct_reasoning: 所有模态显示同一病灶，整体评估为复杂囊性病灶伴潜在恶性

rules.rule: Medial patellofemoral arthrosis: medial tibial tubercle transfer is contraindicated

rules.rule: Differential bronchial visibility on CT: non-visible are collapsed/obstructed

rules.correct_reasoning: Potter面容可继发于羊水过少序列，年轻初产妇是子痫前期高危，子痫前期可致羊水过少引发该序列

rules.rule: 趾间肿块需依据T2信号鉴别神经瘤和滑囊炎

rules.rule: 新生儿早期皮疹勿默认感染，需排除母体SLE致新生儿狼疮

rules.rule: 踝关节内翻损伤伴关节松弛需排查腓骨头移位

rules.checkpoint: 该损伤是否存在腓骨头移位？

rules.checkpoint: 患者符合指南适应证吗？
rules.checkpoint_en: Does the patient meet guideline indication?

rules.correct_reasoning: 仅处方Omega-3被指南推荐给特定符合指征患者，该患者不符合，非处方Omega-3无明确获益，本题正确答案是维生素E

rules.rule: 灶状T1低信号骨髓可表现为早期骨髓炎，需查周围改变

rules.checkpoint_en: Is this lesion early osteomyelitis?

rules.rule: 劳力性热射病合并高钠血症，首选乳酸林格而非生理盐水

rules.correct_reasoning: 乳酸林格是等渗晶体，不会过快纠正高钠，乳酸代谢为碳酸氢根可纠正轻度酸中毒，相比生理盐水不会加重高氯血症，因此更适合

rules.rule: Severe OI 12yo 42° progressive scoliosis, prefer posterior fusion

rules.checkpoint_en: Is 42° progressive OI scoliosis treated with posterior fusion?

rules.rule: 化疗致心律失常需考虑合并化疗诱导心脏毒性

rules.error_behavior: 错误认为化疗诱导心脏毒性必须伴心肌标志物异常
rules.correct_reasoning: 急性化疗心脏毒性可仅表现为心律失常，标志物可正常，无既往心脏病史不能假设心功能异常为陈旧性，需考虑合并心脏毒性

rules.rule: Check all images for all findings before diagnosis

rules.correct_reasoning: Check all images, confirm lingual thyroid with calcifications and absent anterior neck thyroid matches A

rules.rule: 评估膝韧带损伤需关注韧带内信号，不单看连续性
rules.rule_en: When evaluating knee ligament injury, check intraligamentous signal not just continuity

rules.checkpoint: 韧带内是否存在异常高信号？

rules.correct_reasoning: 除观察纤维连续性，还要查看韧带内信号判断损伤

rules.rule: 孤立小腿骨筋膜室综合征不影响同侧股骨远端IO置管
rules.rule_en: Isolated calf compartment syndrome does not contraindicate ipsilateral distal femur IO insertion

rules.scenario_en: Need to change IO insertion site with isolated ipsilateral calf compartment syndrome
rules.checkpoint: 骨筋膜室综合征是否累及股骨远端？
rules.checkpoint_en: Does compartment syndrome involve distal femur?
rules.error_behavior: 错误认为同侧小腿骨筋膜室综合征禁用同侧股骨远端IO
rules.correct_reasoning: 孤立小腿骨筋膜室仅累及小腿，同侧股骨远端可放置IO

rules.rule: CTPA不确定异常，优先考虑影像学伪影而非变异
rules.rule_en: For inconclusive CTPA findings, prioritize imaging artifact over anatomic variation

rules.checkpoint_en: Is the inconclusive abnormality an imaging artifact?
rules.error_behavior: 模型将不确定异常错判为正常解剖变异，而非影像学伪影
rules.correct_reasoning: CTPA无主肺动脉充盈缺损时，不确定异常更可能是影像学伪影而非解剖变异

rules.rule: Do not invent unstated clinical context, stick to given info
rules.rule_en: Do not invent unstated clinical context, stick to given information

rules.scenario_en: When only normal B12 and thyroid function are given with no other clinical context

rules.correct_reasoning: Do not add unstated context, stick to what is given in the question

rules.rule: 椎体见脂肪浸润，先考虑血管瘤而非骨折后脂肪替代

rules.checkpoint_en: Is there characteristic fatty infiltration?
rules.error_behavior: 将椎体脂肪浸润误认作骨折后脂肪替代，排除血管瘤
rules.correct_reasoning: 脂肪浸润是椎体血管瘤特征，血管瘤可继发病理性骨折，不能因骨折排除血管瘤

rules.rule: Confirm abbreviation definitions in options before diagnosis

rules.scenario_en: Choosing between diagnostic options for post-transplant lymphoproliferative disorder

rules.correct_reasoning: Confirm abbreviation definitions first, do not assume prior unconfirmed lesions are same disease, match features to correct diagnosis

rules.scenario_en: Confirmed STEMI with uncorrected severe hypoxemia, determining next step
rules.checkpoint: 患者低氧血症是否已经纠正？

rules.correct_reasoning: 病例未提示已吸氧，严重低氧血症需优先纠正，遵循ABC原则

rules.checkpoint_en: Have I checked all visible organs on CT?
rules.error_behavior: 误判正常肠管为弥漫增厚伴脂肪条索，误诊炎症性肠病
rules.correct_reasoning: 逐一观察所有可见结构，本例肠管正常，肝可见符合肝囊肿的病变

rules.rule: 读题明确要求，勿混淆确诊与继发表现
rules.rule_en: Clarify question requirements, don't confuse diagnosis with complications
rules.scenario: 题干给出疑似囊性纤维化病例，询问进一步检查结果
rules.scenario_en: Suspected cystic fibrosis case, asking for findings of further evaluation
rules.checkpoint: 问题要求找确诊还是继发表现？
rules.checkpoint_en: Does the question ask for diagnosis or complication?
rules.error_behavior: 模型误把问题要求当成找确诊金标准，选了升高的汗氯离子
rules.correct_reasoning: 题干问进一步检查最可能发现，囊性纤维化致维生素K吸收障碍，凝血酶原时间升高

rules.rule: 新生儿产后头皮肿胀需结合临床特征匹配正确解剖间隙
rules.rule_en: Match correct anatomical space by clinical features for newborn scalp swelling
rules.scenario: 真空辅助分娩后新生儿迟发头皮肿胀，判断受累解剖间隙
rules.scenario_en: Determine involved anatomical space for delayed newborn scalp swelling after vacuum delivery
rules.checkpoint: 临床特征是否匹配正确解剖间隙？
rules.checkpoint_en: Does clinical feature match correct anatomical space?
rules.error_behavior: 错判稳定头围意义，错配瘀斑与头颅血肿，错误限定解剖间隙病变
rules.correct_reasoning: 按出现时间、跨缝情况、瘀斑、头围变化区分类型，再匹配对应解剖间隙

rules.rule: When asked for additional findings, do not reuse already described findings
rules.rule_en: When asked for additional findings, do not reuse already described findings
rules.scenario: When asked to identify an additional finding to support a suspected diagnosis
rules.scenario_en: When asked to identify an additional finding to support a suspected diagnosis
rules.checkpoint: Is this finding an additional, not already described one?
rules.checkpoint_en: Is this finding an additional, not already described one?
rules.error_behavior: Reused an already described skin finding and incorrectly dismissed beefy red tongue as a pellagra finding
rules.correct_reasoning: First confirm the finding is additional, not already described; then recognize beefy red tongue is a valid pellagra finding

rules.rule: 腋窝中央透亮圆形钙化是真皮钙化而非分泌性
rules.rule_en: Lucent-centered round axillary calcifications are dermal not secretory
rules.scenario: 鉴别乳腺钼靶中的腋窝钙化类型时适用
rules.scenario_en: Applicable when classifying axillary calcifications on mammography
rules.checkpoint: 该腋窝钙化是否为真皮钙化？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is this axillary calcification dermal?
rules.error_behavior: 误将中央透亮圆形腋窝钙化认作分泌性钙化，错描述真皮钙化特征
rules.correct_reasoning: 腋窝圆形中央透亮钙化是典型真皮皮脂腺钙化，应诊为真皮钙化

rules.rule: AFib with decompensated HF: avoid diltiazem, use amiodarone
rules.rule_en: For AFib with decompensated HF, avoid diltiazem, use amiodarone
rules.scenario: Acute AFib with decompensated heart failure needing rate control
rules.scenario_en: Acute atrial fibrillation with decompensated heart failure requiring rate control
rules.checkpoint: Is diltiazem contraindicated in this patient?
rules.checkpoint_en: Is diltiazem contraindicated in this patient?
rules.error_behavior: Model selected diltiazem, ignoring its negative inotropic contraindication in decompensated HF
rules.correct_reasoning: Diltiazem has negative inotropy, contraindicated in decompensated HF; amiodarone with minimal negative inotropy is appropriate

rules.rule: Palpable nodules are superficial, not deep non-palpable structures
rules.rule_en: Palpable nodules are superficial, not deep non-palpable structures
rules.scenario: Locating a palpable gangliform nodule in acute pancreatitis
rules.scenario_en: Locating a palpable gangliform nodule in acute pancreatitis
rules.checkpoint: Is the palpable nodule superficial?
rules.checkpoint_en: Is the palpable nodule superficial?
rules.error_behavior: Incorrectly eliminated intercostal options, assumed nodule is deep paravertebral
rules.correct_reasoning: Palpable nodules must be superficial. Tender gangliform nodules in pancreatitis are at superficial intercostal spaces, not deep non-palpable paravertebral.

rules.rule: 未成年急性伤害风险，联系家属获信息无需同意
rules.rule_en: For at-risk minors, contact family for info without consent
rules.scenario: 未成年人独自就诊，存在急性自伤风险时
rules.scenario_en: When a minor presents alone with acute self-harm risk
rules.checkpoint: 该未成年人是否存在急性伤害风险？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is the minor at acute risk of harm?
rules.error_behavior: 错误认为联系家属需未成年人同意且会延误治疗
rules.correct_reasoning: 未成年人有急性伤害风险时，联系家属获取旁证信息无需其同意，信息对后续诊疗至关重要，应优先获取

rules.rule: 发现口腔黏膜白斑，优先排查酒精危险因素
rules.rule_en: For oral leukoplakia, check alcohol risk first
rules.scenario: 体格检查发现口腔黏膜病灶，判断危险因素时
rules.scenario_en: When identifying risk factors of oral mucosal lesions on physical exam
rules.checkpoint: 是否正确识别病灶并匹配危险因素？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is lesion correctly identified and risk matched?
rules.error_behavior: 错误将口腔黏膜白斑识别为性传播疾病病灶，误将性行为作为危险因素
rules.correct_reasoning: 正确识别病灶为口腔黏膜白斑，其明确危险因素包含酒精消耗，因此选酒精消耗

rules.rule: V1节段性面部婴儿血管瘤需先筛PHACE心脏异常
rules.rule_en: Segmental V1 facial IH needs PHACE cardiac screening first
rules.scenario: 评估节段性面部婴儿血管瘤下一步处理方案时
rules.scenario_en: When evaluating next management for segmental facial infantile hemangioma
rules.checkpoint: 是否需优先筛查PHACE相关心脏异常？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is priority PHACE cardiac screening needed?
rules.error_behavior: 误判急性视力威胁，立即选普萘洛尔，漏筛PHACE心脏异常
rules.correct_reasoning: V1节段性面部血管瘤需优先筛PHACE心脏异常，首选超声心动图，无急性威胁无需立即用普萘洛尔

rules.rule: 检查发现的排列顺序不影响答案正确性
rules.rule_en: Order of listed findings does not affect answer correctness
rules.scenario: 多选题选择描述影像发现组合的最优答案时
rules.scenario_en: When selecting the best answer describing combinations of imaging findings in MCQs
rules.checkpoint: 排列顺序是否决定答案正确性？
rules.checkpoint_en: Does listing order determine answer correctness?
rules.error_behavior: 模型按发现排列顺序匹配题干选答案，错误选D
rules.correct_reasoning: 内容正确即符合要求，正确答案应为A

rules.rule: 诊断短肢侏儒症需先识别特征性影像再分型
rules.rule_en: Identify characteristic imaging before typing short-limbed dwarfism
rules.scenario: 根据影像学诊断儿童短肢侏儒症病因时
rules.scenario_en: Diagnosing the cause of pediatric short-limbed dwarfism via imaging
rules.checkpoint: 是否识别了特征性影像表现？
rules.checkpoint_en: Have characteristic imaging findings been identified?
rules.error_behavior: 错误识别影像特征，误判畸形性发育不良为软骨发育不全
rules.correct_reasoning: 先识别特征影像，搭便车拇指、耳异常提示畸形性发育不良，病因为硫酸转运蛋白基因突变

rules.rule: 尺神经病变需结合运动感觉功能区分分支
rules.rule_en: Ulnar neuropathy requires distinguishing branches via motor and sensory function
rules.scenario: 查体发现尺神经支配区功能异常，判断受累分支时
rules.scenario_en: When judging the involved nerve branch after detecting abnormal function in ulnar nerve innervation area on physical examination
rules.checkpoint: 是否同时考虑了运动和感觉功能？
rules.checkpoint_en: Did you consider both motor and sensory functions?
rules.error_behavior: 错误假设病变仅为运动缺陷，仅依运动异常选尺神经深支，忽略感觉异常
rules.correct_reasoning: 先明确各分支功能，尺神经深支仅司运动，全尺神经含运动感觉，结合查体的运动+感觉异常选对应神经

rules.rule: 妇科近距离治疗需分次单独勾画直肠和乙状结肠
rules.rule_en: In gynecologic brachytherapy, contour rectum and sigmoid separately per fraction
rules.scenario: 妇科近距离治疗计划评估直肠乙状结肠受量时
rules.scenario_en: When assessing dose to rectum and sigmoid in gynecologic brachytherapy planning
rules.checkpoint: 是否分次单独勾画直肠和乙状结肠?
rules.checkpoint_en: Is rectum and sigmoid contoured separately per fraction?
rules.error_behavior: 错误拒绝分开分次勾画，忽略位置变异影响剂量评估
rules.correct_reasoning: 直肠乙状结肠分次位置变异大，需分开分次勾画准确评估剂量

rules.rule: 近期用光敏药后户外发疹先排除光性皮炎
rules.rule_en: Rule out photodermatitis first for outdoor rash with recent photosensitizing drug use
rules.scenario: 近期接受药物治疗，户外园艺后新发皮疹需鉴别诊断时
rules.scenario_en: When differential diagnosis of new rash after outdoor gardening with recent medication
rules.checkpoint: 患者近期是否使用过光敏药物？
rules.checkpoint_en: Has the patient used photosensitizing drugs recently?
rules.error_behavior: 忽略光敏药物用药史，误将园艺后皮疹诊断为毒常春藤皮炎
rules.correct_reasoning: 关注近期用药史，莱姆病治疗用多西环素是光敏药，前臂日晒后发疹先考虑光性皮炎

rules.rule: 一侧后横突提示椎体向该侧旋转
rules.rule_en: Posterior transverse process indicates rotation toward that side
rules.scenario: 骨病检查判断胸椎功能紊乱旋转方向时
rules.scenario_en: When judging rotation direction of thoracic dysfunction
rules.checkpoint: 后横突侧是否提示椎体向该侧旋转？
rules.checkpoint_en: Does posterior transverse process indicate rotation toward that side?
rules.error_behavior: 错误认为一侧后横突提示椎体向对侧旋转
rules.correct_reasoning: 一侧后横突提示椎体向该侧旋转，符合Fryette第二定律，旋转侧屈同向

rules.rule: 肾绞痛腰痛为同侧，需查同侧输尿管壁段结石
rules.rule_en: Renal colic flank pain is ipsilateral, check ipsilateral UVJ stones
rules.scenario: 单侧腰痛疑似肾绞痛行CT尿路造影检查
rules.scenario_en: Unilateral flank pain suspicious for renal colic on CT urography
rules.checkpoint: 腰痛与结石位置是否同侧？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is flank pain ipsilateral to stone location?
rules.error_behavior: 错误认为左肾结石可引起对侧右腰痛，漏诊右侧UVJ结石
rules.correct_reasoning: 肾绞痛腰痛为同侧，同侧肾积水需排查同侧UVJ是否有结石

rules.rule: CT见结肠对比剂充盈缺损先排查穿孔，勿误判憩室
rules.rule_en: Rule out perforation first for contrast-filled colon defect on CT
rules.scenario: CT读片发现结肠局灶对比剂充盈缺损时
rules.scenario_en: When focal contrast-filled defect of colon is found on CT reading
rules.checkpoint: 是否已先排除结肠穿孔可能？
rules.checkpoint_en: Has colonic perforation been ruled out first?
rules.error_behavior: 误将局限性穿孔漏口对比剂外渗当成正常憩室对比剂积聚，错误认为穿孔必有广泛游离对比剂
rules.correct_reasoning: 小局限性结肠穿孔可表现为局灶对比剂充盈漏口，需先排查穿孔，区分憩室和穿孔漏口

rules.rule: 读头颅矢状位MRI需全面检查，勿漏斜坡区异常
rules.rule_en: When reading sagittal cranial MRI, check all structures to avoid missing clival abnormalities
rules.scenario: 分析头颅矢状位MRI的主要异常时
rules.scenario_en: When analyzing the main abnormality on sagittal cranial MRI
rules.checkpoint: 是否检查全了解剖区域的异常？
rules.checkpoint_en: Have you checked all anatomical regions for abnormalities?
rules.error_behavior: 错将空蝶鞍当成主要异常，漏诊了下位斜坡区肿块
rules.correct_reasoning: 全面扫查所有结构，明确主要异常是下位斜坡肿块

rules.rule: Unknown maternal HBV status, give only HBV vaccine within 12h birth
rules.rule_en: When maternal HBV status is unknown, give only HBV vaccine within 12h of birth
rules.scenario: Neonate born to mother with unknown HBV status at delivery
rules.scenario_en: Neonate born to mother with unknown HBV status at delivery
rules.checkpoint: Empiric HBIG needed for unknown maternal HBV?
rules.checkpoint_en: Is empiric HBIG needed for unknown maternal HBV status?
rules.error_behavior: Incorrectly recommended empiric HBIG plus vaccine within 12h when status unknown
rules.correct_reasoning: Only HBV vaccine within 12h, HBIG added later if mom tests HBsAg positive

rules.rule: Distinguishing diffuse Hashimoto: prioritize echogenic fibrotic lines
rules.rule_en: When distinguishing diffuse Hashimoto, prioritize echogenic fibrotic lines
rules.scenario: Distinguishing diffuse thyroid pathology from other diffuse conditions on ultrasound
rules.scenario_en: Distinguishing diffuse thyroid pathology from other diffuse conditions on ultrasound
rules.checkpoint: Are echogenic lines fibrotic fibrils or interstitial spaces?
rules.checkpoint_en: Are echogenic lines fibrotic fibrils or interstitial spaces?
rules.error_behavior: Misidentified echogenic white lines as interstitial spaces, incorrectly selected F
rules.correct_reasoning: Defining feature of diffuse Hashimoto is echogenic lines representing fibrotic fibrils, which is the most definitive distinguishing feature, so answer C is correct. Pseudo-nodular appearance is non-specific.

rules.rule: 绝经前附件肿块伴甲亢，需排除卵巢甲状腺肿
rules.rule_en: Premenopausal adnexal mass with hyperthyroidism, rule out struma ovarii
rules.scenario: 诊断绝经前女性伴全身症状的附件肿块起源时
rules.scenario_en: When diagnosing origin of adnexal mass with systemic symptoms in premenopausal women
rules.checkpoint: 患者是否存在甲状腺功能亢进症状？
rules.checkpoint_en: Does the patient have hyperthyroidism symptoms?
rules.error_behavior: 忽略甲亢相关症状，未考虑卵巢甲状腺肿，错误归为上皮来源
rules.correct_reasoning: 整合所有症状，低热心动过速反射亢进提示甲亢，40岁以下绝经前女性附件肿块需优先考虑生殖细胞来源的卵巢甲状腺肿

rules.rule: 选异位甲状旁腺腺瘤答案需核对位置描述
rules.rule_en: Check location description when selecting answer for ectopic parathyroid adenoma
rules.scenario: 作答异位甲状旁腺腺瘤影像试题时
rules.scenario_en: When answering imaging questions about ectopic parathyroid adenoma
rules.checkpoint: 选项描述位置和影像一致吗？
rules.checkpoint_en: Does the option location match imaging?
rules.error_behavior: 忽略B选项中纵隔位置描述和实际病变位置不符
rules.correct_reasoning: 逐个核对选项描述的位置，排除位置不符合的B，选位置正确的A

rules.rule: 发现肺泡沫巨噬细胞需先排查用药史再诊断
rules.rule_en: Check medication history before diagnosing when finding pulmonary foamy macrophages
rules.scenario: 分析肺活检病理诊断肺部疾病发现泡沫巨噬细胞时
rules.scenario_en: When analyzing lung biopsy for pulmonary disease and foamy macrophages are found
rules.checkpoint: 是否已排查患者相关用药史？
rules.checkpoint_en: Has relevant medication history been checked?
rules.error_behavior: 错误认为肺内泡沫巨噬细胞是胺碘酮肺损伤特有，选了宽泛诊断
rules.correct_reasoning: 泡沫巨噬细胞非胺碘酮特有，本病例病理明确为继发性机化性肺炎，选特定诊断

rules.rule: 睾丸局灶病变超声需看血流区分梗死与附睾睾丸炎
rules.rule_en: Check flow to distinguish infarction vs epididymo-orchitis for focal testicular lesion on US
rules.scenario: 儿童睾丸疼痛超声见睾丸局灶病变，需鉴别诊断时
rules.scenario_en: Differential diagnosis of focal testicular lesion on ultrasound in child with testicular pain
rules.checkpoint: 病变区域有无血流信号？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is there vascular flow in the focal lesion?
rules.error_behavior: 误将带血流的局灶睾丸病变诊断为节段性睾丸梗死，排除急性附睾睾丸炎
rules.correct_reasoning: 先观察病变区血流，无血流才考虑节段性梗死，血流增加提示急性附睾睾丸炎

rules.rule: 急重症遵循ABC原则，优先纠正危及生命的低氧
rules.rule_en: Follow ABC principle for acute illness, correct life-threatening hypoxemia first
rules.scenario: 急诊处理合并低氧血症的急重症患者时
rules.scenario_en: Emergency management of acutely ill patients with hypoxemia
rules.checkpoint: 是否遵循ABC处理优先级原则？
rules.checkpoint_en: Does it follow ABC priority principle?
rules.error_behavior: 错误将手术治疗放在纠正低氧血症之前，违反ABC原则
rules.correct_reasoning: 急重症处理先遵循ABC原则纠正低氧，再处理原发病

rules.rule: 精索扭转伴保留动脉血流优先考虑早期扭转
rules.rule_en: Prioritize early-stage torsion for spermatic cord torsion with preserved arterial flow
rules.scenario: 多普勒超声发现精索扭转伴保留动脉血流，判断病因时
rules.scenario_en: When judging cause of spermatic cord torsion with preserved arterial flow on Doppler
rules.checkpoint: 是否优先考虑早期睾丸扭转？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is early-stage testicular torsion prioritized?
rules.error_behavior: 错误排除早期扭转，误将该表现归为部分扭转
rules.correct_reasoning: 早期扭转先阻静脉，动脉因高压仍保血流，该表现优先考虑早期扭转

rules.rule: 诊断肘内翻需明确：携带角减小，远尺内收，腕外展
rules.rule_en: Diagnose cubitus varus: decreased carrying angle, adducted distal ulna, abducted wrist
rules.scenario: 判断肘内翻的体格检查特征时
rules.scenario_en: When judging the physical findings of cubitus varus
rules.checkpoint: 肘内翻的体格特征是否识别正确？
rules.checkpoint_en: Are cubitus varus findings correctly identified?
rules.error_behavior: 错误颠倒远端尺骨和腕部位置，认为远尺外展腕内收
rules.correct_reasoning: 肘内翻正确特征是携带角减小，远端尺骨内收，腕部外展

rules.rule: 疑心包疾病，无积液不能诊断心脏压塞
rules.rule_en: Do not diagnose cardiac tamponade without confirmed pericardial effusion
rules.scenario: 鉴别心包疾病，超声见舒张功能受损时
rules.scenario_en: Differentiating pericardial diseases when echo shows impaired diastolic filling
rules.checkpoint: 是否存在明确的心包积液？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is there confirmed pericardial effusion?
rules.error_behavior: 误判ECG为电交替，无积液仍诊断心脏压塞
rules.correct_reasoning: 无明确心包积液不支持心脏压塞，符合缩窄性心包炎

rules.rule: Confirm 5-letter thoracic dysfunction code structure first
rules.rule_en: Confirm correct 5-letter thoracic dysfunction code structure first
rules.scenario: Diagnosing thoracic somatic dysfunction with 5-letter code options
rules.scenario_en: Diagnosing thoracic somatic dysfunction with 5-letter code options
rules.checkpoint: Is the 5-letter code structure correct?
rules.checkpoint_en: Is the 5-letter code structure correct?
rules.error_behavior: Misdefined 5-letter code structure, incorrectly eliminated correct option
rules.correct_reasoning: First confirm standard 5-letter code: 1=F/E/N, 2=rotation R/L, 3=sidebending R/L, 4=rot/sb relationship, 5=side of anterior transverse. Left T7 transverse anterior → rotation right, sidebending left, neutral → NSLRR.

rules.rule: 解读影像前先确认正确的解剖位置
rules.rule_en: Confirm correct anatomic location before interpreting imaging
rules.scenario: 解读联合MRI和多普勒超声的血管影像时
rules.scenario_en: When interpreting vascular imaging combining MRI and Doppler ultrasound
rules.checkpoint: 解剖位置是否确认正确？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is the anatomic location correctly confirmed?
rules.error_behavior: 错将脑血管影像认定为盆腔影像，误判表现选错答案
rules.correct_reasoning: 先确认解剖位置为脑血管，再匹配诊断排除错误选项

rules.rule: CTPA先确认靶血管，勿误认邻旁组织为栓塞
rules.rule_en: Confirm target vessel first in CTPA, avoid misidentifying adjacent tissue as embolism

rules.scenario_en: When reading CTPA for finding pulmonary embolism filling defect
rules.checkpoint: 是否已确认目标结构为肺动脉分支？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is the target structure confirmed as pulmonary artery branch?

rules.checkpoint_en: Is measurement direction and anatomy correctly identified?
rules.error_behavior: 误将垂直测量的Line5认作股骨偏心距，错判Line4为髋臼测量
rules.correct_reasoning: 先明确股骨偏心距定义，识别圆形结构为股骨头假体，Line4符合定义

rules.rule: 半髋置换术后不稳，优先考虑认知障碍致不依从
rules.rule_en: For instability after hemiarthroplasty, consider cognitive impairment causing noncompliance first
rules.scenario: 半髋置换术后发生髋关节脱位不稳，明确病因时
rules.scenario_en: When identifying the cause of hip dislocation instability after hemiarthroplasty
rules.checkpoint: 是否存在认知障碍影响依从性？
rules.checkpoint_en: Does cognitive impairment affect compliance?
rules.error_behavior: 错误低估痴呆对术后不稳的作用，误认技术因素为首要原因
rules.correct_reasoning: 痴呆致患者无法遵守术后活动禁忌，无技术问题证据时优先考虑它是不稳原因

rules.rule: 单骨折线穿双柱的髋臼骨折为横形而非双柱骨折
rules.rule_en: Acetabular fracture with single line through both columns is transverse, not both-column
rules.scenario: 应用Letournel分型对CT髋臼骨折进行分类时
rules.scenario_en: Classifying acetabular fracture with Letournel classification on CT
rules.checkpoint: 是否为单骨折线贯穿双柱？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is it a single fracture line through both columns?
rules.error_behavior: 错误认为横形骨折不贯穿双柱，误判为双柱骨折
rules.correct_reasoning: 横形骨折是单骨折线穿前后双柱，双柱骨折需各柱单独骨折线伴漂浮髋臼

rules.rule: 题干要求干预措施时，需区分诊断与治疗
rules.rule_en: When asked for intervention, distinguish diagnosis from therapy
rules.scenario: 题干询问解决患者主要症状的最适当干预措施时
rules.scenario_en: When question asks for intervention to address patient's primary symptom
rules.checkpoint: 要求的干预是诊断还是治疗？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is the requested intervention diagnostic or therapeutic?
rules.error_behavior: 模型误将诊断性检查当作解决症状的干预措施，混淆诊断与治疗
rules.correct_reasoning: 题目要求干预解决症状，超声心动图是诊断检查，本例符合肥厚型心肌病，首选美托洛尔治疗

rules.rule: 盆腔病灶DWI高信号ADC低信号，需同时考虑脓肿和恶性肿瘤
rules.rule_en: For pelvic lesions with high DWI and low ADC, consider both abscess and malignancy
rules.scenario: 解读盆腔MRI的DWI及ADC序列影像时
rules.scenario_en: When interpreting DWI and ADC sequences of pelvic MRI
rules.checkpoint: 是否同时考虑脓肿和恶性肿瘤？
rules.checkpoint_en: Have both abscess and malignancy been considered?
rules.error_behavior: 错误认为扩散受限最常见原因是恶性肿瘤，不恰当排除盆腔脓肿
rules.correct_reasoning: 脓肿和恶性肿瘤均可出现扩散受限，二者均需考虑，不能优先排除脓肿

rules.rule: 创伤后CRI减弱，优先选择第四脑室压迫术
rules.rule_en: For post-traumatic diminished CRI, prioritize compression of the fourth ventricle
rules.scenario: 头部创伤后头痛，伴SBS活动受限、CRI减弱
rules.scenario_en: Post-traumatic headache with limited SBS motion and diminished CRI
rules.checkpoint: 是否存在颅节律冲动减弱？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is there diminished cranial rhythmic impulse?
rules.error_behavior: 错误认为第四脑室压迫是过时危险技术，误选SBS平衡韧带张力
rules.correct_reasoning: 第四脑室压迫是安全成熟技术，适用于本例创伤后头痛伴CRI减弱

rules.rule: 骨质疏松合并脆性髋骨折需预处理代谢检查
rules.rule_en: Pre-treatment metabolic workup is required for osteoporosis with fragility hip fracture
rules.scenario: 新发骨质疏松合并脆性髋骨折的临床管理
rules.scenario_en: Clinical management of newly diagnosed osteoporosis with fragility hip fracture
rules.checkpoint: 是否已完成预处理代谢检查？
rules.checkpoint_en: Has pre-treatment metabolic workup been completed?
rules.error_behavior: 错误认为无需预处理代谢检查，直接起始双膦酸盐治疗
rules.correct_reasoning: 起始骨质疏松药物治疗前，需先完成继发性病因代谢检查

rules.rule: Answer clinical questions exactly what they ask for
rules.rule_en: Answer clinical questions exactly what they ask for
rules.scenario: Answering multiple-choice questions about expected imaging findings
rules.scenario_en: Answering multiple-choice questions about expected imaging findings
rules.checkpoint: Does my answer match what the question asks?
rules.checkpoint_en: Does my answer match what the question asks?
rules.error_behavior: Misinterpreted the question as asking for the causative lesion instead of the most likely observed imaging finding, selected wrong answer
rules.correct_reasoning: First confirm the question's request. This question asks for the most likely observed imaging finding, which is distended gallbladder (Courvoisier's sign) in this painless obstructive jaundice case.

rules.rule: 区分晚期RA需结合对称受累、快速进展和严重狭窄
rules.rule_en: Distinguish advanced RA combining symmetric involvement, rapid progression and severe narrowing
rules.scenario: 区分晚期类风湿关节炎与其他炎症性关节病时
rules.scenario_en: When distinguishing advanced RA from other inflammatory arthropathies
rules.checkpoint: 是否结合进展特点区分晚期RA？
rules.checkpoint_en: Does it use progression feature to distinguish advanced RA?
rules.error_behavior: 仅靠对称多关节狭窄伴破坏区分晚期RA，忽略快速进展
rules.correct_reasoning: 区分晚期RA不能仅靠对称破坏，需结合对称受累、快速进展、严重狭窄才更具特异性

rules.rule: 脑部MRI读片先确认中线结构移位
rules.rule_en: Confirm midline shift before reading brain MRI
rules.scenario: 脑部MRI判断病变水肿与占位效应关系时
rules.scenario_en: When assessing lesion edema and mass effect on brain MRI
rules.checkpoint: 是否存在明显中线结构移位？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is there significant midline shift?
rules.error_behavior: 错误评估中线移位程度，漏诊明显中线移位
rules.correct_reasoning: 先确认信号特点，再仔细观察中线结构是否移位，本题存在明显中线移位

rules.rule: 判断小脑扁桃体疝需确认其低于枕骨大孔
rules.rule_en: Confirm position below foramen magnum to diagnose tonsillar herniation
rules.scenario: 判断小脑扁桃体是否疝出的影像阅片
rules.scenario_en: When reading MRI to assess cerebellar tonsillar herniation
rules.checkpoint: 小脑扁桃体是否低于枕骨大孔？
rules.checkpoint_en: Are cerebellar tonsils below foramen magnum?
rules.error_behavior: 错误认定小脑扁桃体低于枕骨大孔，误诊为疝出
rules.correct_reasoning: 先定位枕骨大孔，再确认扁桃体位置，未低于则无疝出

rules.rule: 遇卒中代码伴瞳孔不等大，先确认是否有玻璃义眼史
rules.rule_en: When code stroke with anisocoria, first check glass eye history
rules.scenario: 无影像能力的乡村中心处理伴瞳孔不等大的卒中代码患者
rules.scenario_en: Managing code stroke patient with anisocoria at rural center without imaging
rules.checkpoint: 瞳孔不等大是否为玻璃义眼的基线表现？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is anisocoria a baseline finding from glass prosthetic eye?
rules.error_behavior: 忽略玻璃义眼病史，将瞳孔不等大误诊为急性颅内病变导致
rules.correct_reasoning: 先识别玻璃义眼史，瞳孔不等大是基线表现，无新发缺损无需紧急神经影像学检查

rules.rule: 现有组织学与既往活检不符时，优先按现有组织学诊断
rules.rule_en: Prioritize current histology over conflicting prior biopsy diagnosis
rules.scenario: 复发性鼻腔黏膜病变，现有组织学与既往活检结果不符
rules.scenario_en: Recurrent nasal mucosal lesion with conflicting current histology and prior biopsy
rules.checkpoint: 现有组织学是否符合既往诊断？
rules.checkpoint_en: Does current histology match the prior diagnosis?
rules.error_behavior: 坚持既往汗腺腺瘤诊断，忽略现有组织学提示的病变特征
rules.correct_reasoning: 优先评估现有组织学，考虑初次活检可能误诊，匹配特征诊断

rules.rule: 肩袖更大部分撕裂指关节侧增大，滑囊侧仍完整
rules.rule_en: Larger partial rotator cuff tear means articular enlargement, bursal side intact
rules.scenario: 解读肩关节MRI肩袖部分撕裂的进展特征
rules.scenario_en: Interpreting progression of partial rotator cuff tear on shoulder MRI
rules.checkpoint: 更大部分撕裂是否累及滑囊侧？
rules.checkpoint_en: Does larger partial tear involve bursal side?
rules.error_behavior: 错误将更大部分撕裂解读为滑囊侧进行性撕裂
rules.correct_reasoning: 更大部分撕裂仅指关节侧撕裂范围增大，滑囊侧仍完整

rules.rule: 右颞叶切除术仅切除海马前部/异常部分，而非整个结构
rules.rule_en: Right temporal lobectomy resects only anterior/abnormal hippocampus, not the entire structure
rules.scenario: 分析癫痫患者右颞叶海马术后MRI手术效果
rules.scenario_en: Analyzing surgical outcomes on postoperative MRI of right temporal hippocampus in epilepsy patients
rules.checkpoint: 是否正确判断海马切除范围？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is the extent of hippocampal resection correctly judged?
rules.error_behavior: 误判第一患者完全切除整个海马，错判第二患者术后有切除腔伴残余肿瘤
rules.correct_reasoning: 右颞叶切除术仅切除海马前部异常部分，需按影像信号判断肿瘤切除完整性

rules.rule: 无延迟CT时，肾上腺高强化先考虑嗜铬细胞瘤
rules.rule_en: For adrenal lesion without delayed CT, consider pheochromocytoma first for hypervascular enhancement
rules.scenario: 判断肾上腺病变性质，仅提供平扫和动脉期CT HU值
rules.scenario_en: Judging adrenal lesion nature with only unenhanced and arterial phase CT HU values
rules.checkpoint: 有无延迟CT数据计算廓清率？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is there delayed CT to calculate washout?
rules.error_behavior: 误判CT期相，无延迟数据仍诊断乏脂性腺瘤，排除嗜铬细胞瘤
rules.correct_reasoning: 无延迟CT无法计算良性廓清，高强化优先考虑嗜铬细胞瘤

rules.rule: 术后腹壁切口波动性肿块，先超声再切开引流
rules.rule_en: Postoperative abdominal wound fluctuant mass, ultrasound first before I&D
rules.scenario: 腹部术后切口伴感染出现波动性肿块，拟行切开引流前
rules.scenario_en: Postoperative abdominal incision with infection has fluctuant mass before planned I&D
rules.checkpoint: 是否先行床旁超声检查切口肿块？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is bedside ultrasound done before I&D?
rules.error_behavior: 误认体检发现波动感即可直接行床旁切开引流，无需术前超声
rules.correct_reasoning: 需先做床旁超声明确脓肿深度、范围，排除深部延伸，再行处理

rules.rule: ASPECTS得分=10减去受累区域数量
rules.rule_en: ASPECTS score equals 10 minus number of affected regions
rules.scenario: 计算急性脑卒中CT的ASPECTS评分时
rules.scenario_en: When calculating ASPECTS score for acute stroke on CT
rules.checkpoint: 得分是否等于10减受累区域数？
rules.checkpoint_en: Does score equal 10 minus affected regions?
rules.error_behavior: 错误认为ASPECTS 6分需要5个受累区域
rules.correct_reasoning: ASPECTS得分=10-受累区域数，6分对应4个受累区域

rules.rule: 开放性骨折冲洗首选低压重力流生理盐水
rules.rule_en: Low-pressure gravity saline is first-line for open fracture irrigation
rules.scenario: 开放性骨折初始清创后进行伤口冲洗
rules.scenario_en: Wound irrigation after initial debridement of open fracture
rules.checkpoint: 冲洗方案是否为低压重力生理盐水？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is the irrigation using low-pressure gravity saline?
rules.error_behavior: 错误认为低压重力流不足以清创开放性骨折，选择高压脉动流
rules.correct_reasoning: 指南推荐开放性骨折冲洗首选低压重力生理盐水，高压冲洗有害无优势

rules.rule: 进展期胆脂瘤可出现耳囊侵蚀及听骨完全缺失
rules.rule_en: Advanced cholesteatoma can have otic capsule erosion and complete ossicle absence
rules.scenario: 颞骨CT诊断胆脂瘤病变时
rules.scenario_en: When diagnosing cholesteatoma on temporal bone CT
rules.checkpoint: 进展期胆脂瘤会侵蚀耳囊吗？
rules.checkpoint_en: Can advanced cholesteatoma erode otic capsule?
rules.error_behavior: 错误认为 mural胆脂瘤不会出现耳囊侵蚀听骨缺失
rules.correct_reasoning: 进展期mural胆脂瘤可出现耳囊侵蚀和听骨完全缺失

rules.rule: HIV CD4<200：活带状疱疹疫苗禁用
rules.rule_en: For HIV with CD4 <200, live zoster vaccine is contraindicated
rules.scenario: 艾滋病患者CD4<200cells/µL，评估疫苗指征
rules.scenario_en: Evaluating vaccine indication in HIV with CD4 <200 cells/µL
rules.checkpoint: 患者CD4计数是否小于200cells/µL？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is patient CD4 count less than 200 cells/µL?
rules.error_behavior: 模型误将选项中带状疱疹疫苗认作重组疫苗，忽略其为减毒活疫苗
rules.correct_reasoning: HIV CD4<200时，活带状疱疹疫苗禁用，本例需选复方新诺明加肺炎球菌疫苗

rules.rule: V4-V6深T波倒置需排查心尖肥厚型心肌病
rules.rule_en: Deep T inversion in V4-V6 needs to exclude apical HCM
rules.scenario: 心电图见V4-V6深T波倒置，需对肥厚型心肌病分型时
rules.scenario_en: When ECG shows deep T inversion in V4-V6 and HCM typing is required
rules.checkpoint: 是否符合心尖肥厚型心肌病表现？
rules.checkpoint_en: Does it match apical HCM features?
rules.error_behavior: 错误否认心尖肥厚型心肌病，忽略特征性表现选泛化诊断
rules.correct_reasoning: V4-V6深T波倒置结合超声特征需考虑心尖肥厚型心肌病

rules.rule: 读胸部CT轴位片，先依据解剖标志确认侧别
rules.rule_en: When reading axial chest CT, confirm side with anatomic landmarks first
rules.scenario: 判断胸部CT轴位片上肺动脉充盈缺损侧别时
rules.scenario_en: When judging the side of pulmonary artery filling defect on axial chest CT
rules.checkpoint: 是否正确确认了CT图像的患者侧别？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is the patient's side correctly identified on CT?
rules.error_behavior: 混淆了患者左右和观察者左右，误判充盈缺损侧别
rules.correct_reasoning: 遵循标准放射常规：患者左侧对应观察者图像右侧，可通过降主动脉位于椎体左侧确认侧别，再定位充盈缺损

rules.rule: 看到T2不均子宫肌瘤，需结合T1判断是否变性
rules.rule_en: When seeing T2 heterogeneous fibroids, combine T1 to judge degeneration
rules.scenario: 盆腔MRI判断子宫肌瘤是否变性时
rules.scenario_en: Judging fibroid degeneration on pelvic MRI
rules.checkpoint: 是否结合T1信号判断肌瘤变性？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is T1 signal used to judge fibroid degeneration?
rules.error_behavior: 模型看到T2不均就直接判定肌瘤变性，错选D
rules.correct_reasoning: T1均质符合非变性特点，T2不均不一定是变性，本例为非变性肌瘤

rules.rule: 定位主动脉病变节段后再进行病变分型诊断
rules.rule_en: Localize aortic lesion before classifying pathology type
rules.scenario: 对CT图像中的主动脉病变进行分型诊断时
rules.scenario_en: When classifying aortic pathology on CT images
rules.checkpoint: 病变累及升主动脉还是仅局限降主动脉？
rules.checkpoint_en: Does lesion involve ascending or only descending aorta?
rules.error_behavior: 错误将降主动脉病变误定位为升主动脉，排除正确选项
rules.correct_reasoning: 先准确定位病变主动脉节段，局限降主动脉为B型，本例符合E选项诊断

rules.rule: 肩胛下肌横韧带撕裂，需确认肱二头肌位置再诊断
rules.rule_en: Confirm biceps position before diagnosis after subscapularis and transverse ligament tear
rules.scenario: 读肩关节轴向MRI发现肩胛下肌横韧带撕裂时
rules.scenario_en: When reading axial shoulder MRI with subscapularis and transverse ligament tear
rules.checkpoint: 是否确认了肱二头肌肌腱的位置？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is the position of biceps tendon confirmed?
rules.error_behavior: 错误假定肩胛下肌横韧带撕裂必然导致肱二头肌内侧脱位，未看影像确认位置
rules.correct_reasoning: 发现肩胛下肌和横韧带撕裂后，需根据影像实际观察确认肱二头肌位置再诊断

rules.rule: 辨胰管内高回声位置，区分结石与慢性胰腺炎钙化
rules.rule_en: Identify location of hyperechoic to distinguish stone from calcification
rules.scenario: 评估扩张胰管内高回声区域性质时
rules.scenario_en: When evaluating hyperechoic regions within a dilated pancreatic duct
rules.checkpoint: 高回声是否位于胰管管腔内？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is hyperechoic located in pancreatic duct lumen?
rules.error_behavior: 错误排除胰管结石，误将胰实质钙化认作胰管内病变
rules.correct_reasoning: 胰管内高回声伴扩张首先考虑胰管结石，慢性胰腺炎钙化多位于胰实质

rules.rule: 垂体凸轮廓需先排除海绵窦颈内动脉内侧移位压迫
rules.rule_en: Convex pituitary contour should first rule out medial cavernous ICA displacement
rules.scenario: 对比两张垂体MRI分析垂体凸轮廓成因时
rules.scenario_en: When comparing two pituitary MRI to analyze cause of convex pituitary contour
rules.checkpoint: 是否排除颈内动脉内侧移位压迫？
rules.checkpoint_en: Has medial ICA displacement been ruled out?
rules.error_behavior: 错误否认颈内动脉内侧移位可致垂体凸轮廓，误选正常变异
rules.correct_reasoning: 颈内动脉内侧移位侧向挤压垂体使之上膨成凸轮廓，正常后叶亮斑无法解释轮廓差异

rules.rule: 结肠旁口服对比剂聚集先排查憩室炎穿孔脓肿
rules.rule_en: Check diverticulitis perforation first for contrast adjacent to colon on CT
rules.scenario: CT见结肠旁口服对比剂聚集合并胆囊异常

rules.rule: Confirm clinical finding before matching to risk factors
rules.rule_en: Confirm clinical finding before matching to risk factors

rules.scenario_en: Selecting risk factor for an illustrated physical exam finding

rules.checkpoint_en: Have I correctly identified the clinical finding?

rules.scenario_en: When identifying the direction of restrictive barrier for fibular head somatic dysfunction
rules.checkpoint: 限制性屏障是否在受限运动方向？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is the restrictive barrier in direction of restricted motion?

rules.rule: Evaluate lesion vascularity from current CT, don't generalize GIST

rules.rule: 发热合并冠脉扩张，需符合川崎病诊断标准才可诊断

rules.correct_reasoning: 先打开拉链排除机械性构音障碍，再行卒中相关评估

rules.rule: Sagittal pelvic MRI: left is anterior, right posterior for invasion localization

rules.scenario_en: Assessing adjacent organ invasion for cervical cancer on sagittal pelvic MRI

rules.checkpoint_en: Is left of sagittal pelvic image patient anterior?
rules.error_behavior: Misoriented sagittal pelvic MRI, misidentified bladder invasion as rectal invasion

X-linked inheritance (maternal uncle affected) fits hemophilia, and factor 8 deficiency (Hemophilia A) is far more common than factor 9, platelet disorders are ruled out by normal BT.

rules.rule: 假体周围骨折先确认假体稳定性再选治疗
rules.rule_en: Check implant stability before treating periprosthetic fracture post THA

rules.checkpoint: 是否确认了假体的稳定性？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is implant stability confirmed?
rules.error_behavior: 误判假体松动失败，错分骨折后选择翻修
rules.correct_reasoning: 先确认假体稳定性，固定良好的B1型首选ORIF无需翻修

rules.rule: 不明原因低钾血症需排查威尔逊病
rules.rule_en: Unexplained hypokalemia requires screening for Wilson disease

rules.checkpoint: 是否排查了威尔逊病？
rules.checkpoint_en: Has Wilson disease been excluded?
rules.error_behavior: 错误排除威尔逊病，认为其与低钾血症无关
rules.correct_reasoning: 威尔逊病铜沉积可致肾小管功能障碍，引发低钾血症，需排查

rules.rule: 勿仅因考虑截肢就排除复发性局限性腱鞘巨细胞瘤
rules.rule_en: Do not rule out recurrent localized GCTTS just because amputation is considered
keywords_en: giant cell tumor of the tendon sheath

rules.scenario_en: Evaluating a recurrent low-signal soft tissue hand lesion with prior excision history considered for amputation
rules.checkpoint: 是否仅因考虑截肢就排除GCTTS？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is GCTTS ruled out only due to amputation consideration?
rules.error_behavior: 仅因考虑截肢就排除局限性腱鞘巨细胞瘤，错误诊断为复发性纤维瘤病
rules.correct_reasoning: 手部解剖空间局限，复发性腱鞘巨细胞瘤可浸润邻近结构，需要评估截肢，不能仅因此排除该病，病灶低信号、既往切除史、手部发病均符合该病表现

rules.rule: 读胫骨骨折MRI需先确认起源、方向、分支和终止
rules.rule_en: Confirm origin, direction, branching, termination first for tibial fracture MRI
rules.scenario: 分析胫骨MRI判断骨折类型和范围时
rules.scenario_en: When analyzing tibial MRI to determine fracture type and extent
rules.checkpoint: 你确认骨折起源、走行和分支了吗？
rules.checkpoint_en: Have you confirmed fracture origin, course and branching?
rules.error_behavior: 误将中胫骨起源横形伴分支骨折认作近端螺旋无分支骨折
rules.correct_reasoning: 先识别骨折起源于胫骨中段，横形走行伴双侧分支，延伸至干骺端下端

rules.rule: 分类预防干预需先确认患者有无疾病诊断
rules.rule_en: Classify preventive intervention after confirming patient's diagnosis
rules.scenario: 对预防医学干预措施进行分类时
rules.scenario_en: When classifying preventive medicine interventions
rules.checkpoint: 是否确认了患者的疾病诊断状态？
rules.checkpoint_en: Has the patient's diagnosis status been confirmed?
rules.error_behavior: 错误假设患者无骨质疏松确诊，错误排除三级预防
rules.correct_reasoning: 不自行假设无诊断，降低风险可指确诊后降进展/并发症，选三级预防

rules.rule: Pancytopenia post gout prophylaxis points to xanthine oxidase inhibitor adverse effect
rules.rule_en: Pancytopenia after gout prophylaxis indicates xanthine oxidase inhibitor adverse effect
rules.scenario: Post-acute gout flare prophylaxis, patient develops pancytopenia
rules.scenario_en: After acute gout flare prophylaxis, patient develops pancytopenia
rules.checkpoint: Which drug caused the observed pancytopenia?
rules.checkpoint_en: Which drug caused the observed pancytopenia?
rules.error_behavior: Model incorrectly chose purine nucleotide synthesis inhibitor as the cause.
rules.correct_reasoning: Xanthine oxidase inhibitor (allopurinol) for gout prophylaxis can cause pancytopenia.

rules.rule: 免疫受损肺CT磨玻璃影伴结节，需排查CMV肺炎
rules.rule_en: For immunocompromised patients with lung CT GGO plus nodules, rule out CMV pneumonia
rules.scenario: 免疫受损患者肺CT见磨玻璃影伴小结节，鉴别感染时适用
rules.scenario_en: It applies for infection differential diagnosis when immunocompromised patients have lung CT GGO with nodules
rules.checkpoint: 是否已排查CMV肺炎的可能性？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is CMV pneumonia correctly evaluated?
rules.error_behavior: 忽略PCP无广泛小结节表现，误排CMV诊断为PCP
rules.correct_reasoning: 免疫受损肺CT磨玻璃影伴小结节，PCP无此典型表现，CMV可出现该表现

rules.rule: Do not diagnose IIH if a known cause of elevated ICP exists
rules.rule_en: Do not diagnose idiopathic intracranial hypertension if a known cause exists
rules.scenario: Evaluating elevated ICP in a patient with leukemia history
rules.scenario_en: Evaluating elevated intracranial pressure in a patient with leukemia history
rules.checkpoint: Is there a known cause for elevated intracranial pressure?
rules.checkpoint_en: Is there a known cause for elevated intracranial pressure?
rules.error_behavior: Model incorrectly diagnosed IIH despite CSF blasts confirming CNS leukemia relapse as cause of elevated ICP
rules.correct_reasoning: IIH requires no known cause of elevated ICP. This patient has CSF blasts confirming CNS ALL relapse, the correct diagnosis

rules.rule: 视网膜褶皱提示合并牵拉性和孔源性视网膜脱离
rules.rule_en: Corrugated retinal folds indicate combined tractional and rhegmatogenous retinal detachment
rules.scenario: 眼部超声判断视网膜脱离类型时
rules.scenario_en: When classifying retinal detachment type via ocular ultrasound
rules.checkpoint: 是否存在视网膜褶皱，合并牵拉成分？
rules.checkpoint_en: Are there corrugated retinal folds with traction component?
rules.error_behavior: 模型误将有褶皱的合并型视网膜脱离认为是浅脱离，漏诊牵拉成分
rules.correct_reasoning: 浅脱离无足够空间形成褶皱，存在褶皱提示合并牵拉性成分，应诊断为合并牵拉和孔源性视网膜脱离

rules.rule: Tc-99m HMPAO脑灌注显像先区分颅内颅外摄取
rules.rule_en: Distinguish intracranial and extracranial uptake on Tc-99m HMPAO brain perfusion scan
rules.scenario: 解读Tc-99m HMPAO脑灌注显像结果时
rules.scenario_en: When interpreting Tc-99m HMPAO brain perfusion scan results
rules.checkpoint: 摄取是否位于颅内脑实质？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is the uptake located in intracranial parenchyma?
rules.error_behavior: 误将颅外软组织的放射性摄取认作颅内脑实质正常灌注
rules.correct_reasoning: 先区分摄取位置，颅内无摄取仅颅外有摄取提示脑灌注缺失

rules.rule: 脊髓多发离散高信号，勿误判为脊髓空洞症
rules.rule_en: Multiple discrete spinal hyperintensities, do not misdiagnose as syringomyelia
rules.scenario: 脊髓MRI发现多发离散高信号病灶鉴别诊断时
rules.scenario_en: When performing differential diagnosis of multiple discrete hyperintense lesions on spinal cord MRI
rules.checkpoint: 是否为多发离散脊髓高信号病灶？
rules.checkpoint_en: Are there multiple discrete spinal hyperintense lesions?
rules.error_behavior: 误将多发离散高信号当成单个连续囊腔，错诊为脊髓空洞症
rules.correct_reasoning: 先识别病灶数目特点，多发离散病灶符合多发性硬化脱髓鞘斑块表现，优先考虑多发性硬化

rules.rule: 局灶结肠对比影先排除穿孔再诊断憩室
rules.rule_en: Rule out perforation before diagnosing diverticulum for focal colonic contrast collection
rules.scenario: CT读片见结肠局灶口服对比剂聚集，需鉴别诊断时
rules.scenario_en: When focal oral contrast collection is found on colon CT requiring differential diagnosis
rules.checkpoint: 是否已排除局限性小穿孔？
rules.checkpoint_en: Has small contained perforation been ruled out?
rules.error_behavior: 错误认为所有穿孔都会漏出游离对比剂，将局限性小穿孔误判为憩室
rules.correct_reasoning: 小的局限性穿孔可仅表现为局灶对比剂聚集，无游离腹腔对比剂漏出，需先区分病灶位置性质，排除穿孔后再诊断憩室

rules.rule: CT见肝多发低密度灶，先排除肝转移瘤而非脂肪肝
rules.rule_en: For multiple hypodense liver lesions on CT, rule out metastasis first not steatosis
rules.scenario: 解读腹部CT肝脏影像，患者有肝肿大及脂肪肝危险因素
rules.scenario_en: Interpreting abdominal CT liver imaging, patient with hepatomegaly and fatty liver risk factors
rules.checkpoint: 是否已经排除肝多发转移瘤可能？
rules.checkpoint_en: Has multiple hepatic metastasis been ruled out?
rules.error_behavior: 误将多发转移灶判为斑片状脂肪肝，错误排除转移瘤
rules.correct_reasoning: 多发局灶低密度符合转移瘤，弥漫低密度才是脂肪肝，即使有脂肪肝危险因素也要先考虑转移

rules.rule: 评估肠道CT，首先检查移行点排除小肠梗阻
rules.rule_en: When evaluating bowel CT, first check transition point to exclude obstruction
rules.scenario: 腹部CT肠道病变的鉴别诊断
rules.scenario_en: Differential diagnosis of bowel lesions on abdominal CT
rules.checkpoint: 是否存在扩张塌陷肠袢间移行点？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is there a transition point between dilated and collapsed bowel?
rules.error_behavior: 错将弥漫肠壁增厚脂肪条索当主异常，漏看移行点
rules.correct_reasoning: 先找核心异常，存在移行点应首先诊断小肠梗阻

rules.rule: 前位腹部扫描中，患者左对应图像右，正确定位消化道出血
rules.rule_en: On anterior abdominal scans, patient's left is image's right, localize GI bleed correctly
rules.scenario: 解读锝-99m标记红细胞消化道出血前位图像定位出血时
rules.scenario_en: When localizing bleeding site on anterior Tc-99m-labeled RBC GI bleed images
rules.checkpoint: 解剖定位方向是否正确？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is the anatomical orientation correct?
rules.error_behavior: 错误颠倒解剖方位，将左腹出血误判为回肠出血，错误排除横结肠出血
rules.correct_reasoning: 前位图像中患者左侧对应图像右侧，左中上腹局灶摄取符合横结肠出血，回肠多位于中右下腹可排除

rules.rule: 读题需核对MRI序列信号描述符合给定信息
rules.rule_en: Check if MRI sequence and signal match given info
rules.scenario: 鉴别非变性与变性子宫肌瘤的MRI考题中
rules.scenario_en: In MRI questions differentiating non-degenerate and degenerated fibroids
rules.checkpoint: 是否核对了给定的信号描述信息？
rules.checkpoint_en: Have you checked the given signal description?
rules.error_behavior: 错误排除含T2的选项，未核对信号描述错选A
rules.correct_reasoning: 先确认非变性肌瘤信号，再核对变性肌瘤信号，符合描述选F

rules.rule: 内侧距下脱位：趾短伸肌最易阻碍闭合复位

rules.scenario: 判断阻碍距下脱位闭合复位的结构时适用
rules.scenario_en: Applicable when identifying structure obstructing medial subtalar dislocation closed reduction
rules.checkpoint: 此损伤是否为内侧距下脱位？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is this injury a medial subtalar dislocation?
rules.error_behavior: 误判损伤为踝脱位，认为拇长屈肌腱阻碍复位，排除了正确答案
rules.correct_reasoning: 先明确损伤为内侧距下脱位，该损伤最常阻碍闭合复位的结构是趾短伸肌

rules.rule: 既往治疗无效提示换药，推断新发皮损病因
rules.rule_en: Previous ineffective treatment indicates drug change, infer cause of new lesion
rules.scenario: 难治性银屑病经多线治疗后新发皮损明确诊断
rules.scenario_en: Diagnosing new skin lesion in refractory psoriasis after multiple lines of therapy
rules.checkpoint: 是否推断出后续换用的治疗药物？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is the subsequent changed therapy inferred?
rules.error_behavior: 错误认为未提及的药物不存在，拒绝正确选项
rules.correct_reasoning: 既往治疗无效提示停药换药，secukinumab是银屑病标准下一线药符合诊断

rules.rule: DIP截肢需考虑蚓状肌阳性指并发症
rules.rule_en: Consider lumbrical plus finger after DIP amputation

rules.scenario_en: When analyzing complications after DIP joint amputation
rules.checkpoint: DIP截肢考虑了蚓状肌阳性指吗？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is lumbrical plus finger considered for DIP amputation?
rules.error_behavior: 错误描述蚓状肌阳性指病理，错认与DIP截肢无关
rules.correct_reasoning: DIP截肢时FDP离断于蚓状肌起点远端，可引发蚓状肌阳性指

rules.rule: 读腰椎MRI纤维环撕裂，先确认位置勿混淆正常结构
rules.rule_en: When interpreting lumbar MRI annular tear, confirm location avoid confusing normal structures
rules.scenario: 腰椎MRI评估椎间盘纤维环撕裂位置和性质
rules.scenario_en: Evaluating location and nature of intervertebral disc annular tear on lumbar MRI
rules.checkpoint: 是否正确判断了纤维环撕裂位置？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is the location of annular tear correctly identified?
rules.error_behavior: 误将侧方撕裂判为后方，误认脑脊液为移位髓核
rules.correct_reasoning: 先确认切片层面，该切片为旁矢状位，撕裂为侧方，高信号是脑脊液不是移位髓核，髓核完整无移位

rules.rule: 多发肝囊性病变需鉴别多囊肝与肝包虫病
rules.rule_en: Differentiate polycystic liver disease and hepatic echinococcosis for multiple hepatic cystic lesions

rules.scenario_en: When multiple hepatic cystic lesions are found on liver MRI for differential diagnosis
rules.checkpoint: 是否鉴别了多囊肝和肝包虫病？
rules.checkpoint_en: Have you differentiated polycystic liver disease and echinococcosis?
rules.error_behavior: 错误认为肝包虫病仅致少数囊肿，将多发肝囊性病变误诊为多囊肝
rules.correct_reasoning: 弥漫性多发包虫病也可致肝脏多发广泛囊性病变，需结合影像特征鉴别多囊肝和包虫病

rules.rule: 膝跳反射减弱时，首先考虑L3-L4神经根受累
rules.rule_en: When patellar reflex is diminished, first consider L3-L4 nerve root involvement

rules.scenario_en: Clinically determining involved lumbosacral nerve root with reflex abnormality
rules.checkpoint: 是否存在膝跳反射减弱？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is the patellar reflex diminished?
rules.error_behavior: 忽略膝跳反射减弱提示L3-L4受累，错误排除正确选项
rules.correct_reasoning: 膝跳反射主要由L3-L4神经根介导，患者膝跳反射减弱符合L3-L4受累

rules.rule: 孤立雷诺现象先排查CREST，不直接诊MCTD

rules.checkpoint: 是否存在MCTD相关的重叠症状？
rules.checkpoint_en: Are there MCTD-related overlap symptoms?

rules.correct_reasoning: 孤立雷诺是CREST核心表现，伴抗着丝点抗体阳性；MCTD需额外重叠表现，无则不考虑

rules.rule: CA19-9显著升高时，需先排除胆管细胞癌再考虑肝包虫病

rules.scenario_en: Patient with prior hepatic echinococcosis has new hepatic lesions
rules.checkpoint: CA19-9是否显著升高？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is CA19-9 markedly elevated?

rules.rule: 分析CTPA和ECG时，先确认心律再诊断肺栓塞
rules.rule_en: When analyzing CTPA and ECG, confirm rhythm before diagnosing PE
rules.scenario: 中年男性长途飞行后急性发病，行ECG和CTPA检查
rules.scenario_en: Middle-aged male with acute symptoms after long flight, examined with ECG and CTPA
rules.checkpoint: 心电图心律是否解读正确？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is ECG rhythm interpreted correctly?
rules.error_behavior: 错将心电图判为规则心律，误报CTPA有PE充盈缺损，诊断PE而非房颤
rules.correct_reasoning: 先确认ECG为无P波的不规则心律符合房颤，CTPA无PE确诊证据，故诊断房颤

rules.rule: 甲黄变多甲受累时，先排查黄甲综合征勿误判甲癣
rules.rule_en: When nails are yellow and multiple involved, check yellow-nail syndrome first

rules.scenario_en: Nail disease diagnosis with yellow discoloration and multiple nail involvement
rules.checkpoint: 是否排查了黄甲综合征？
rules.checkpoint_en: Has yellow-nail syndrome been ruled out?

rules.correct_reasoning: 黄甲综合征可表现为增厚黄甲伴甲改变，多甲黄变优先考虑该病，本题符合该诊断

rules.rule: 酶缺陷疾病中，选缺陷酶为受累通路限速酶

rules.checkpoint: 缺陷酶是否为本次的限速酶？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is the defective enzyme the rate-limiting enzyme here?

rules.correct_reasoning: 患者丙酮酸激酶缺陷，该酶即为受累通路的限速酶

rules.rule: HIV相关无症状局限卡波西肉瘤初始ART加观察
rules.rule_en: Asymptomatic limited HIV-associated KS uses initial ART plus observation
rules.scenario: 确定HIV相关卡波西肉瘤的初始治疗方案时
rules.scenario_en: When determining initial treatment for HIV-associated Kaposi sarcoma
rules.checkpoint: 病灶是否无症状且局限？
rules.checkpoint_en: Are lesions asymptomatic and limited?

rules.correct_reasoning: 无症状局限HIV相关KS初始ART联合观察，化疗仅用于有症状进展快或ART难治者

rules.rule: 硝普钠诱导氰中毒合并肾损伤首选羟钴胺

rules.scenario_en: When selecting antidote for nitroprusside-induced cyanide poisoning with AKI
rules.checkpoint: 硝普钠致氰中毒合并肾损首选羟钴胺吗？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is hydroxocobalamin first-line for this case?
rules.error_behavior: 误认硫代硫酸钠为一线，忽略患者合并急性肾损伤

rules.rule_en: Distinguish surface artifacts from subcutaneous air for linear lucency on chest X-ray
