rules.rule: 评估婴儿HPS风险，需考虑新生儿大环内酯预防暴露
rules.rule_en: When assessing infant HPS risk, consider neonatal macrolide prophylaxis exposure
rules.scenario: 3周龄新生儿进食后喷射性呕吐，评估HPS风险时
rules.scenario_en: Assessing HPS risk factors for a 3-week-old neonate with post-feeding projectile vomiting
rules.checkpoint: 是否有新生儿大环内酯预防暴露史？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is there a history of neonatal macrolide prophylaxis?
rules.error_behavior: 错误选择单卵双胎为HPS风险因素，忽略大环内酯暴露的明确关联
rules.correct_reasoning: 先根据典型表现疑诊HPS，再确认大环内酯预防是HPS明确危险因素

rules.rule: 颅骨棉絮混密度影先考虑Paget病而非骨髓瘤
rules.rule_en: Consider Paget disease instead of multiple myeloma for mixed opacity on skull X-ray
rules.scenario: 解读颅骨X线混合溶骨成骨改变时
rules.scenario_en: When interpreting mixed lytic sclerotic changes on lateral skull X-ray
rules.checkpoint: 该颅骨病变符合哪种疾病？
rules.checkpoint_en: Which disease does this skull lesion fit?
rules.error_behavior: 误将Paget病棉絮影认作骨髓瘤改变，选错实验室指标
rules.correct_reasoning: 颅骨混合溶骨成骨增厚是Paget病，ALP升高，应选D

rules.rule: 读腰椎CT需查看所有层面，勿漏矢状位术后改变
rules.rule_en: Check all views when reading lumbar CT, don't miss sagittal post-surgical changes
rules.scenario: 腰椎CT评估脊柱骨折及术后改变时
rules.scenario_en: When evaluating spinal fracture and post-surgical changes on lumbar CT
rules.checkpoint: 是否查看了所有CT层面的异常？
rules.checkpoint_en: Have you checked all CT slices for abnormalities?
rules.error_behavior: 模型漏看矢状位的术后内固定改变，错误排除正确选项
rules.correct_reasoning: 需查看所有CT方位层面，发现术后内固定要考虑医源性骨折

rules.rule: CT见骨折+外渗：勿直接认定骨折为出血来源
rules.rule_en: CT shows fracture + extravasation: don't assume fracture is bleeding source
rules.scenario: 创伤休克患者CT见腰椎骨折合并腹膜后对比剂外渗
rules.scenario_en: Traumatic shock patient has lumbar fracture with retroperitoneal contrast extravasation on CT
rules.checkpoint: 出血来源确认是骨折吗？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is bleeding source confirmed as fracture?
rules.error_behavior: 错误认定对比剂外渗来自骨折，排除了大血管损伤可能
rules.correct_reasoning: 骨折和外渗共存不能确认出血来源，休克时需先排除大血管损伤

rules.rule: 骨MRI读片需先明确骨髓信号分布以分期骨髓炎
rules.rule_en: Characterize marrow signal on bone MRI to stage osteomyelitis
rules.scenario: 分析骨MRI判断骨髓炎分期时
rules.scenario_en: When interpreting bone MRI for osteomyelitis staging
rules.checkpoint: 是否正确判断骨髓信号分布？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is marrow signal distribution correctly identified?
rules.error_behavior: 错误判断骨髓高信号分布，误将骨膜水肿认作骨膜反应，错诊亚急性骨髓炎
rules.correct_reasoning: 先确认液体敏感序列上骨髓高信号分布，骨膜水肿不等于骨膜反应，局限性高信号符合急性骨髓炎伴积脓

rules.rule: CTA双侧头臂静脉均显影时，上腔静脉无混合未显影血
rules.rule_en: When both brachiocephalic veins are opacified on CTA, SVC has no mixed unopacified blood
rules.scenario: 分析胸部CTA上腔静脉和头臂静脉的显影情况时
rules.scenario_en: When analyzing opacification of SVC and brachiocephalic veins on chest CTA
rules.checkpoint: 双侧头臂静脉都显影了吗？
rules.checkpoint_en: Are both brachiocephalic veins opacified?
rules.error_behavior: 错误认定双侧头臂静脉均显影时上腔静脉仍有未显影血混合
rules.correct_reasoning: 双侧头臂静脉均含对比剂显影，汇入上腔静脉后应均匀显影，无未混合未显影血

rules.rule: 骨干大结节是第二肋的特征性解剖标志
rules.rule_en: A large shaft tuberosity is the characteristic marker of the 2nd rib
rules.scenario: 识别胸廓肋骨病变中受累肋骨的解剖特征时
rules.scenario_en: When identifying anatomical features of involved rib in thoracic rib lesions
rules.checkpoint: 哪根肋骨骨干有特征性大结节？
rules.checkpoint_en: Which rib has a characteristic large shaft tuberosity?
rules.error_behavior: 模型错误将骨干大结节归为第一肋特征，存在多处肋骨解剖认知错误
rules.correct_reasoning: 本例受累肋骨是第二肋，第二肋特征是骨干有供前锯肌附着的大结节

rules.rule: 稳定首次癫痫发作选门诊脑电图而非住院监测
rules.rule_en: For stable first seizure, use outpatient EEG not inpatient monitoring
rules.scenario: 稳定首次无诱因癫痫发作，发作后缺陷完全缓解，检查结果正常时
rules.scenario_en: For stable first unprovoked seizure with resolved deficits and normal exams
rules.checkpoint: 该首选门诊还是住院脑电图检查？
rules.checkpoint_en: Should we choose outpatient or inpatient EEG as next step?
rules.error_behavior: 误判门诊脑电图 yield低，错误选择住院24小时视频脑电图
rules.correct_reasoning: 稳定患者无需住院监测，安排门诊脑电图是合适下一步

rules.rule: 正常X线不能排除早期骨髓炎，需看骨髓MRI信号
rules.rule_en: Normal X-ray cannot rule out early osteomyelitis, check bone marrow MRI signal
rules.scenario: X线正常，MRI发现骨内异常高信号时
rules.scenario_en: When X-ray is normal, MRI shows abnormal high signal in bone
rules.checkpoint: 是否排除早期骨髓炎，骨髓信号正常吗？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is there abnormal bone marrow signal, rule out early osteomyelitis?
rules.error_behavior: 误将骨内异常信号归为正常软组织，认为正常X线可排除骨髓炎
rules.correct_reasoning: 早期骨髓炎X线可正常，骨内MRI异常信号提示骨髓炎

rules.rule: 达托霉素可被肺表面活性物质灭活，不用于肺炎
rules.rule_en: Daptomycin is inactivated by pulmonary surfactant, avoid for pneumonia
rules.scenario: 选择ICU院内肺炎的经验性抗生素治疗时
rules.scenario_en: Selecting empiric antibiotics for ICU hospital-acquired pneumonia
rules.checkpoint: 达托霉素可用于治疗肺炎吗？
rules.checkpoint_en: Can daptomycin be used to treat pneumonia?
rules.error_behavior: 模型错误排除正确选项G，错认达托霉素不会在肺失活，错选F
rules.correct_reasoning: 达托霉素被肺泡肺表面活性物质灭活，对肺炎无效，正确为G

rules.rule: 陈旧心梗EF降低稳定室速，首选利多卡因而非胺碘酮
rules.rule_en: For stable VT with old MI and reduced EF, prefer lidocaine over amiodarone
rules.scenario: 陈旧心梗、射血分数降低患者出现稳定室性心动过速
rules.scenario_en: Hemodynamically stable VT in patients with old MI and reduced EF
rules.checkpoint: 此病例是否首选利多卡因治疗？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is lidocaine the first-line treatment here?
rules.error_behavior: 错误认为该情况首选胺碘酮，排除了正确的利多卡因
rules.correct_reasoning: 陈旧心梗EF降低伴稳定室速，首选静脉利多卡因，胺碘酮非首选

rules.rule: 指甲扁平苔藓伴甲缺失出血性结痂，无完整大疱也不能排除大疱亚型
rules.rule_en: For nail lichen planus with nail loss and hemorrhagic crusting, do not rule out bullous subtype even without intact bullae
rules.scenario: 评估丙型肝炎阳性患者的指甲扁平苔藓亚型时
rules.scenario_en: When evaluating subtypes of nail lichen planus in hepatitis C positive patients
rules.checkpoint: 是否存在指甲缺失伴出血性结痂？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is there nail loss with hemorrhagic crusting?
rules.error_behavior: 因未见完整大疱排除大疱性扁平苔藓，误选丙型肝炎相关性指甲扁平苔藓
rules.correct_reasoning: 大疱性扁平苔藓大疱破裂后可无完整大疱，表现为甲缺失出血性结痂，本例应选该特异形态学分型

rules.rule: 诊断BRASH综合征，晕厥提示休克无需持续低血压
rules.rule_en: For BRASH syndrome diagnosis, syncope indicates shock without persistent hypotension
rules.scenario: 判断疑似BRASH综合征病例是否符合休克标准
rules.scenario_en: Judging whether suspected BRASH syndrome meets shock criteria
rules.checkpoint: 患者晕厥是否符合BRASH休克标准？
rules.checkpoint_en: Does patient syncope meet BRASH shock criteria?
rules.error_behavior: 错误认为BRASH休克必须有持续入院低血压
rules.correct_reasoning: BRASH休克可表现为一过性晕厥低灌注，无需持续低血压

rules.rule: 阅片MRI需查肌腱纤维完整性区分撕裂程度
rules.rule_en: Check tendon fiber integrity on MRI to distinguish tear grade
rules.scenario: 评估骨盆MRI长收肌肌腱撕裂程度时
rules.scenario_en: Evaluating adductor longus tendon tear grade on pelvic MRI
rules.checkpoint: 肌腱纤维是否全层中断？
rules.checkpoint_en: Are tendon fibers fully disrupted?
rules.error_behavior: 误判肌腱纤维未完全中断，将完全撕裂错认为部分撕裂
rules.correct_reasoning: 先确认肌腱纤维是否全层中断，全层中断为完全撕裂，本例耻骨完整，为完全撕裂

rules.rule: 回答重组胰岛素生产相关问题时，需核查选项字面事实准确性
rules.rule_en: When answering recombinant insulin production questions, check options for literal factual accuracy
rules.scenario: 外源性胰岛素过量致低血糖考题中，需判断合成胰岛素生产细胞的特性
rules.scenario_en: In exam questions about hypoglycemia from exogenous insulin overdose, identify characteristics of synthetic insulin producing cells
rules.checkpoint: 选项描述是否符合字面事实准确性？
rules.checkpoint_en: Does the option description meet literal factual accuracy?
rules.error_behavior: 模型错误认为选项E普遍正确，错误排除描述大肠杆菌特性的正确选项B
rules.correct_reasoning: 重组胰岛素可使用大肠杆菌生产，选项B准确描述其特性；选项E错误，生产细胞不表达天然人胰岛素基因

rules.rule: Keratin-negative GI spindle tumors with lymph node spread favor sarcomatoid carcinoma
rules.rule_en: Keratin-negative GI spindle tumors with lymph node spread favor sarcomatoid carcinoma
rules.scenario: Diagnosing poorly differentiated gastrointestinal spindle cell neoplasms
rules.scenario_en: Diagnosing poorly differentiated gastrointestinal spindle cell neoplasms
rules.checkpoint: Does this spindle neoplasm have lymph node metastasis?
rules.checkpoint_en: Does this spindle neoplasm have lymph node metastasis?
rules.error_behavior: Over-relied on complete keratin negativity to exclude sarcomatoid carcinoma, ignored lymphatic spread pattern.
rules.correct_reasoning: Poorly differentiated sarcomatoid carcinoma can lose keratin expression; lymph node metastasis favors it over UPS which usually spreads hematogenously.

rules.rule: Positive PCR from sterile biopsy confirms etiology despite negative culture
rules.rule_en: Positive PCR from sterile biopsy confirms etiology despite negative culture
rules.scenario: Diagnosing spinal infection with positive biopsy PCR but negative culture
rules.scenario_en: Diagnosing spinal infection with positive biopsy PCR but negative culture
rules.checkpoint: Is positive PCR from sterile biopsy?
rules.checkpoint_en: Is positive PCR from sterile biopsy?
rules.error_behavior: Model incorrectly dismissed positive PCR as contamination due to negative culture
rules.correct_reasoning: Positive PCR from sterile biopsy with inflammation confirms etiology even with negative culture

rules.rule: 颈髓C2-C6T2高信号先排查压迫性脊髓病
rules.rule_en: For increased T2 signal in C2-C6 cervical cord, check compressive myelopathy first
rules.scenario: 颈髓MRI发现C2至C6水平颈髓T2高信号时
rules.scenario_en: When increased T2 signal is found in C2-C6 cervical cord on MRI
rules.checkpoint: 是否优先排查了压迫性脊髓病？
rules.checkpoint_en: Has compressive myelopathy been checked first?
rules.error_behavior: 错误排除退行性压迫性脊髓病，误诊断为脊髓肿瘤
rules.correct_reasoning: 先确认是否存在退行性变导致颈髓压迫，再考虑其他病因

rules.rule: MRI主动脉信号丢失，勿误认正常管腔为支架，先查血栓
rules.rule_en: For MRI aortic signal loss, don't mislabel normal lumen as stent, check thrombus first
rules.scenario: 分析MRI腹主动脉瘤腔内信号丢失原因时适用
rules.scenario_en: Applicable when analyzing cause of signal loss in abdominal aortic aneurysm lumen on MRI
rules.checkpoint: 是否误将正常管腔识别为金属支架？
rules.checkpoint_en: Did you misidentify normal lumen as metallic stent?
rules.error_behavior: 误将降主动脉正常管腔认定为金属支架，错把信号丢失归因为支架伪影
rules.correct_reasoning: 先确认解剖结构，金属支架伪影不延伸远段，慢性血栓可致T1信号丢失

rules.rule: 脂肪栓塞后苍白楔形梗死优先考虑心肌而非肺
rules.rule_en: After fat embolism, pale wedge infarct suggests heart not lung
rules.scenario: 多发骨折后疑诊脂肪栓塞综合征，判断梗死病灶器官
rules.scenario_en: Identifying infarct organ after multiple fractures with suspected FES
rules.checkpoint: 梗死病灶是苍白还是出血性？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is the infarct pale or hemorrhagic?
rules.error_behavior: 错误认为肺会出现脂肪栓塞所致苍白楔形梗死
rules.correct_reasoning: 肺因双重血供梗死多为出血性，脂肪栓子可致心肌苍白梗死

rules.rule: 阅颅颈交界区矢状位MRI需确认小脑扁桃体位置
rules.rule_en: Confirm position of cerebellar tonsils on sagittal craniocervical MRI
rules.scenario: 评估颅颈交界区MRI是否存在小脑扁桃体下疝
rules.scenario_en: Assessing tonsillar herniation on craniocervical junction MRI
rules.checkpoint: 小脑扁桃体是否低于枕骨大孔？
rules.checkpoint_en: Are tonsils below the foramen magnum?
rules.error_behavior: 模型误判小脑扁桃体位于枕骨大孔上方，否认下疝
rules.correct_reasoning: 先定位枕骨大孔，再判断小脑扁桃体是否下疝及下疝水平

rules.rule: 鉴别恶性雀斑样痣：交界异型细胞不规则分布聚集
rules.rule_en: Diagnose lentigo maligna via irregular clustered junctional atypical cells
rules.scenario: 共聚焦下鉴别恶性雀斑样痣和发育不良交界性病变
rules.scenario_en: Differentiating lentigo maligna from dysplastic junctional lesion under confocal microscopy
rules.checkpoint: 是否存在交界区异型细胞不规则聚集？
rules.checkpoint_en: Are there irregular clustered junctional atypical cells?
rules.error_behavior: 误认恶性雀斑样痣是均匀无聚集的交界异型细胞
rules.correct_reasoning: 恶性雀斑样痣特征为交界区异型细胞不规则分布聚集，可资鉴别

rules.rule: CT读片先按标准方位确认病变侧别再诊断
rules.rule_en: Confirm lesion side by standard orientation before CT diagnosis
rules.scenario: 腹部CT肾脏病变定位诊断，需要明确病变侧别时
rules.scenario_en: Localizing renal lesions on abdominal CT, need to confirm lesion side
rules.checkpoint: 是否按标准方位确认了病变侧别？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is lesion side confirmed by standard orientation?
rules.error_behavior: 错误定位病变肾脏，将左肾病变误判为右肾，错排正确选项
rules.correct_reasoning: 按标准放射学方位，结合多幅图像确认病变位于左肾，再结合征象选答案

rules.rule: 肩MRI见肱二头肌腱旁暗区需先定位，区分撕裂与沟内积液
rules.rule_en: On shoulder MRI, localize dark area near biceps tendon to distinguish tear vs fluid
rules.scenario: 分析肩部MRI序列中肱二头肌腱旁暗区时
rules.scenario_en: When analyzing dark area near biceps tendon on sequential shoulder MRI
rules.checkpoint: 暗区位于肌腱内还是肱二头肌沟？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is the dark area in tendon or bicipital groove?
rules.error_behavior: 错误将肱二头肌沟暗区定位于肌腱内，误诊为部分撕裂
rules.correct_reasoning: 先确认暗区在肌腱实质还是肱二头肌沟内，包绕肌腱的暗区是沟内积液

rules.rule: 儿童慢性湿咳哮喘治疗无效，首选阿莫西林克拉维酸钾试验
rules.rule_en: For pediatric chronic wet cough unresponsive to asthma therapy, trial amoxicillin-clavulanate first
rules.scenario: 儿童慢性湿性咳嗽，对哮喘/过敏药物治疗无效时
rules.scenario_en: When pediatric chronic wet cough is unresponsive to asthma/allergy medications
rules.checkpoint: 是否为哮喘治疗无效的儿童慢性湿咳?
rules.checkpoint_en: Is it chronic wet cough unresponsive to asthma therapy in child?
rules.error_behavior: 错误排除阿莫西林克拉维酸钾诊断性治疗试验，误选肺功能检查，未考虑激素治疗无效降低了哮喘概率
rules.correct_reasoning: 儿童慢性湿咳经哮喘、过敏治疗无效后，细菌感染病因可能性大，经验性阿莫西林克拉维酸钾治疗试验是标准诊断步骤，哮喘因激素无效概率低，无需首选肺功能检查

rules.rule: 游走复发性瘙痒皮疹勿误诊疥疮，先考虑炎症性皮疹
rules.rule_en: Do not misdiagnose recurrent migratory pruritic rash as scabies
rules.scenario: 急诊或门诊鉴别泛发慢性复发性瘙痒皮疹
rules.scenario_en: Differential diagnosis of generalized chronic recurrent pruritic rash in clinic/ER
rules.checkpoint: 皮疹是否符合疥疮临床特点？
rules.checkpoint_en: Does the rash match clinical features of scabies?
rules.error_behavior: 将游走复发性泛发瘙痒皮疹误诊为疥疮，误选扑灭司林
rules.correct_reasoning: 游走复发不符合疥疮持续存在特点，疥疮好发褶皱间擦部位，本病例为炎症性皮肤病，需用糖皮质激素治疗

rules.rule: RTA先定病理生理缺陷，再选具体分子机制
rules.rule_en: Confirm pathophysiological defect first before molecular mechanism for RTA
rules.scenario: 分析RTA病因题，无法区分具体分子机制时
rules.scenario_en: Analyzing RTA etiology questions when specific molecular mechanism cannot be distinguished
rules.checkpoint: 是否能确定具体分子病因？
rules.checkpoint_en: Can the specific molecular etiology be determined?
rules.error_behavior: 错误选无证据的具体分子机制，排除正确病理生理选项
rules.correct_reasoning: 先定病理生理缺陷，无法区分分子机制时选病理生理选项

rules.rule: 区分肿瘤缺氧水平与固定OER，D0与放射敏感性负相关
rules.rule_en: Distinguish tumor hypoxia level from fixed OER; D0 inversely correlates with radiosensitivity
rules.scenario: 分析肿瘤缺氧降低后细胞放射敏感性变化时适用
rules.scenario_en: Applicable when analyzing changes in cellular radiosensitivity after decreased tumor hypoxia
rules.checkpoint: OER是否固定，D0是否与敏感性负相关？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is OER fixed, D0 inversely related to radiosensitivity?
rules.error_behavior: 将肿瘤缺氧水平等同于OER值，错误解读D0拒绝正确选项
rules.correct_reasoning: OER是给定细胞和射线的固定参数，不随缺氧水平改变；缺氧降低增加放射敏感性，使D0降低

rules.rule: 冠脉造影见远端显影需排除侧支供血的完全闭塞
rules.rule_en: When distal contrast is seen, exclude total occlusion via collaterals
rules.scenario: 冠状动脉造影判断左前降支病变性质时
rules.scenario_en: When diagnosing LAD lesion on coronary angiography
rules.checkpoint: 是否排除了侧支供血导致的远端显影？
rules.checkpoint_en: Have you excluded distal filling via collaterals?
rules.error_behavior: 误将中段完全闭塞判为弥漫狭窄，认为远端显影就排除闭塞

rules.correct_reasoning: 患者血清铁降低，持续呕吐影响口服铁吸收，叶酸正常无需额外补充，应选静脉铁

rules.rule: 分析CMT高弓足失衡需关注第一跖骨肌作用

rules.rule: 低风险疑似跖骨应力骨折平片正常首选经验性保守治疗

rules.correct_reasoning: 低风险临床高度怀疑的跖骨应力骨折，平片正常首选休息+NSAIDs经验性保守治疗，MRI仅用于保守无效或诊断不确定者

rules.rule: 血管造影勿将塑形微导管头端误认栓塞弹簧圈

rules.rule: Prioritize regular appointments for frequent somatic symptom care seekers
rules.rule_en: Prioritize regular appointments for frequent somatic symptom care seekers

rules.scenario_en: Multiple unexplained symptoms with frequent ED visits after declining specialist referral
rules.checkpoint: Is regular scheduled appointment prioritized?
rules.checkpoint_en: Is regular scheduled appointment prioritized?
rules.error_behavior: Incorrectly dismissed scheduling regular appointments, chose asking patient about symptom cause as best step
rules.correct_reasoning: Regular scheduled primary care appointments provide consistent access, reassurance, reduce unnecessary acute care, and build trust for these patients, which is evidence-based after declining specialist referral

rules.rule: CTA排查肺栓塞，疑似充盈缺损需溯源确认心腔连接

rules.checkpoint: 该血管是否连接右心房？
rules.checkpoint_en: Does the vessel connect to the right atrium?

rules.rule: 感音神经性聋术后利尿提示袢利尿剂作用于升支粗段

rules.checkpoint: 听力损失是否由袢利尿剂导致？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is hearing loss caused by loop diuretic?
rules.error_behavior: 模型误将袢利尿剂作用位点认作远曲小管
rules.correct_reasoning: 静脉利尿剂后感音神经性聋是袢利尿剂耳毒性，其作用位点是髓袢升支粗段，远曲小管是噻嗪类位点

rules.rule: 肝腺瘤>5cm，首选切除不首选活检

rules.correct_reasoning: 大于5cm疑似肝腺瘤出血风险高，禁忌活检，应首选切除

rules.rule: Young femoral neck nonunion prefers valgus osteotomy over arthroplasty
rules.rule_en: Prefer valgus osteotomy over arthroplasty for young active patients with femoral neck nonunion

rules.checkpoint_en: Does the patient have femoral head collapse?

rules.correct_reasoning: 年轻活跃患者股骨颈骨不连不伴塌陷首选保关节的外翻截骨，不首选半髋置换

rules.rule: Do not add unstated criteria to eliminate options
rules.rule_en: Do not add unstated criteria to eliminate options
rules.scenario: Answering clinical multiple-choice pathophysiology questions
rules.scenario_en: Answering clinical multiple-choice pathophysiology questions
rules.checkpoint: Did I add any unstated elimination criteria?
rules.checkpoint_en: Did I add any unstated elimination criteria?
rules.error_behavior: Added unstated criterion that change must be primary not compensatory
rules.correct_reasoning: Only use criteria explicitly stated in the question. Compensatory changes are valid pathophysiologic changes.

rules.rule: 逐一确认每根骨的MRI骨髓信号再诊断骨髓炎

rules.error_behavior: 误读胫骨骨髓信号，错误认为两根骨都有急性炎症
rules.correct_reasoning: 分别读取每根骨的骨髓信号，确认胫骨慢性低信号、腓骨急性高信号

rules.rule: Check slice level first when localizing FCD on FLAIR MRI

rules.scenario_en: Localizing subtle focal cortical dysplasia on axial FLAIR MRI for epilepsy evaluation

rules.correct_reasoning: Confirm slice level first: high superior slice above insula confirms FCD in cingulate, not insula

rules.rule: 答题前先确认题目问的是诊断还是相关疾病

rules.correct_reasoning: 先明确题目要求，该表现符合坏死性外耳道炎，葡萄糖不耐受是其最常见相关危险因素，应选B

rules.rule: 解读联合影像特征需涵盖所有发现，不能遗漏

rules.rule: 仔细读题，明确题目要求的结局类型

rules.rule: 唇部弥漫结痂糜烂，需排查IBD勿仅诊单纯疱疹

rules.scenario: 长期服抗精神病药的双相障碍患者疑诊药物性帕金森综合征
rules.scenario_en: Bipolar disorder patient on antipsychotics with suspected DIP
rules.checkpoint: 是否优先更换致病药物而非影像学检查？
rules.checkpoint_en: Should we replace offending agent before imaging?
rules.error_behavior: 错误优先选择DaTscan检查，认为换用药物前需先明确诊断
rules.correct_reasoning: 怀疑药物性帕金森且有安全替代方案时，应首先换用致病药物，无需先做DaTscan

rules.rule: Viewing anterior coronal brain: image left = patient's right hemisphere
rules.rule_en: When viewing anterior coronal brain sections: image left is patient's right hemisphere
rules.scenario: Localizing stroke lesion affecting motor homunculus on coronal brain image
rules.scenario_en: Localizing stroke lesion affecting motor homunculus on coronal brain image
rules.checkpoint: Did you reverse patient brain laterality?
rules.checkpoint_en: Did you reverse patient brain laterality?
rules.error_behavior: Reversed brain laterality, incorrectly thought image left is patient's left hemisphere, chose wrong region.
rules.correct_reasoning: Anterior coronal view convention: image left = patient's right hemisphere, image right = patient's left hemisphere. Right hand weakness localizes to contralateral (patient left) hemisphere upper extremity motor area, which is Region D.

rules.rule: 鉴别腺肌症时，优先选择肌层内囊肿而非弥漫肌层扩张
rules.rule_en: When differentiating adenomyosis, prioritize intramyometrial cysts over diffuse myometrial expansion
rules.scenario: 盆腔MRI鉴别弥漫性子宫腺肌症与子宫肌瘤、子宫内膜增生时
rules.scenario_en: When differentiating diffuse adenomyosis from leiomyoma and endometrial hyperplasia on pelvic MRI
rules.checkpoint: 哪个特征更支持弥漫性子宫腺肌症诊断？
rules.checkpoint_en: Which feature better supports the diagnosis of diffuse adenomyosis?
rules.error_behavior: 错误排除肌层内小囊肿特征，误认弥漫肌层扩张为最佳特征
rules.correct_reasoning: 肌层内小囊肿比弥漫肌层扩张对腺肌症更具特异性

rules.rule: 显著肝酶升高是抗结核治疗最常见停药指征
rules.rule_en: Significant elevated liver enzymes are the most common indication to stop anti-TB treatment
rules.scenario: 判断抗结核治疗停药指征的临床场景
rules.scenario_en: Clinical scenario of judging discontinuation indications for anti-TB treatment
rules.checkpoint: 是否为最常见的停药指征？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is it the most common indication for discontinuation?
rules.error_behavior: 误将肝酶升高仅解读为轻度无症状升高，错选视神经炎
rules.correct_reasoning: 符合停药标准的显著肝酶升高是抗结核治疗最常见停药指征，更常见于视神经炎

rules.rule: 青少年轻度移位ASIS撕脱首选保守而非手术
rules.rule_en: For mildly displaced ASIS avulsion in adolescents, conservative is first-line
rules.scenario: 青少年运动后ASIS撕脱骨折的治疗决策
rules.scenario_en: Treatment decision of ASIS avulsion fracture in adolescent athletes
rules.checkpoint: 该撕脱骨折是否首选手术治疗？
rules.checkpoint_en: Is surgery first-line for this avulsion fracture?
rules.error_behavior: 错误认为ASIS撕脱首选手术，排除正确保守治疗
rules.correct_reasoning: 青少年轻中度移位ASIS撕脱首选保守，手术仅用于严重移位

rules.rule: 鉴定血琼脂细菌先确认溶血类型和菌落形态
rules.rule_en: When identifying bacteria on blood agar, confirm hemolysis type and colony morphology first
rules.scenario: 需要对血琼脂平板培养分离出的细菌进行鉴定
rules.scenario_en: Identifying bacterial isolates cultured on blood agar plate
rules.checkpoint: 你确认溶血类型和菌落形态了吗？
rules.checkpoint_en: Have you confirmed hemolysis type and colony morphology?
rules.error_behavior: 错误将α溶血菌落识别为β溶血和金黄色葡萄球菌典型菌落，误选金黄色葡萄球菌
rules.correct_reasoning: 先正确观察血琼脂平板的溶血类型和菌落形态，再匹配对应细菌，本案例α溶血对应肺炎链球菌
